chapters.title: Chapter 1310: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (1)
paragraphs: [4th Floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon]
It had already been close to a month since Vexthra, her sisters, and the legion entered the dungeon.
They planned to enter the 5th floor immediately, considering that they had already cleared the entirety of the Church of destruction the last time.
Unexpectedly, however, Unity fell into a trance-like state when a writing on a wall in the Church of Destruction triggered memories of her past life as the goddess of the hunt.
That made them wait for her to finish.
They could have left her and gone ahead to challenge the 5th floor, but Vexthra chose to wait for her, since Kent had told them the dungeon was somehow linked to Unity’s past.
So allowing her to be with them every step of the way was the best move on their part. In the end, she did come out of her trance stronger and ready for what lies ahead.
She claimed that she had awakened a skill for creating a powerful kind of arrow. She didn’t demonstrate how it works, but she promised to show them when they enter the 5th floor.
They are happy with that. After all, they are more than ready to kick some ass on the 5th and subsequent floors.
"Alright, gather around," Vexthra said, clapping gently. In no time, her sisters and the legion gathered around. Kaizo, of course, was in front of the line, already pumped for a good battle.
All of them had already reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage, even without Kent upgrading them.
Of course, the Eternal Wrath Legion are immortals, so the moment Kent ascended to the High World, their cultivation recovered to the limit of a High World.
However, the Undead Legion, according to what happened the last time Kent upgraded them, their cultivation base only increased to the Spirit Lord stage.
However, since they were in a medium world, it remained at the Core Formation stage. But it caught up after the ascension.
But unlike the Eternal Wrath Legion, they had to cultivate to reach the Heavenly Ascension stage. They only recovered to the Spirit Lord stage.
So the fact that they have already reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage shows the cultivation technique they are using, and their comprehension is through the roof.
Even Krex, the undying cockroach, has reached the Heavenly Ascension stage and is pumped to test his new abilities. The dungeons inside the tower aren’t much of a challenge to them anymore.
So they need a stronger challenge.
Watching them lined up with powerful auras around them, Vexthra knew the future of Kent’s harem and legion is in safe hands.

"Good," she nodded, "as we have already discussed, if the battle is not too big and dangerous, only a selected few would participate. This is to ensure we all test our abilities in a favourable environment."
They all nodded, already content with this plan.

They are too overpowered, so if they gang up on the enemy as they have done so far, they wouldn’t feel the pressure they desire. It is through that pressure that they can see their limits and work on transcending them.
Vexthra came up with this plan, of course.
"Since we are both in agreement, then we should be on our way," Vexthra opened the doorway to the 5th floor and entered. Her sisters followed, then Kaizo, and the legion followed.
The last to enter is Uncle Drew, Miryssa and the three demigods. They hid their aura and would be standing down like Vexthra.
This is not their battle, at least, not yet their battle.
[5th Floor - Haunted Village]

When Vexthra and her team emerged on the other side, they were shocked to appear in the middle of a road leading to a probably busy city, considering that in front of them, there were many carriages moving.
The load is clean and wide enough to allow a long journey.
Looking closely at the carriages moving away, Vexthra instantly see loads of injured folks moaning and groaning packed within. Some are even passed out, and others are near death’s door.
She is a god, so examining the injured, she found that something dark had caused it, judging by the dark, smoky energy emanating from the wounds.
The ordinary eye wouldn’t see such an aura, but she did, and that made her aware something insideious is amiss.
"Hey, you are blocking the way!" Suddenly, a voice came from behind, prompting Vexthra to become aware of where they were standing.
Turning around, they saw more carriages coming, each packed with injured people. They quickly spread out to let them pass.
Unity quickly used the chance to ask them a question.
Vexthra wasn’t the only one who saw the injured; they all did and realised something was definitely wrong.
"Uhm, may I know what is wrong?"
Beside the carriage, some guards, looking like they had fought harrowing battles, glared at her. Their armours are busted, and even their pale looks show they are not in the mood to talk.
However, Unity is or was the Goddess of Love for a reason. Her appearance and voice put them at ease.

One of them looked up to Unity and answered, "Something dark appeared in Lerma Village and started devouring beings there. We didn’t know for how long, but we received a distress signal 2 days ago, and by the time we got there, these were the only survivors."
The answer left Unity, and everyone was puzzled. "And where are you taking them?" Vexthra asked.

"Holix City. We don’t know what had infected the village, so the pope ordered that the survivors be brought there. Hopefully, with the holy power of the Goddess of Light, we will be able to purge this darkness."
After that, the guard moved along and left, running after his friends. Unity and the others watched them go with complex expressions.

They both knew the mission for this floor was probably in the village that the guard mentioned. However, the guard they spoke to is a peak Spirit Lord, yet his miserable appearance made it seem as if he had fought a god.
Also, while the rest saw nothing, Vexthra and the demigods could tell that something was seriously wrong with the guards and the people.
It was like they were alive and at the same time dead.
To the ordinary person, they seemed normal, but they saw much deeper. This made them realise that perhaps this mission would be a wild one.
"Something isn’t right," Kaizo, of all people, even sensed something was amiss. Although he is not dumb, aside from battle, he is much more dull to catch on to normal stuff.
His intelligence is geared more toward battles only. However, if even he saw through this new mission, then it is plain it isnt a normal one.

They all turned to Vexthra because she is in charge of the mission. Mostly, the mission details come to her the moment they appear on the dungeon floor, so they turned to her to see what was wrong with this particular mission.
Thankfully, at that very moment, the mission details appeared before her.
’Tower, share the details with everyone.’
She gave the order, and they all saw the message appear on a panel before them.

sentences.text: [4th Floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon]
It had already been close to a month since Vexthra, her sisters, and the legion entered the dungeon.
They planned to enter the 5th floor immediately, considering that they had already cleared the entirety of the Church of destruction the last time.
Unexpectedly, however, Unity fell into a trance-like state when a writing on a wall in the Church of Destruction triggered memories of her past life as the goddess of the hunt.
That made them wait for her to finish.
They could have left her and gone ahead to challenge the 5th floor, but Vexthra chose to wait for her, since Kent had told them the dungeon was somehow linked to Unity’s past.
So allowing her to be with them every step of the way was the best move on their part.
In the end, she did come out of her trance stronger and ready for what lies ahead.
She claimed that she had awakened a skill for creating a powerful kind of arrow.
She didn’t demonstrate how it works, but she promised to show them when they enter the 5th floor.
They are happy with that.
After all, they are more than ready to kick some ass on the 5th and subsequent floors.
"Alright, gather around," Vexthra said, clapping gently.
In no time, her sisters and the legion gathered around.
Kaizo, of course, was in front of the line, already pumped for a good battle.
All of them had already reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage, even without Kent upgrading them.
Of course, the Eternal Wrath Legion are immortals, so the moment Kent ascended to the High World, their cultivation recovered to the limit of a High World.
However, the Undead Legion, according to what happened the last time Kent upgraded them, their cultivation base only increased to the Spirit Lord stage.
However, since they were in a medium world, it remained at the Core Formation stage.
But it caught up after the ascension.
But unlike the Eternal Wrath Legion, they had to cultivate to reach the Heavenly Ascension stage.
They only recovered to the Spirit Lord stage.
So the fact that they have already reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage shows the cultivation technique they are using, and their comprehension is through the roof.
Even Krex, the undying cockroach, has reached the Heavenly Ascension stage and is pumped to test his new abilities.
The dungeons inside the tower aren’t much of a challenge to them anymore.
So they need a stronger challenge.
Watching them lined up with powerful auras around them, Vexthra knew the future of Kent’s harem and legion is in safe hands.
"Good," she nodded, "as we have already discussed, if the battle is not too big and dangerous, only a selected few would participate.
This is to ensure we all test our abilities in a favourable environment."
They all nodded, already content with this plan.
They are too overpowered, so if they gang up on the enemy as they have done so far, they wouldn’t feel the pressure they desire.
It is through that pressure that they can see their limits and work on transcending them.
Vexthra came up with this plan, of course.
"Since we are both in agreement, then we should be on our way," Vexthra opened the doorway to the 5th floor and entered.
Her sisters followed, then Kaizo, and the legion followed.
The last to enter is Uncle Drew, Miryssa and the three demigods.
They hid their aura and would be standing down like Vexthra.
This is not their battle, at least, not yet their battle.
[5th Floor - Haunted Village]

When Vexthra and her team emerged on the other side, they were shocked to appear in the middle of a road leading to a probably busy city, considering that in front of them, there were many carriages moving.
The load is clean and wide enough to allow a long journey.
Looking closely at the carriages moving away, Vexthra instantly see loads of injured folks moaning and groaning packed within.
Some are even passed out, and others are near death’s door.
She is a god, so examining the injured, she found that something dark had caused it, judging by the dark, smoky energy emanating from the wounds.
The ordinary eye wouldn’t see such an aura, but she did, and that made her aware something insideious is amiss.
"Hey, you are blocking the way!" Suddenly, a voice came from behind, prompting Vexthra to become aware of where they were standing.
Turning around, they saw more carriages coming, each packed with injured people.
They quickly spread out to let them pass.
Unity quickly used the chance to ask them a question.
Vexthra wasn’t the only one who saw the injured; they all did and realised something was definitely wrong.
"Uhm, may I know what is wrong?"
Beside the carriage, some guards, looking like they had fought harrowing battles, glared at her.
Their armours are busted, and even their pale looks show they are not in the mood to talk.
However, Unity is or was the Goddess of Love for a reason.
Her appearance and voice put them at ease.
One of them looked up to Unity and answered, "Something dark appeared in Lerma Village and started devouring beings there.
We didn’t know for how long, but we received a distress signal 2 days ago, and by the time we got there, these were the only survivors."
The answer left Unity, and everyone was puzzled.
"And where are you taking them?" Vexthra asked.
"Holix City.
We don’t know what had infected the village, so the pope ordered that the survivors be brought there.
Hopefully, with the holy power of the Goddess of Light, we will be able to purge this darkness."
After that, the guard moved along and left, running after his friends.
Unity and the others watched them go with complex expressions.
They both knew the mission for this floor was probably in the village that the guard mentioned.
However, the guard they spoke to is a peak Spirit Lord, yet his miserable appearance made it seem as if he had fought a god.
Also, while the rest saw nothing, Vexthra and the demigods could tell that something was seriously wrong with the guards and the people.
It was like they were alive and at the same time dead.
To the ordinary person, they seemed normal, but they saw much deeper.
This made them realise that perhaps this mission would be a wild one.
"Something isn’t right," Kaizo, of all people, even sensed something was amiss.
Although he is not dumb, aside from battle, he is much more dull to catch on to normal stuff.
His intelligence is geared more toward battles only.
However, if even he saw through this new mission, then it is plain it isnt a normal one.
They all turned to Vexthra because she is in charge of the mission.
Mostly, the mission details come to her the moment they appear on the dungeon floor, so they turned to her to see what was wrong with this particular mission.
Thankfully, at that very moment, the mission details appeared before her.
’Tower, share the details with everyone.’
She gave the order, and they all saw the message appear on a panel before them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1311: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (2)
paragraphs: ⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: Haunted Village (5th)⟧
⟦Power Level: Spirit Sovereign - Heavenly Ascension*⟧
⟦Description:
↠ Two days ago, one of the seeds planted by the Dark Empress hatched in a small village west of Holix, the City of Light. In less than 48 hours, it had killed thousands.
↠ The Holy Pope of the Light Church sent holy warriors over when he received the distress signal. Thanks to his intervention, several thousand were saved.
↠ However, even though many were saved, the damage is already done, and the peaceful Lerma Village has now become a haunted city, surrounded by the darkness of the Dark Princess.
↠ The Holy Pope plans to lead a charge into the temple within the next 45 hours to eradicate the filth. However, he cannot be allowed to do that since that is a trap set by the Dark Princess.

↠ She wanted more cultivators with the light energy burning in their hearts to enter her trap, something she planned on using to evolve into a Dark Queen. When that happens, then all of Planet Yoppi would be covered in darkness.
↠ Your mission is to venture into the Haunted Village and eradicate the Dark Princess and her Dark Fiends before she evolves.
↠ Also, you must eradicate the darkness in the hearts of those touched by her dark, corrupted energy. Failure to do that within the next 48 hours will turn them all into Dark Fiends. ⟧
⟦Be ready for anything, since the amount of light harvested by the Dark Princess is enough for an evolution. Good luck⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 10 Billion Tower Points
↠ 300 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Booster Pill.
Everyone sucked in a cold breath as they read the details of the mission. "This sounds like a dangerous mission," Zareth muttered, reading through the description again.
Even Vexthra nodded to his words despite her being a goddess.
"Oh, trust me, it is dangerous for sure." Uncle Drew suddenly stepped forward, making sure everyone paid attention to him. Vexthra realised he knew something, so even she started to listen.
When he reached the front of the line, he began to speak about the harrowing nature of the mission.

"Calling it a dangerous mission is an understatement. What the mission didn’t tell you is that the Dark Empress is no simple threat. In fact, putting a label on her is not wise; her nature is far more threatening to every life in the universe than one would like to accept.
The number of gods and the Supremes that fell to her darkness is just too much to even begin to count.
During the Dark Era, when the creatures of the Dark attacked this universe, the Dark Empress accompanied them, leading a portion of their forces called the Dark Fiends.
She led millions of Dark Fiends in that campaign, killing billions within a day. By the time the Night Riders arrived, she had already devoured several billions, turning them all into dark fiends.
A battle ensued between the night riders and her insurmountable army. After 69 days, she fell to my sword. However, before she died, she said something I didn’t understand until today
She said, and I quote, ’My invasion hasn’t started yet.’" Uncle Drew let everyone take in his words and the implications they carried.
He, like the rest of the Night Riders, has recovered his memories. However, he is still missing a few, especially memories related to some of the major universe-ending battles he fought in.
One of them is their battle with the Dark Empression. Thankfully, this mission had triggered the memory of that fateful battle.
"Although this isn’t the Dark Empress, as the mission description said, she is tied to her somehow, so we might be able to find something related to her when the mission is complete.
Naturally, that means this mission is now a priority one. And since the demigods and I can’t join you, Iwould like to remind you to be extra careful.
The Dark Empress was a dangerous opponent, and I have no doubt her minions would be any different."
Vexthra took over. "You heard the man, we are going against a remnant of an ancient past that even I haven’t met before in combat. This means we must prepare for a good battle."
Uncle Drew nodded, and so did everyone. He turned to Nara and smiled. "Are you ready for round two?"

The Veil lady who carries the seed of darkness smiled, showing she had also recovered that fateful memory. "Although she isn’t the real deal, the last time we faced her, I fell short, so I will do well to redeem myself this time around."
"Good to hear that." He turned to Vexthra and made a request,

"Allow only Nara, Saden, and Eryndor to fight the Dark Princess. All those with the Darkness Element can support from the side, and under no circumstance should anyone with the light element or holiness be allowed to venture into her nest."
"Why is that?" Val asked, clearly not liking this outcome since it doesn’t favour her. She is the Goddess of the Moon, so naturally, she has so much light and holiness in her blood.
The same could be said for Selene, Mara, Unity...
Uncle Drew smiled and answered:
"Many say darkness fears light. In a way, that is indeed true. However, in the case of the Dark Empress, light is her breakfast, lunch and supper.
She needs light to grow stronger. So if we sent you and anyone with a light element to her, she wouldn’t even have to lift a finger to render you useless and food for her to devour.
This is why we must only send those with dark elements. Nara and the other Night Riders draw their power from darkness, so they qualify.
You can even say light is her strongest ally, considering it renders the user weak when in her presence."
Vexthra took over, "The same can be said for Lani, Vari, Liora, and Indie."
Val nodded, but she seemed sad.
Seeing this, Vexthra smiled and said, "Don’t worry, while you can’t fight the darkness with the light at the source, you can help purge the one in the hearts of those touched by her vile energy."
Val and all who knew they couldn’t enter the nest nodded. Vexthra went ahead with her battle plan.

"Since it has come down to this, then like Uncle Drew said, Nara, you will face the Dark Princess with Saden and Eryndor. Lani, Vari, Liora, and Indie will support from the side, and the Undead Legion, with the exception of Kaizo, will be on standby to provide additional support should her Dark Fiends prove difficult to handle."
"Huh, why me?" Kaizo asked, his battle-ready face faltering.
Vexthra smiled and pointed due west, "You and Krex have a mission. It is not in the mission description, but it is related to it."
"I am cool," Kaizo said. Vexthra chuckled, knowing that as long as there is battle, Kaizo is down for anything.

She turned to the rest of her sisters and the Eternal Wrath Legion, "Unity will lead some of you to the city to go handle the curing of those infected by the darkness. Those who don’t want to go can come with us to the village."
They nodded.
"I will go with them," Miryssa said, standing at the back of the line with Lene.
"I will go with them too," Lene also said. She would love to see Nara kick ass up close, but she is a demigod, so she can see her, even from millions of miles away.
"Then it is decided," Vexthra said. Soon, the teams divided, and they went their separate ways.

chapters.title: Chapter 1312: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (3)
paragraphs: The team heading to Lerma Village consists only of Darkness Elemental users, with Nara as their leader.
Nara is a Night Rider with a natural affinity for darkness. She has no light in her heart compared to her sister Mara, who is literally an angel.
Nara is half human, half wraith, making her someone of the darkness kind. Her role in the Night Riders litterally make her the carrier of the Dark Seed, the source of their power.

So when facing darkness where light is not a counter but a food to be consumed, someone of her nature is needed. She is already strapped and ready for combat, two long swords sheathed on her back as she rides her Nightmare horse toward the village.
Joining her in this enterprise, of course, is Saden, who is also seated on her Nightmare horse. She is the first Night Rider Uncle Drew awakened after he became one, thanks to Kent.
She uses the bow, and while she isn’t Kent’s wife, thanks to her nature as a Night Rider, she already has a True Name.
When Kent invoked it, it had awakened her innate Night Rider talents, making her a powerful warrior in all regards.
Uncle Drew had already used a special method to awaken more of her innate talent, giving her that deadliness she had during the Dark Era.

Then there is Eryndor, who is riding on his own Nightmare horse. He used to be a high-ranking member of the Dark Devil Church before Uncle Drew met him. In the Night Riders, he has a special class that allows him to summon hellfiends.

Although his summons are temporary, there are some situations where he can form a contract with the summoned fiend (hell demon). Back in the day, he had contracted over 3,000 hellfiends, making him one of the most dangerous Night Riders.

Uncle Drew allowed him to join this campaign mainly because the darkness from the Dark Princess and her dark friend, while dangerous to light-based users, is actually beneficial to darkness elemental users.

The more they kill, the stronger they get. Eryndor had yet to form his first contract, so Uncle Drew wanted him to absorb more dark essence so he could summon the strongest fiends the moment he became an immortal.
Just the three of them would be enough for the Dark Princess. However, knowing what they know, Uncle Drew knew an extra hand wouldn’t be too bad.
Vari, Lani, and the rest of the assassins in the Chaos Dragon Harem would support, and the Undead Legion would provide backup.

If that isn’t enough, then some of the members of the Eternal Wrath Legion would step in. Not all of them left with Unity’s team, so they all want to help in ways they can, provided they have no light elemental affinity.
Along the way, they met some more carriages. Uncle Drew secretly marked them, so in case they meet an obstacle on the way, he can easily teleport to them to help.
After 30 minutes of movement, a dark and eerie village appeared in the distance. The buildings, while normal for a village, have their walls damaged and roofs burnt or eaten by something.
Dark smoke keeps rising from them, with many human and livestock skeletons littering the place.
"Looks spooky," Eryndor said, bringing his hellhorse (nightmare horse) to a halt.
The others also stopped, each scrutinising the eerie look before them. There is no doubt the city is indeed spooky, like Eryndor said.
The spookiness is indeed true. There is nothing encouraging about the village anymore. Everything had been covered by smoke and darkness.
What could be seen is now worn out. A battle happened in the city, and judging by the damage left behind, the guards they met may have narrowly escaped with their lives.
It was even a miracle they survived.

"This is indeed a nest of dark creatures. Looks similar to the Nest of the Dark Empress back during the Dark Era. It is just that this one is underdeveloped," Saden said, using her enhanced sight to see more clearly and much deeper into the village.
"Very underdeveloped for sure. If this were to be the Nest of the Dark Empress, by now, the howling, screaming, and crying of the Dark Fiends would have filled this place.
We wouldn’t even have met a single guard or civilian. I am judging that by now she is undergoing some form of evolution, which makes it the best time to strike."
Nara said, taking a sidelong glance at Saden... "If she is indeed undergoing an evolution, then you can go ahead and kill her with a single arrow to the head. If not, be ready for a deadly combat."

Saden nodded, and Nara turned to Eryndor... "Be ready to summon your own fiends. This will be a battle of fiends, so prepare well. The last time you lost almost all your summon... don’t make the same mistake again."
He nodded, already prepared. At his current level, he can summon 12 fiends (hell demons/ hell fiends).

Nara then turned to her sisters and the Undead Legion, "Let’s go. It will be better to end this quickly and handle the aftermath before things escalate. Who knows how long she has been planning this?"
They nodded and started moving toward the village.
"We will stay here," Vexthra said, standing atop a small hill, overlooking the village. Uncle Drew, Vargus (other Night Rider demigod), and Avotha (Abyss Dragon) joined her.
The ladies had no problem with that.
"We will stand much closer to the village just in case something unexpected happens," Olive and Ivy said before making their way toward the village.
They are two of Uncle Drew’s Night Agents. Since the maximum cultivation level for this mission is the Heavenly Ascension stage, they would be standing down.
They are at the Empyrean stage, just one stage above the limit of a High World.
They are not Night Riders, but they have some connection to the hellflame, and the darkness in their heart is even higher than Vari and the rest of the assassins.
This makes them perfect for this mission.
Watching them go, Uncle Drew merely smiled. Twelve of his Fourteen Night Agents had already reached the Death Stage, just a step from becoming Root Immortals.
However, these twins are very keen to remain at the Empyrean stage, citing a desire to experience life in a High World like the rest of Kent’s wives.
They are stronger than beings in the High Worlds, but they love the idea of living like them. Uncle Drew didn’t force them. His Night Agents are free to live their own lives, so he lets them.

Hopefully, soon, they will accept the offer to break some of the seals on their bodies so they can increase their cultivation. The higher they climb the floors of the dungeon, the stronger their opponents will be, so they would soon snap back to reality.
For now, they can have their fun.
Soon, Nara and her team arrived at the village entrance. Now that they were much closer, they started hearing the eerie sounds the Dark Fiends were making from deep within the village.
"Let’s get busy then." Without any hesitation, they entered, leaving only Olive, Ivy and some of the Eternal Wrath legion at the entrance.

Dark smoke keeps rising from them, with many human and livestock skeletons littering the place.
"Looks spooky," Eryndor said, bringing his hellhorse (nightmare horse) to a halt.
The others also stopped, each scrutinising the eerie look before them.
There is no doubt the city is indeed spooky, like Eryndor said.
The spookiness is indeed true.
There is nothing encouraging about the village anymore.
Everything had been covered by smoke and darkness.
What could be seen is now worn out.
A battle happened in the city, and judging by the damage left behind, the guards they met may have narrowly escaped with their lives.
It was even a miracle they survived.
"This is indeed a nest of dark creatures.
Looks similar to the Nest of the Dark Empress back during the Dark Era.
It is just that this one is underdeveloped," Saden said, using her enhanced sight to see more clearly and much deeper into the village.
"Very underdeveloped for sure.
If this were to be the Nest of the Dark Empress, by now, the howling, screaming, and crying of the Dark Fiends would have filled this place.
We wouldn’t even have met a single guard or civilian.
I am judging that by now she is undergoing some form of evolution, which makes it the best time to strike."
Nara said, taking a sidelong glance at Saden...
"If she is indeed undergoing an evolution, then you can go ahead and kill her with a single arrow to the head.
If not, be ready for a deadly combat."
Saden nodded, and Nara turned to Eryndor...
"Be ready to summon your own fiends.
This will be a battle of fiends, so prepare well.
The last time you lost almost all your summon... don’t make the same mistake again."
He nodded, already prepared.
At his current level, he can summon 12 fiends (hell demons/ hell fiends).
Nara then turned to her sisters and the Undead Legion, "Let’s go.
It will be better to end this quickly and handle the aftermath before things escalate.
Who knows how long she has been planning this?"
They nodded and started moving toward the village.
"We will stay here," Vexthra said, standing atop a small hill, overlooking the village.
Uncle Drew, Vargus (other Night Rider demigod), and Avotha (Abyss Dragon) joined her.
The ladies had no problem with that.
"We will stand much closer to the village just in case something unexpected happens," Olive and Ivy said before making their way toward the village.
They are two of Uncle Drew’s Night Agents.
Since the maximum cultivation level for this mission is the Heavenly Ascension stage, they would be standing down.
They are at the Empyrean stage, just one stage above the limit of a High World.
They are not Night Riders, but they have some connection to the hellflame, and the darkness in their heart is even higher than Vari and the rest of the assassins.
This makes them perfect for this mission.
Watching them go, Uncle Drew merely smiled.
Twelve of his Fourteen Night Agents had already reached the Death Stage, just a step from becoming Root Immortals.
However, these twins are very keen to remain at the Empyrean stage, citing a desire to experience life in a High World like the rest of Kent’s wives.
They are stronger than beings in the High Worlds, but they love the idea of living like them.
Uncle Drew didn’t force them.
His Night Agents are free to live their own lives, so he lets them.
Hopefully, soon, they will accept the offer to break some of the seals on their bodies so they can increase their cultivation.
The higher they climb the floors of the dungeon, the stronger their opponents will be, so they would soon snap back to reality.
For now, they can have their fun.
Soon, Nara and her team arrived at the village entrance.
Now that they were much closer, they started hearing the eerie sounds the Dark Fiends were making from deep within the village.
"Let’s get busy then." Without any hesitation, they entered, leaving only Olive, Ivy and some of the Eternal Wrath legion at the entrance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1313: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (4)
paragraphs: "The last time, they knew we were coming, and so they waited for us at the entrance," Saden said, her bow firmly in her grip as they ventured deeper into the village.
Of course, they had only moved 200 meters deeper, but considering this is a village, that is deep enough to at least meet a Dark Fiend.
However, aside from the eerie noises, they saw no dark fiend.

"This is a Dark Princess, so it is normal that we haven’t yet met a Dark Fiend. I am sure she has fewer creatures under her command, considering she had only recently hatched," Nara replied, riding on her hell horse.
"I suppose this is also good. With fewer Fiends, we can complete this mission much faster," Eryndor added, turning to his left. He looked deeper into the village but saw nothing.
They continued to advance.
Meanwhile, behind them, Lani, Vari, Liora, and Indie walked, observing their surroundings while having their own conversation.
"So none of you lived during the Dark Era?" Indie asked, looking at her sisters. They shook their heads and replied,

"From what I can remember, I lived during the Ancient Era. I don’t know which horror I fought back then, but I remember hearing from some elders that it was the Ancient Era," Lani said, causing her sisters to nod.
"I am from the Primordial Era," Vari added, and Liora followed, "Chaos Era."

"I am also from the Primordial Era, so I suppose we wouldn’t know anything about the Dark Creatures," Indie said, feeling sad she couldn’t join the conversation happening between Nara and the Night Rider teammates.
"I guess you are right. But Neomi did, or at least came into contact with Dark Creatures. I learned she was the one who eradicated the remaining Dark Creatures sealed behind the veil."
"Yeah, she is a monster, and we both know that. She isn’t known as the mother of killers for nothing."
The four ladies giggled despite walking deep into the heart of corrupted darkness. Although they all have their pasts, they all seemed impressed by Neomi’s.
Her past was no rainbows and sunshine.

Whenever they recovered a memory, they shared it with each other. In most cases, they shared happy memories. However, whenever it was Neomi’s turn, if it wasn’t one battle after another, then it was her running from danger.
The last memory she shared was when she entered the Trial of Killers to awaken her bloodline. That trial made her the mother of killers.

14,000 killers were sent into an abandoned planet, and only one walked out. She killed half the total number of killers, and using their blood as a stepping stone, she came out more dangerous and super powerful.
So when Uncle Drew revealed she was the one who ended what they couldn’t during the Dark Era, none of the ladies doubted him. They knew what Neomi was capable of.
"Good thing she isn’t here. She would have stolen the spotlight like always."
The ladies giggled again. However, their giggle was cut short when they sensed movement. Everyone turned to their right, sensing a wind blowing toward them.
"Incoming," Nara’s voice reached everyone, causing them to go into battle mode.
Vari drew her scythe, her hair darkening. She has a yin-yang type constitution, so while she has light in her heart, if she wishes, she can turn that off and take on the darkness.
Naturally, that is what she did. She needed her dark side for this mission, and now that she sensed danger, she knew it was time to go into combat mode.
"Let me handle it," she said before melding into the shadows.
3 km away, a 12-meter-tall dog with a giant horn standing on its forehead charged toward the team, its body radiating intense corrupted dark qi.
Judging by its appearance, it had only recently become this grotesque-looking fiend. Before the Dark Princess arrived, it was merely a household dog, loved and cared about by many children.
However, she transformed it into a Tier 17-level Dark Fiend with deadly intent.
Vari appeared atop a building 500 meters away, watching as the creature ran toward her sisters. "Ugly and dangerous. Great combination."
She smiled and turned into a mist of smoke. A second later, she arrived atop the dog and unleashed a powerful attack. Her scythe traced a dark arc in the air as it embedded itself into its neck.
There was no resistance at all.
The sudden attack caused it to stumble and fall, crashing through many makeshift buildings. Vari had already turned to dark smoke and vanished into thin air.
She appeared just when the dog tried to get back up after rolling several meters on the ground, crashing through many buildings.

This time, she moved with a blur, striking with her scythe several times within mere seconds. Dozens of thin lines appeared in the air and cut through the dog, severing its head and legs and basically, all parts of its body.
"That would do it," she muttered, placing her scythe on her shoulder, her senses spread out, looking for a few more prey in case there are some around.
From the body of the dead dog, a thin line of darkness moved and entered her body. At once, she felt energised. Her connection to the dark element strengthened all of a sudden, making her smile.
"Wow, I didn’t see that coming," she welcomed the change, but was also shocked by it. Strengthening the darkness element is much harder than the light element, so this is a big deal.
Regardless, she didn’t focus much on it and quickly made her way back to her sisters and teammates.
"What do you think?" Nara asked when Vari returned.
"It was just a Spirit Sovereign, but I can tell it is much stronger than the Spirit Lord-level beasts we have faced in the past."
"Then we’d better be prepared because we have more incoming." Just when Nara said that, the ground started shaking.
5 km away, dozens of dogs, each a Tier 17-level Dark Fiend, rushed toward Kent, their gazes burning with fury and hunger.
"It seems she knew we were here," Saden said, taking out an arrow from her quiver.
"Then we’d better make sure she doesn’t forget us till her death," Eryndor raised his staff and got ready to fight. He is a summoner, but he can also hold his own in close combat just fine.
Lani didn’t take out her scythe as Vari did; instead, her clown mask appeared on her face, and an annoying laughter started echoing in the air as she spun her daggers.
Vari turned and looked at her, clearly annoyed by the laughter... "Every time," she muttered.

"Don’t blame me. This is how I was born, so if you wanna blame someone, blame the one who created me." With a giggle, she summoned her tattoos, filling her flawless skin with names of all the people she had killed that didn’t deserve death.
"Time to clear some names off my skin, I suppose."
Her sisters just ignored her, knowing, as she said, this is who she is.
The Undead also got ready. Soon, their enemies arrived, and the long-awaited battle began.

chapters.title: Chapter 1314: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (5)
paragraphs: The battle quickly turned chaotic, forcing the Undead Legion to join in earlier than anticipated.
Although Nara and her team were not being pressured, as more and more Dark Fiends started coming in, they were being forced to use more of their energy.
Since they would be facing the Dark Princess, whose strength they had no idea of, using more of their energy on her minions isn’t the wise choice to make.
The maximum strength level of this mission is heavenly Ascension. However, there is no telling how monstrous she would be and what kind of fiends she would have under her wings.
So the twelve undead joined Vari, Lani, Indie, and Liora in handling the Dark Fiends while Nara, Saden, and Eryndor ventured deeper into the village.
Their mission is kill the Dark Princess.
They could sense her nest hidden deep inside the village, so they slowly made their way there, avoiding as many Dark Fiends as they could.
While killing them was strengthening their dark elements, they knew the longer they delayed, the more dangerous the Dark Princess became.
Allowing her to become a Queen would make her a whole different kind of threat that no one was ready for.

Of course, there is an upside to it. If she were to become a Dark Queen, there is Uncle Drew and the demigods to stop her. However, if the mission were to update itself and prohibit them from interfering even when that happens, it would truly become a disaster.
So the bet is to kill her before things escalate.

"Indie, allow some of the fiends to pass by you so that Velithra and Varyn can take some loads off your shoulder. There are a few Tier 19 Dark Fiends headed your way, so you are going to need to conserve your energy."
Vari advised, diving back into the battle, cutting down one fiend after another.
On the side, Indie allowed some of the Dark Fiends to pass, allowing two of the undead to handle them. After her True Name awakening, she had become much more deadlier.
Velithra, one of the Undead, uses both shadows (darkness) and void essence, so she was basically untouchable in this battle.
She was part of the eight undead Dori and her sisters created when Kent was in seclusion a while back. She is fast and deadly.

Varyn is no different. He is both an assassin and a knight, proficient in the use of souls and the void. His affinity for darkness is very strong, and now that he is growing stronger through slaughter, he seems to be having fun.
Even against the Tier 19 Dark Fiends, none of them were being pressed despite having the same cultivation base.
When it comes down to monstrous talents, Kent has dozens of them in his legion.
Meanwhile, deep into the village, Nara and her teammates came to a sudden stop, almost as if something held them down.

Sixty meters from them stood twelve humanoid Dark Fiends. Their height alone is about 4 meters tall, built to crash planets with a single punch. Their grotesque frame, which seemed to have been constructed by joining many body parts, gave them a unique appearance but also made them look dull and somewhat painful to look at.
There is no right word to describe their appearance.
The need to kill them filled the minds of the three Night Riders. Looking at those long, bone-like swords in their hands told them to prepare for a good battle.

But they didn’t immediately attack. They held themselves back simply because behind these twelve huge Dark Fiends sat a pale-looking lady with a pair of dark colored horns on her forehead. She had dark eyes and a human-like body.
She sat cross-legged on a throne, looking funny at Nara and her friends, who looked like they had seen a ghost.
In a way, they had indeed seen a ghost. The face staring at them—while they would love to say it isn’t her—the Dark Empress they had faced during the Dark Era looked just like her.

Obviously, considering that what Uncle Drew had just revealed were her last words when he killed her, they were inclined to believe that she was indeed her, and as a result, despite knowing she was merely a Dark Princess now, they raised their guard regardless.
They saw the horror of the Dark Empress, so they weren’t about to underestimate her.
When she spoke, they were further convinced.
"Night Riders." Her voice was calm, sweet, and somehow eerie.
"You know who we are?" Eryndor asked, his grip on his staff tightening. He had yet to summon a single Hellfiend since there was no need to.
With Yi Lai summoning her two dragon undead, the battle happening behind them was in perfect shape. However, now hearing the Dark Princess refer to them as Night Riders made him go on high alert.
"I can never forget the stench of my conquerors." The Dark Princess lifted her slender left leg and placed it on the right one, showing a tip of her black tail.
"I have been waiting for you people," she added, looking happy for some reason.
"Do you want to be conquered again? Is that why you are happy?" Saden asked, but what he received in return was a resounding laugh, tinged with mockery.
"Conquer me again?" Her laughter continued, making Saden and her friends frown. However, they knew something significant was afoot, and as such, they waited to get her laughter out of the way.

"First of all, you didn’t conquer me; I let myself be conquered. And second, while you 69 had proven to be the perfect counter for me, considering you are made from the same source as me, I have never truly feared you.

In a way, I merely allowed myself to fall into your hands. I engineered the battle so that you people would come. Thankfully, you did, and what I had envisioned came to pass. Now, I am free, and thanks to you, I can begin my conquest."

Standing on the outside, Uncle Drew, Vexthra, and the others frowned, hearing what the Dark Princess said. They clearly understood the meaning behind her words, and as such, they knew what she was implying.
They also seem to grasp the implication of what she was trying to say.
Of course, without them saying it, the Dark Princess revealed her master plan...
"I know you all are aware that I am the engineer behind the Dark Fiend species. I have the power to create Dark Fiends, and so you can even say I am the creator of the Dark Fiend race.
What you didn’t know, however, is that the Dark Fiend race isn’t a different creation; it is merely a way for me to extend my domain, making me more powerful.
I never intended to create anything. I merely wanted to grow my domain. All that you people call Dark Fiend, I merely see it as a manifestation of my domain, extending my powers and reach.

However, as to whether there is indeed a Dark Fiend, the answer is, of course, yes... There is only one Dark Fiend, and that is me. I am one of my kind, and as such, just like my domain, I can be in multiple places at once.

However, the reason why the Dark Fiend race came into existence was simple: so I could catch the attention of the Night Riders. I needed you to come and free me." She smiled, putting on a mocking expression.
Nara and the rest who heard what she said became puzzled, realisation dawning on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (6)
paragraphs: There was indeed a perfect scheme hidden behind what the Dark Princess said.

During the Dark Era, when the Dark Empress arrived in this known universe, she found out that her power as the Dark Fiend was restricted by an external force, one that she could wiggle her way out of on her own.
The restriction prevented her from separating her body into its various forms.
This brought down her power so much that she had to resort to using her domain to create Dark Fiends, or at least that was what they were called back then.

Later, during her unholy conquest, she found that the only way to lift the restriction was to fall to the sword of a particular person... The cure for her curse was to fall to the sword of one of the dangerous beings who dominated the dark era.
"Kael Duskbane, the captain of the Night Riders." The Dark Princess looked beyond Nara and her team, gazing back at Uncle Drew.

"You primitive people really are easy to manipulate. Back then, many of your people betrayed your kind for their own gain. While you Night Riders were fighting to save the ’universe’ from the Dark Creatures, some of your powerhouses were signing deals with us.
They were helping us advance and take as much as we could. They truly helped us, and in return, we helped them also.
So when they told me the way to break my restriction was to fall at your sword, I knew I had to face the Infamous Night Riders.
So I did, and in the end, I ended up dying. However, that also freed me, and now, I can be who I was meant to be, the Empress of the Dark Race."

Uncle Drew frowned deeper, and so did everyone. If what the Dark Princess was saying was to be taken seriously, then it meant all the battles and killings that happened during the Dark Era were all for nothing.

Sure, they killed a lot of Dark Creatures and saved many innocent lives. However, the main aim, which was to kill the Empress of the Dark Race, may have ended in failure if what she just said was to be believed.
"So you are the Empress, not the Seven-Headed Dark Lion."
"She was my sister who willingly sacrificed her life for the cause. I was the one you wanted. But it is too late now. Even if you kill this body, there are many scattered in the universe.
I will always come back stronger, and guess what, you won’t always be there to intervene. Not that you would be leaving here alive anyway..."
Nara, Saden, and Eryndor frowned. But they weren’t the only ones. Even Vexthra wore a frown, and so did Miryssa and Lene, who were far away in HolixCity but keeping an eye on things.
What the Dark Princess had just revealed changes everything.
If she had indeed returned like she claimed, seeing her alive now, even if in her basic form, then it meant the main seed was somewhere else.
But even worse, who knew how many seeds she had planted over the many years nobody had any idea she was alive.
The implications are just too much to even begin to consider. Nobody saw her coming, and even now, learning about it, they would have rather not.
But now that they had become aware of the return and the danger she posed, the next logical thing was to make plans. But first, they must handle this version of her before things get out of hand.

Nara drew both swords and pointed the right one at the Dark Princess, muttering coldly, "This doesn’t change anything. Regardless of who you are, as long as the Night Riders still draw breath, you will never know peace."
With that, she charged forward, and an arrow followed. But that wasn’t all—Eryndor stabbed his staff into the ground and manifested 12 flaming summoning gates.
From within, 12 Hellfiends stepped out, their bodies ablaze, and charged forward, meeting the 12 Dark Fiends in fierce combat.
"Saden, you and Eryndor should handle the Dark Fiends. I am going after her," Nara commanded, and Saden nodded.
"Be careful, there is something unsettling about her," Saden said, unleashing three powerful arrows at the same time, sending a Dark Fiend flying back.
It didn’t kill it, but it sure sent it flying...
"I will be fine." With that, Nara stepped into the darkness, and she was gone. The next second, the Dark Princess jumped back, a long sword cutting her throne in half.
A frown appeared on her pale face, along with a deadly whip appearing in her right hand. Her tail whipped back and forth, forcing her to create distance between them.
However, Nara didn’t allow her to move even a step. She threw one of her swords, aimed right at the Dark Princess’s heart.
She saw it coming and managed to evade. However, just when the sword was speeding past her, Nara appeared, her other sword cutting a deep wound into her chest.
Blood gushed out as she flew back, crashing into a small mountain.
This mountain used to be a playground for most of the children in the then-vibrant Lerma Village, but now it has become a battlefield.

The next second, the sword that had been aimed at her chest reappeared, its momentum unchanged. However, this time, the Dark Princess attacked with her whip, making sure she didn’t let it pass by her side again.
She saw what Nara did, and as such, she wouldn’t let her swap places with her sword again. However, she underestimated Nara’s combat intelligence.
Just when her whip formed a wind shield around the sword, Nara was ready for a kill move. She raised her sword, and darkness surged into it.
"Midnight Cut."
A green flame ignited around the sword, and when she slashed, a thin crescent arc made of pure darkness flashed out and blasted through the windshield.
The Dark Princess tried to dodge, but her hand wasn’t moved fast enough, resulting in a rather decisive cut—one that sent her left hand flying off her body.
"AAAARGH!"
She screamed, but that was cut short by a sudden barrage of sword arcs, each flying toward her with terrible speed and deadly intent.
In no time, the mountain came crashing down, and her body was littered with all kinds of cuts.
"Weak," Nara muttered and then, with a decisive slash, she took her head off—or at least tried to.
Just when her sword moved and was about to take her head off, the Dark Princess spoke...
"If I die, all the people infected by my dark energy would also die."
This made Nara pause, her expression turning ugly. However, as if there were no better time to hear Unity’s voice, her words echoed in her head.
"I can’t believe Yuyin is the reincarnation of the Goddess of Light."
"Die, bitch..." The Dark Princess’s eyes widened when she sensed her connection to the people she planned to use as her shield suddenly severed.
She lost her head in that instant, and within 5 minutes, the whole battle came to an end... However, the main mission didn’t end just there...
Kaizo and Krex are the key to ending the filth spread by the Dark Princess... or, more precisely, the filth spread by the Dark Empress.

chapters.title: Chapter 1316: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (7)
paragraphs: [Somewhere on Planet Gbogba - Kaizo and Krex]
The undead titan and the undying cockroach stood atop a small hill overlooking a dark building just 2 km away with calm expressions.
Around the building, cultivators dressed in black, with hoods covering their heads, moved to and fro, guarding the area.
Most of them were Spirit Sovereigns, with a few Spirit Lords. There were about 24 of them, each holding a weapon of their specialisation.
"Big sister Vexthra said we should kill them all, right?" Krex asked, a pair of curved swords appearing in his firm grip.
"Yes. She said these people nurtured the Dark Seed, so they must all be killed. We can’t allow even one of them to escape."
"Sounds cool to me. I was bored killing beasts that respawn anyway."
Kaizo turned and looked at Krex and grinned... "Same here. You should take those outside, and I will handle those inside the building. Can you handle that?"
"Stop looking down on me, Kaizo. Even if I can’t handle them, they can’t kill me either. After all, I am the..."
"Undying Cockroach," Kaizo smirked, and then his gauntlet appeared around his hand, and golden lightning started dancing around them.
"I will go boom, so take advantage of the Chaos."
Krex nodded.
"Here I come,"
The next second, as if he had been hurled into the air, Kaizo jumped high and, with a Superman punch, descended on the dark building, causing everyone to become alert.
The speed at which he came was too fast and destructive. Before any of them could make a move to stop him, he was already upon the building.
BOOM
He blasted through, sending a shockwave far and wide.
"So cool," Krex said with a smile before he vanished.
When he appeared, a Spirit Lord lost his head. However, that was just the start of a massacre where, unless a head came rolling down, Krex wouldn’t be happy.
Just a few years ago, he was a pawn his family was using to get to Lilian, who had a rather potent Spirit Root back then. They wanted to take her Spirit Root for their prodigy daughter.
Before the plan could bloom, however, Kent entered the scene. The two of them clashed, but instead of killing him, Kent spared him.
Killing him was pointless in his eyes, especially since he had no idea he was being used.
This encounter snapped him back to reality, so he chose to leave his own family... the same family that had given him the power of a young master.
Later, when Kent went to save Li Hua, he found him locked in the same prison dungeon. He saved him, and that was when his True Name manifested: Krex Nithal, the Undying Cockroach.
Now, he had joined the family of the Chaos Dragon, and thanks to the training received from his big brothers and sisters, he had now become a formidable warrior.
As he moved across the battlefield, blocking, countering, and beheading, one could tell he had become a warrior to be feared.
Meanwhile, inside the dark building, which had now lost its roof, Kaizo gazed coldly at the 7 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators surrounding him.
They each had their faces covered behind eerily looking masks, a clear sign that they were a cult. Their appearance sold them out.
"Who are you, and what do you want?" one of them asked, his tone laced with both fury and fear.
"You do not qualify to know who I am. Just know that I am here to deliver judgment..."
"Judgement on what crime?"
"Aiding and abetting the rise of the Dark Princess..."
Hearing Kaizo’s answer, the 7 hooded figures tried to make a run for it. However, they were too slow, considering they were facing Kaizo. He isn’t the fastest out there, yet he was faster than them.
"Lightning Domain." A net fashioned from lightning fell on the building, trapping them all. Kaizo smiled, and he moved, a terrifying fist landing on one of them.
He was blasted through the walls of the building, slamming into the lightning net. What followed was him getting burned by the overcharged power of Kaizo’s divine lightning.
The rest weren’t far behind.
In under ten minutes, they were groaning on the ground, their bodies burnt beyond recognition.
Even if Kaizo were to leave them now, it wouldn’t be long before all seven of them breathed their last breath.

However, he was sent here to make sure the Crow Cult was eradicated, so summoning a lightning spear, Kaizo did just as he was told. He drove it through their heads, ending their miserable existence for good.
By then, Krex had also ended his side of the battle, making sure every dead body had its head separated from its body.
"They were weaker than I thought," Krex said, looking at the mess Kaizo had made.
"Yeah. I expected them to put up a fight."
The two sneered, clearly disappointed. However, with the mission completed, they had no choice but to leave.

It took them a heartbeat to teleport their team back. After Nara ended the Dark Princess’s life, they all entered the village to search for the clues left behind for them, just like they did on the previous floors.
"How did it go?" Vexthra asked the moment Kaizo and Krex appeared.
"They’ve been wiped out, every last one of them. They reacted as you predicted."
"Good job."
Kaizo and Krex joined the search.
Vexthra, being a goddess, was able to track a foreign energy form in the village the moment she spread her god sense over it.

This foreign energy was not of the dark kind. It was mere spiritual qi, the same energy many cultivators used. So she tracked it, and from where it led, she knew the ones responsible for the birth of the Dark Princess were them.

This also meant the Dark Empress could not return to her true self without the help of others. However, to confirm, Vexthra made Kaizo and Krex handle them, and based on the outcome, she would know what to do next.
Now, hearing they reacted aggressively to the accusation that they aided the Dark Empress, she knew she was right all along.
"I guess the Dark Princess was right, the human mind is indeed easy to manipulate," Vexthra muttered, making Uncle Drew take a deep sigh.
"We have to get ahead of this. We cannot allow her to infest this universe, not when the Void Beasts and the Forsaken Race are still a threat."
"Where do you suppose we start from?"
Uncle Drew thought for a moment and replied, "We need to review the Dark records. Since some people betrayed this universe, we need to know more about the Dark War. We might find some clues there.
Though it would be extremely hard to get our hands on these records. The Cult of Wisdom wouldn’t just hand them to us... even if they know we are Night Riders."
Vexthra smiled and even giggled a little. "You have nothing to worry about. I know someone who can get it for us."
"Who?" Uncle Drew asked with his brow furrowed.
"Who else if not Kent. He had joined the Cult of Wisdom without even knowing it."
Uncle Drew smiled. "Why am I not surprised?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1317: The Fifth Floor - Haunted Village (8)
paragraphs: "So what happened when you got to Holix City?" Vexthra asked Unity. She was the one who led the team to Holix City to cure those afflicted by the dark infections inflicted on them by the Dark Princess.
Two hours after the battle ended, Unity and her sisters returned from Holix City with many stories to tell.
Apparently, when they arrived in Holix City, the villagers who had been transported there were being attended to by normal healers.
The pope, who had ordered his guards to bring them there, was nowhere to be found. He only had them bring in the injured and left them without proper healing.
So Unity instructed Elaina, Adina, and Runa to start healing them. Some of their sisters joined in, doing their best to help in any way they could.
After making sure they had a handle on things, Unity, alongside Yuyin, Mara, Camilla, and Ingrid, made their way to the Church of Light, where the supposed pope lived.
It turned out he merely used the village’s rescue as a stunt to win votes in the upcoming reelection.
From the little Unity gathered, the church had become divided when the former pope ascended to the immortal world.
The rightful pope to inherit him was conspired against and nearly killed. The one currently handling church matters was merely a usurper; he wasn’t the right fit for the role.
Of course, from what they gathered along the way, whenever a pope is sworn in, the divine power of the Goddess of Light is bestowed upon them.
Because of this divine authority, despite knowing he wasn’t the right fit, going against him was also not something they could do. So he had been ruling for 4,995 years now.
In five years, there would be an election to select a new pope after the church of light in the immortal realm intervened in the effort to bring peace.
Because of this, he had been doing damage control, and this current stunt was merely to appear benevolent in the eyes of the masses.
After rescuing as many as they could, they merely transported them to the city, only to dump them in a rather poorly maintained healing camp.
Unity and her sisters were pissed, so when they reached the Church of Light, they didn’t even wait to be allowed entry. They blasted the gates open and walked in like they owned the place.

A fierce confrontation took place, but the ladies quickly subdued them. However, the pope, with his divine light blessing, tried to use that against them. Naturally, none of them would have been able to withstand that.
However, the Pope’s decision to unleash the holy light of the goddess of light caused a shocking scene.

Just when the pope unleashed his blessing, Yuyin’s true nature awakened. It turned out she was once the Goddess of Light, the same legendary goddess whose light shone during the dark hours of the Great Dark War.
Even long after she died, she remains one of the most respected goddesses in the universe.

Although the power she received from her awakening was only temporary, it allowed her to strip the pope of his authority and heal the injured villagers, as well as the guards who fought against the Dark Fiends.

Thanks to her, Nara was able to kill the Dark Princess just when she tried to use the lives of the villagers to threaten her. Her awakening prevented a grave disaster, the kind that nobody saw coming.
"Looks like you had a wild run," Vexthra said, turning to Yuyin, who merely smiled. On her forehead now, the tattoo of a lamp could be seen.
Deep within her soul, the divine light that had given hope to many warriors began to burn.
"I guess I was at the right place at the right time."

Vexthra smiled and shook her head. "Say what you want, but know that the Goddess of Light is a legend in the God Realm. No god, whether from the Righteous, Devil, or Neutral faction, would dare disrespect her name or statue.
Her temple is still standing, and the millions of Church of Light still pray to her. Her divinity still holds supreme power over light.
So when you become a god, which I know you will, be ready to resume your role as the Goddess of Light. Trust me, you have a lot to do."

Vexthra paused and smiled. Long before she met Kent, the goddess of light was one of the few gods she liked. Even though she was dead, her light still burned deep within her dark heart. So learning that her soon-to-be sister was her reincarnation brought her joy.

She turned and looked at Unity before continuing, "Aside from the Goddess of Love, the goddess of light was one of the most respected, loved and liked gods to ever live... she still is, so be happy with yourself."
"Yeah, be happy, Yuyin. Once Kent is back and he awakens your True Names, you will start recovering all your memories."
The ladies nodded, giving her all the support and encouragement she needed.
While that was happening, Selene sneakily moved and stood beside Miryssa, her hand resting on her shoulder.
"I know what you are wondering..." she said, making Miryssa look at her.
"What am I thinking?"
"You are wondering if you also have a True Name."
Miryssa opened her mouth to speak, but no words came out. That was because Selene hit the nail right on the head. She indeed was wondering that.
Although she is a Universal God, spending these past weeks with Vexthra and her sisters has made her have many thoughts she never thought she would one day have.
One of them was their True Names.
She learned that they all had True Names, and while all gods can be said to have True Names since their divinity comes with a unique name, the True Names invoked by Kent were completely different.
She saw what the True Name did to Adina when Kent invoked it. So she couldn’t help wondering if she also had the same True Name.

Selene chuckled. "I cannot tell you plainly if you have a True Name. But what I can say is, all those invited to the Harem Tower end up having one, so be ready to strip and spread those legs when the time comes."

And of course, Selene couldn’t end a sentence without making her true intentions known. Miryssa blushed and ran from her, making sure the gap between them was wide enough to unhear more of her shameless words.
Unfortunately, Selene was not easily discouraged.
After a few more talks, the ladies joined the legions and started looking for the hidden clues that they mostly searched for after clearing any floor of the dungeon.
Later, they would return to the Church of Light to see if they could find something there, too, before ascending to the 6th floor.
[First Floor of the Void Temple]
Ten days later, Gaap had recovered his spent energy. Kent had also explored the entire first floor, and what he found made him super happy.
It turned out the void flame was indeed a high-grade Primordial Flame. He found the source where, if he wanted to form his next flame core, he could cultivate it.
The only thing left now was for him to clear the entire temple and find other flame-rich treasures and add them to this vast flame source.
"Are you ready?" Kent asked, looking at Gaap with a smile.
"More than ready."
"Good. Be prepared, we might get ambushed this time around."
Gaap transformed into his sword form and flew into Kent’s firm grip. He took a deep breath. Then, looking up, he flew toward the portal in the air.

The pope, who had ordered his guards to bring them there, was nowhere to be found.
He only had them bring in the injured and left them without proper healing.

The one currently handling church matters was merely a usurper; he wasn’t the right fit for the role.

Even long after she died, she remains one of the most respected goddesses in the universe.

"Say what you want, but know that the Goddess of Light is a legend in the God Realm.

Her divinity still holds supreme power over light.

Trust me, you have a lot to do."

Even though she was dead, her light still burned deep within her dark heart.
So learning that her soon-to-be sister was her reincarnation brought her joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1318: Nyssara Noctveil
paragraphs: While the first floor was made of fire and heat, the second floor was surprisingly quiet and foggy.
The moment Kent arrived there through the portal, he felt like he had fallen into the domain of darkness.
There was mist everywhere, and the air was humid and dull.

Without the soul map, when Kent tried to sense around him, he found out that his divine sense was severely restricted. He could sense only the immediate 10 meters around, a far cry from the 10,000km he could even do without a soul map.
This was something he could not accept, so he activated the soul map.

However, to his shock, he could only sense a 5 km radius, something that shook him greatly. Looking at the nature of the place he had appeared in and the fact that his senses had been cut by that much showed he was in for a wild ride.
"This is clearly the domain of an assassin," Kent muttered, observing the space around him.
Of course, he didn’t need the Tower telling him this is the domain of an assassin. Everything could be seen from the various shadows, foggy mist, and the smoke rising everywhere.
Dude to this, his guard was up and ready for anything.
Suddenly, Kent slashed his sword back, meeting a dagger.
CLANG
Kent was pushed back, a vivid sigh that the attack wasn’t simple at all.
However, before he could discern the nature of the dagger that came at him, it vanished, and thousands of pointed ropes formed from solid shadows shot at him from all directions.
"The fuck."
Before Kent could even begin to defend, the dagger appeared again, catching him off guard.
’Fuck, I only saw that dagger come when it was within the 100-meter radius,’ Kent said inwardly, his expression turning ugly.
The fact that, despite being severely restricted, his soul map could still see a 5 km radius was a good thing in this situation.
However, as it turned out, the incoming dagger attacks were being missed even within a 5 km radius. Kent only sensed the attack coming when it was 100 meters away.
While to most that could be considered a wide enough radius, to someone like Kent, who was using 70,000 flame veins, the speed at which the attack was coming still caught him by surprise, says a lot.

The first attack was slower than the second. And now that he had pushed that attack back and started evading the ropes that seemed to have a life of their own, Kent knew that this battle would be fought with speed and extreme awareness.

Kent jumped over a rope only for three more to swerve overhead and stab at his chest. However, while he was restricted, his soul map still had the teleport function, so he used it and teleported away.
But just when he appeared 3 km away, the dagger came again.
This time, however, Kent was prepared.
"FREEZE."
He stomped on the ground, freezing it solid. This caused a powerful freezing shockwave to push outward, sending anything solid back, at least to some extent, or freezing them.
Of course, Kent’s main aim was to freeze the person behind the dagger.

However, to his shock, there was nobody there. In fact, while his intention was to reveal the shape of the person even if they were invisible, after the ice shockwave exploded out, only the daggers—which he was shocked to find were fashioned from shadows—remained frozen.
"Don’t tell me..."
Before Kent could end his words, three daggers appeared again, and this time with greater force and speed.
It turned out the person he was facing wasn’t attacking him directly. In fact, the person was merely using the shadows to forge the daggers and then attack with them through mind control.
Kent didnt know where the attacker was, and since his senses were restricted to only a 5 km radius, he was practically blind.
But even worse, while he wasn’t seeing the daggers coming from 5 km away, he couldn’t help wondering whether the person was within his coverage area.
For all he knew, the person may be standing 400 meters away, but their presence wasn’t registering in the soul map.
Kent frowned but kept dodging the daggers and the ropes coming at him while he slowly worked his way to figuring out who was behind it all.

Soon, 40 minutes passed, but aside from him fighting with a bunch of ropes and daggers that only seemed to grow faster and stronger by the second, he was making no progress in finding who was behind the attacks.

Kent came up with many ways to flush out the real attacker; however, even after implementing the strongest of them, which was to explode his ice within a 5 km radius or to unleash a bunch of soul spirits, he still couldn’t get the attacker.
This left him in a bind.

His only option was to use his sharp tongue to taunt them into revealing themselves. After evading a bunch of deadly shadow ropes and blocking three daggers that came in rapid succession, he finally made his move.
"I know you are an assassin who thrives in the darkness and shadows; however, I never pegged an immortal like you to be afraid of me to the point of even hiding in the shadows like a rat."
Kent made his first move, and after 2 minutes, he saw it wasn’t enough to flush out the attacker. This made him smile weakly.
"At least you are helping me shape my focus and reaction speed, so this is also good. It is like a training, only that at the end of the day, you are going to die by my hand."
Kent indeed was having a good training session. While he could use the [Jade Void Wings] to move much faster and deadlier, he realised reaction speed had nothing to do with actual agility.
To be able to sense a dagger at close range and still react to counter requires some higher form of awareness, one that he was slowly sharpening in this battle.
The attacker seemed to be fast. However, their speed seemed to stem from their elusiveness. That was helping them move at terrible speeds and attack much more strongly.
They are really good at hiding.
However, while Kent would love to keep playing this cat-and-mouse game, exactly one hour into the battle, he saw what the person was aiming at.
All of a sudden, the dagger attack increased greatly, their speed becoming much more explosive. This change, however, brought back a memory from the primordial era.

"During the Primordial Era, on one fateful afternoon, I happened to walk into a Void Temple to clear it like the hundreds I have cleared before. I, of course, knew killing Void Beasts was my passion, so I took the mission seriously.
On the first 4 floors, I met brutes who just couldn’t keep their lives for a minute. However, on the 5th floor, I met an elusive shadow who managed to last one hour and 4 minutes.
She was just like you. She was full of hope and dreams, until the one hour came. That was when I realised I was inside her domain all along."
Kent’s body surged with sword intent, and his sword bathed in sword aura... "It took me 4 minutes to develop a counter for her. When I did, she died in under a second"
Turning to a random direction, Kent unleashed a Void Cleave instantly, causing the entire domain to tremble.
A few seconds later, it crumbeld and his opponent was revealed.
Nyssara Noctveil, the second Temple Master of Shadows, was revealed, her gaze cold like ice.
