chapters.title: Chapter 1319: Beheaded
paragraphs: The face that met Kent was that of a hooded female figure clad in what appeared to be a living void armour. This can be seen from the shifting patterns in her armour. Only living armours can shift and make modifications like that.

Kent cannot see her face, considering it is covered behind a dark mask. However, even with that, Kent knew she held a cold look in her eyes simply from how crimson they are, glowing through the slits of her mask.
’She is a dangerous one.’
[Yes, Master. She is indeed a danger if you become careless.]
Kent narrowed his expression when he sensed her presence erasing itself as she stood there gazing back at him. It was like the more he stared at her, the more she ceased to exist.
[Her aura shows she is a Spirit Immortal with two immortal qi. However, there is something about her that even I can’t sense, and that is making me feel there is a hidden danger to her.]
’Same here. But I am ready for anything. Now that I can see her, what remains is to kill her.’ Kent lifted Gaap and pointed toward the assassin lady who held two daggers in her firm grip.
"You were a sport for the past hour. However, you must die now."
She kept quiet and kept looking at Kent. Suddenly, Kent jumped back, evading a stabbing attack that came from behind him.

The past 1 hour hadn’t been for nothing. His senses had sharpened, and thanks to that, he sensed the attack and dodged better than he would have 1 hour ago. Just then, two more versions of the assassin lady appeared and charged at him.

All three of them move at the same speed, each radiating the same energy signature. This meant they were all the same person, and judging by the speed at which they moved and how perfectly they coordinated their attacks, Kent knew this was her battle style.
She had probably trained for years to be this good with three bodies.

"Interesting, I never expected you to be this good in close combat." Kent deflected a sweeping attack and sidestepped, evading a stabbing attack. Just then, another stabbing attack came from the third clone.
He kicks back, his leg meeting the flat end of a dagger aimed at his back. Using the momentum, he moved his left hand, gently deflecting a sudden attack that came from overhead.
However, before he could make a move back, a second dagger came from nowhere, aiming for his neck.
"Hahahaha... This is awesome," Kent laughed, feeling the thrill of the battle getting to him. It had been a long time since he had this much intense close combat with anyone.
During his life as Lord Genesis, he was known for his close combat skills. During that time, in the entire universe, there was no one better than him when it came to close combat.
He always wins all close combats simply because he has mastered all 1.6 million moves an attacker could make. Regardless of how complex the attack is, he would always have a counter.

In the universe, there are only 1.6 million variations of attacking moves that a person could make. Regardless of how complex the move is, its foundation came from the 1.6 million battle movement styles.
Jest had mastered all 1.6 million.

And Kent inherited that intelligence in this life, and as such, he was enjoying this battle. The assassin lady, in her three cloned forms, is giving him a good fight... so much so that he’s starting to feel like his old self again.
However, while he would love to keep up with this battle, he knew clearing all 5 floors of the void temple was the mission, so he had to end this.

Naturally, he never planned on keeping this long in the battle, but the thrill of the close combat got to him. Now, all he can do is hope one day he will meet someone worthy of facing him in an intense close combat.
"Too bad you are a void beast. While I don’t hate you like I hate the Forsaken Race, you are still my enemy, so why don’t we end this here?"
BUZZ
The moment Kent said that, the jade void wings appeared on his back, and his speed surged. At one point, he saw everything slow down, including the assassin lady.
’Too slow, I suppose.’
The moment he saw her slow down, Kent moved, and the outcome was decided with the three successive attacks he unleashed.
Three heads flew into the air and thudded on the ground, bringing an end to a good battle. The moment his speed dwarfed hers, the fight was over.
"Surprisingly, Spirit Immortals aren’t much of a threat," Kent said with a smile. The next second, his hand moved and stabbed his sword backwards.
From thin air, the assassin lady was revealed, hanging limp off Kent’s sword, blood drooling from the corner of her mouth.
"You clearly underestimated me, young lady. Or you thought I wouldn’t sense your scheme," Kent chuckled and twisted his sword, shredding her heart.
"H-How?" Even in death, she seemed to want to know how Kent saw through her perfect ambush. It was an ambush that would have caught many off guard.
Seh had used it many times, and every time she killed her opponent.
Basically, while Tower and Kent saw two immortal qi, she had three. That thing they both felt was wrong with her was her third immortal qi, which she hid inside the void.
On the outside, she manifested two clones using her immortal qi, so perfect that it fooled even Kent and Tower for a few minutes.

But when he caught on, he saw she was merely two clones and a real body — her real body. She may have good control of her immortal qi, but that doesn’t mean a body created from immortal qi can have the same feel as a real body.
Kent saw through her, and so he quickly sensed the anomaly when he activated the void wings and beheaded her.
This prompted him to be on his guard since the bodies on the floor were 3 immortal qi instead of two and a real body.

The real body swapped places with the clone hidden inside the void. All he had to do was wait and pretend he had no idea what she had cooked. With the void wings on, the moment there was a disturbance related to the void, he sensed it.
The moment she appeared, Kent made his move, and it was perfect.
Kent pointed at his reddish gold eyes and chuckled, "You would have seen through your own disguise if you had the Heavenly Jade Eyes."
With that, Kent pulled out his sword and let her fall on the ground. His Heavenly Jade Eye helped him see through the disguise put on by the assassin lady.
While she managed to elude his senses, she couldn’t evade his eyes. After a few adjustments, Kent saw her immortal qi bodies.
This also shows she was no simple person. Kent got lucky this time and also received a good lesson in what immortal qi is capable of when used to its full potential.
A few seconds later, the kill message appeared. However, this time, there was a third message, one that made Kent furrow his brow.
[You have killed the second temple master, Nyssara Noctveil]
[You have received the second temple Key.]
[You have obtained a Soul Warrior Candidate]

And Kent inherited that intelligence in this life, and as such, he was enjoying this battle.
The assassin lady, in her three cloned forms, is giving him a good fight... so much so that he’s starting to feel like his old self again.
However, while he would love to keep up with this battle, he knew clearing all 5 floors of the void temple was the mission, so he had to end this.
Naturally, he never planned on keeping this long in the battle, but the thrill of the close combat got to him.
Now, all he can do is hope one day he will meet someone worthy of facing him in an intense close combat.
"Too bad you are a void beast.
While I don’t hate you like I hate the Forsaken Race, you are still my enemy, so why don’t we end this here?"
BUZZ
The moment Kent said that, the jade void wings appeared on his back, and his speed surged.
At one point, he saw everything slow down, including the assassin lady.
’Too slow, I suppose.’
The moment he saw her slow down, Kent moved, and the outcome was decided with the three successive attacks he unleashed.
Three heads flew into the air and thudded on the ground, bringing an end to a good battle.
The moment his speed dwarfed hers, the fight was over.
"Surprisingly, Spirit Immortals aren’t much of a threat," Kent said with a smile.
The next second, his hand moved and stabbed his sword backwards.
From thin air, the assassin lady was revealed, hanging limp off Kent’s sword, blood drooling from the corner of her mouth.
"You clearly underestimated me, young lady.
Or you thought I wouldn’t sense your scheme," Kent chuckled and twisted his sword, shredding her heart.
"H-How?" Even in death, she seemed to want to know how Kent saw through her perfect ambush.
It was an ambush that would have caught many off guard.
Seh had used it many times, and every time she killed her opponent.
Basically, while Tower and Kent saw two immortal qi, she had three.
That thing they both felt was wrong with her was her third immortal qi, which she hid inside the void.
On the outside, she manifested two clones using her immortal qi, so perfect that it fooled even Kent and Tower for a few minutes.
But when he caught on, he saw she was merely two clones and a real body — her real body.
She may have good control of her immortal qi, but that doesn’t mean a body created from immortal qi can have the same feel as a real body.
Kent saw through her, and so he quickly sensed the anomaly when he activated the void wings and beheaded her.
This prompted him to be on his guard since the bodies on the floor were 3 immortal qi instead of two and a real body.
The real body swapped places with the clone hidden inside the void.
All he had to do was wait and pretend he had no idea what she had cooked.
With the void wings on, the moment there was a disturbance related to the void, he sensed it.
The moment she appeared, Kent made his move, and it was perfect.
Kent pointed at his reddish gold eyes and chuckled, "You would have seen through your own disguise if you had the Heavenly Jade Eyes."
With that, Kent pulled out his sword and let her fall on the ground.
His Heavenly Jade Eye helped him see through the disguise put on by the assassin lady.
While she managed to elude his senses, she couldn’t evade his eyes.
After a few adjustments, Kent saw her immortal qi bodies.
This also shows she was no simple person.
Kent got lucky this time and also received a good lesson in what immortal qi is capable of when used to its full potential.
A few seconds later, the kill message appeared.
However, this time, there was a third message, one that made Kent furrow his brow.
[You have killed the second temple master, Nyssara Noctveil]
[You have received the second temple Key.]
[You have obtained a Soul Warrior Candidate]

chapters.title: Chapter 1320: Obsidian Void Stones
paragraphs: Kent appeared inside his soul universe and quickly made his way toward the millions of soul spirits he had farmed in the massacre he committed a couple of weeks ago.
Killing an entire forest of beasts gave him millions of soul spirits that he can use to create weapons and other things.
When he arrived, Calix, his first soul warrior, was in seclusion inside a cave he had forged using soul spirits. It seems he had reached the bottleneck to break through to the realm of Root Immortal.
He didn’t want to disturb him since Calix becoming an immortal would help him soon.
Kent focused on the sea of soul spirits and began searching for the soul spirit of Nyssara, the second-floor temple master he had just killed.
From the message he received, he learned he had obtained a second soul warrior candidate. It was unexpected, considering this was the first time he had received such a message.
When he created Calix, he found out that despite having half a million soul spirits back then, only one qualified to become a soul warrior.
This was because of a golden core within the person’s soul spirit. He was the only one who had that golden core.
So when he used the soul warrior skill on him, he became the first soul warrior, a rather powerful warrior that Kent is counting on in the battles to come.

While he seems to be having a free run with the temple masters, he still has one major battle ahead of him that he would need all the strength he could muster, so having capable warriors with special aspects is perfect.

After a few minutes of looking around, he spotted her standing at the far back, her cold gaze fixed on him. If not because Kent sensed a chilling killing intent aimed at him, he wouldn’t have seen her this quickly.
However, it seems even in death she still hates him, and that could be reflected in how intense her gaze was.
"I mean, I did kill her, so the hate in her gaze is warranted." Kent smiles, "But it is a little silly to hold on to your anger and hatred even in death. You lost fair and square"

Kent summoned her, and she had no choice but to come. Inside the soul universe, Kent’s authority is undisputed. Even if he were to kill a celestial today, even if by sheer luck, they would have no choice but to heed his commands in their soul spirit form.
The moment he had a clear view of her, his focus landed on the golden core inside her body. Kent paid more attention to it, hoping to see the core more clearly.
He saw that Calix only had a golden core, and that was all. It was plain, circular and had only a few veins. However, Nyssara’s own had some runes on it — three to be exact.
"Hmmm," Kent used his hand to brush his hair, a suspicious look appearing on his face. He looked up and met Nyssara’s gaze.
"Hmm, strange." Kent walked slowly around her, making sure he took in everything about her. After two good minutes scrutinising her, Kent walked back.
It was like the more he scrutinised her, the more her intent to kill him intensified. She really hates him.
"Can you speak?" Kent asked, but no voice came from behind the mask she was wearing. Of course, even after a whole minute, she said nothing.
Clearly, she either can’t speak now or she can’t speak at all. Either way, Kent was happy he had found a suitable candidate to use in creating his second soul warrior.
"Although you were a Void Beast, when I am done with you, your past will be wiped, and your future as a Soul Warrior will begin. Be grateful you will finally have a life worth living."
Kent activated the [Soul Warrior] ability, and despite the hate and intensity in her eyes, the soul warrior creation process took hold of her.
Thousands of soul spirits started turning to orbs, entering her body. Soon, a cocoon was formed around her.
The next time she is revealed, she will become a terrifying soul warrior, one who can give Kent a good fight.
⟦Soul Warrior Transformation Process Started. Duration: 30 Days⟧
Kent said nothing and just exited his soul universe. He had already started the process, so the next step is to focus on the mission ahead.
He still has three temple masters to kill after all.

When he opened his eyes on the outside, he saw that Gaap was not around... Upon reaching out, he found out he was looking around the second floor to determine whether the shadows and darkness had a source.
There was a flame source on the first floor, so there is bound to be something else here, too. After all, this floor is made of shadows and darkness.
Kent stored away the dead body but took her storage pouch.
"Looks like the Void Beast Race still uses storage pouches instead of space rings," Kent said before looking into it. He was, after all, excited to see what this temple master had for him.
"Oh... what are these?"
Kent brought out three obsidian head-sized stones. His Heavenly Jade Eye scanned them and fed the information to the tower.
[Obsidian Void Stones]
[Grade: Immortal]
[Tier: Peak]
[Description: A condensed form of void essence transformed into obsidian rock. Useful for enhancing void energy and forging void-related weapons/treasures.]
"I don’t really have a use for them yet. However, when I gain void affinity, I am sure they will come in handy." Kent stored the three stones inside his space ring.
He is neither a blacksmith nor a void user at the moment, so he can only put them away. They will have their use when the time is right.
"Guess the talisman was something only the first-floor temple master had." Aside from the three void stones, there was nothing else in the pouch.

While disappointed that the first-floor boss had three different types of items, while this had only one, Kent became more relaxed, knowing his worry about the talisman he found in the first-floor temple master’s pouch might be unnecessary.
Since the second-floor temple master doesn’t have a talisman, it means the chances of the others having it are next to none.
After a few more hours, Gaap returned with good news.
Just like with the first floor, where there flame source, this floor has a darkness source where anyone with a darkness affinity can cultivate.
Kent has a Darkness elemental affinity. However, unlike his flame and ice elements, which had awakened, the darkness element remains dormant, just like his lightning element.
However, if he were to cultivate it inside the source of darkness, then there is a chance he might be able to awaken it and even evolve it to the Absolute stage.
Elemental source is extremely valuable in the universe. Any element source can be considered a universe-level treasure. However, they are rare to find.
Even in the immortal worlds, when a source has been discovered, thousands fight over it. Now, it seems Kent had secured not one, but two elemental sources.
"I suppose this is my good fortune. But I cant but wonder if the Void Beasts are this wealthy. I mean, an elemental source being used as a floor in a void temple. Isn’t that too much?"
Gaap transformed into his sword form, and Kent took hold of him. He gazed at the portal to the third floor and smiled.
Soon, he was gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1321: Kaelthar Bloodbound
paragraphs: BANG BOOM CRASH

Kent was thrown back, crashing through a rather large rock. It was blasted into several bits and pieces. However, before he could stabilise himself, a terrible sabre, chained in blood and radiating intense bloodlust, arrived before him, aiming to break every bone in his body.
However, Kent braced with his sword and, gathering momentum, he hurled his body backwards, flipping countless times like an overqualified athlete.
The chain missed him but struck the sword, causing it to release a furious shout.

"Bastard, you are dead," Gaap vibrated, asking to be freed so he could teach the demon who attacked him a lesson or two. However, Kent held on and, using the soul map, he teleported, appearing several km away.
This gave him a breather to process this.
He had just arrived on the 3rd floor of the Void Temple when a dangerous-looking chain came out of nowhere, slamming into his body.
Naturally, he didn’t see that coming, considering he never expected the temple masters to be this shameless, attacking when he hadn’t yet walked through the door.
Of course, during the primordial era, he had encountered many such behaviours from the temple masters. Some loved to grave-camp, killing just as the challenger walked through the portal.
However, Kent also knew the portal opens at random intervals and at random places, and as such, not all of them can see or sense it before they can camp and wait.
So the fact that this temple master sensed him and attacked just as he arrived means he has a rather vast domain, one that allowed him to sense a wide area.
"Relax, Gaap, we will get him," Kent said, narrowing his gaze at the tall, demonic-looking man staring at him.

He is a horned humanoid with crimson energy coursing through his body. His skin, from the look of things, is hard like metal and probably has some defects that make it shift from brown to red every few seconds.
Around his waist, across his chest and dangling from his arm is a thick chain, one that seems to be made from blood. It is both dark and red, filled with so much power.
"You look ugly, bro," Gaap shouted, making Kent grin.
For Gaap to call someone ugly, it means they are indeed ugly. He himself is the ugliest as they come, so referring to someone as ugly is the last thing he should even say.
But since he said it, it’s probably true.
"He is right, though. You really are one ugly motherfucker. Killing you will be doing the universe a favour."

Kent didn’t know if the poor bastard understood the language they were speaking. It would be a shame if he didn’t get even a word they had just said. So to increase his shamelessness and make sure their taunts, yet factual words, are conveyed, he switched to the language all void beasts understood.
He switched to Aelthryn.
"What my companion and I were trying to say was that you are ugly and that you should just drop dead and do the universe a favour."
This time, the muscles on his face twitched, showing that the words struck a chord deep in his heart. His chains glowed red, and his Spirit Immortal strength flared, showing his three immortal qis.
Kent smirked and pointed his demonic sword at him, "I have killed worse, so come at me, you ugly motherfucker, your mama might have been disappointed giving birth to you."
As if Kent’s words had struck a deep wound, the third temple master, whose name came out empty even for the tower, attacked, manifesting a very large chain and hurling it at Kent.
It filled the entire air, extending and widening to several meters.
However, Kent merely made a casual slashing motion, and a thin arc exploded out, slicing through the chain like it was made of paper.
"Weak. If I were you, I would put some effort into actually trying to make me consider taking you seriously."
The temple master became even more enraged and started attacking even more aggressively. The more he attacked, the more enraged he became.
Perhaps because Kent was blocking all his attacks so effortlessly, he became super pissed. However, if he truly knew what was going through Kent’s mind, he would have exploded from sheer anger.
The more he attacked, the more it became plain to him that he wasn’t fighting someone at his level. Kent is far beyond his level.

Kent merely summoned 10,000 blood runes and used them to create a shield around him, and regardless of how powerful the temple master’s attacks were, it was like his shield was made of the strongest metal.
Even when he put in so much effort, adding all three immortal qis, he never even came close to creating a dent in the shield.

He is the bona fide master of the 3rd floor of the Void Temple. Many feared him simply because of his control over blood and the fact that his path, which is the slaughter path, made him very dangerous.

However, even with all that, he still couldn’t break the shield of someone who is far from becoming an immortal. He is a Spirit Immortal, someone five realms above Kent, yet a simple translucent red shield is holding him back.

After 30 minutes, Kent merely sighed and spoke using Aelthryn, "You clearly lack knowledge in the path you are walking. If you had paid enough attention to my shield, you would have known it came from the same source as you.

Yes, the shield is made from blood. Of course, while you can break any shield if you are strong enough, this particular shield is made from the True Blood Source, and as such, it is indestructible when used against someone wielding blood as their source of power.
All you just did was basically make my shield become much stronger. It took your kinetic energy from the continuous barrage you rained on the shield, which I have collected and stored in this sword.
This energy, of course, will be used to hurt you really badly. So, in simple terms, I will be using your own strength against you."
Kent deactivated the shield, and what followed were devastating sword slashes, the kind that filled the air with dozens of sword arcs.
The poor temple master, who may have just realised the blood path isn’t as simple as he thought, found himself bombarded by Kent’s endless sword attacks.
In no time, his entire body was littered with wounds, blood flowing like a fountain. Kent stopped and let the poor demon catch his breath.
When he started to recover, he resumed. The poor guy ran, attempting to be out of reach of the attacks. However, he quickly found out that Kent is much faster than he is.
In the end, after 2 hours of unrelenting attacks, he succumbed, dying in a pool of blood. He had tried really hard to hold on from dying, but Kent showed no mercy.
He knew the Void Beasts would never show anyone mercy, so he merely followed their principle.
[You have killed the third temple master, Kaelthar Bloodbound]
[You have received the third temple Key.]
Upon his death, Kent again decided to see what the bastard had in his pouch.
"Bastard, he had no pouch on him."
Kent stored away his body and started to look around to see if he would find the blood source.

chapters.title: Chapter 1322: Pissed
paragraphs: Kent became furious after discovering that the 3rd temple master had no storage pouch on him, unlike the last two he had faced. Clearly, he never expected him to be this broke.
This pisses him off.
’Did he destroy his pouch and its contents before I arrived?’ Kent thought, trying to make sense of why the third temple master had no storage pouch.
It doesn’t make sense that he wouldn’t have such a valuable item. Even worse, he never expected him to actually destroy his storage pouch.

Naturally, such an item contains his valuables, so destroying it means losing everything. Obviously, he, as a Spirit Immortal, wouldn’t go to that extreme when he believed himself to possess the power to kill Kent.
What if, after he killed him, he had already destroyed his treasures?
That would be too stupid, and he knew that.

So the only logical explanation was that he had no treasure on him, and as such, he had no need for a storage pouch. But if that is indeed the case, then not only had he really walked into battle unprepared, but he actually had confidence he would win.
He saw no need to have a treasure on him aside from his chains and his own true strength. That is a lot to consider.
"I am happy I used him as a scapegoat to teach the last two remaining Temple masters that I am not to be messed with. He served his purpose at least," Kent said, flying around the third floor.
Gaap transformed into his demonic humanoid form, flying beside him.

"So that was the reason why you made him recover only to be beaten up over and over again," Gaap asked, feeling happy he got to vent his frustration from the earlier chain attack that Kent used him to block.

"Yeah, I did. He and the others are just too weak to make me flinch, so I sent a message making them aware that, regardless of their resistance, I will be able to kill them. It would be better if they just allowed me to behead them and be done with things."
Saturating his cores had given him the confidence he lacked when he learned he would be challenging the void temple. He never, for one moment, saw himself as worthy of braving such a challenge.
However, now, he seems much more eager to face them, knowing that if he puts his all into it, none of them would come close to challenging him.
He is just too strong for them.

The blood runes he had awakened are just too overpowered. Applying them to his attacks had boosted the damage output by so much that even a Spirit Immortal with three immortal rings couldn’t handle it.
"I just hope the 4th temple master would be able to put up a fight," Kent smirked and continued to look around.
[Core of the Universe]

Lady Universe, the Enchantress, Fate, Destiny and Karma were left stunned after watching Kent’s last two battles. The first battle was an easy win for him. However, they at least expected him to face some resistance from the second and third temple masters.
However, from what they’ve seen so far, he seems to be doing better than one would expect.
He had only recently become a Peak Heavenly Ascension stage warrior. So, regardless of how monstrous a person is, they shouldn’t have the power to fight immortals.

Yet Kent did, and from the look of things, he had accumulated so much power that they were not even aware of it. Of course, they aren’t aware of everything about him; however, they never expected him to win the battles this easily.
"Looks like somebody would be crying blood soon", Destiny teased, looking subtly in the direction of Karma. She is probably happier than shocked to see how domineering Kent is.
She and Karma are always on the neck of each other, so this felt like the best gift she could ever receive. Making Karma feel miserable and angry is her passion.
"Looks like we truly looked down on him. It seems he is much more powerful than he was during the primordial era," Lady Universe said, sounding both happy and a little sad.
She is happy to see Kent succeed. However, she is very sad simply because it was her decision to play a game with Chaos that lad led to this very moment.
Kent’s life is tied to the universe, so, regardless of what he wants, he would be forced to rise to the occasion when the danger finally arrives.
So her sadness stemmed from her decision to make Kent the centre of the Universe.

"Does this mean he is much stronger than a Spirit Immortal?" Destiny asked, unsure of an answer. If this were someone other than Kent, she would have had an answer to her question. But Kent is an anomaly.
"He isn’t stronger than Spirit Immortals, he just hasn’t met his match yet," Karma of all cosmic beings answered, making Destiny smirk and turn away.

"Karma is correct. There are many powerful beings out there that can easily make him powerless. However, that also doesn’t mean he isn’t powerful." Fate said, and both Lady Universe and the Enchantress nodded.
There are indeed powerful beings out there.
"Of course, if he were to become an Immortal himself, then perhaps his dominance would be on a whole different level", Fate suddenly added. But he wasnt done...

"The reason why he would be powerless before some immortals is due to the Immortal Qi he cannot harness. We both know Immortal qi is something only immortals can wield, so if he were to meet someone who has a much deeper understanding of Immortal qi, then he would be in danger.
A typical example was himself during the primordial Era. You all saw how he wielded the immortal Qi in combat. Even I was stunned by how flawlessly he handled that.
So you can imagine just how that would translate this time around if he were to meet someone who is even half as good as the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
His explaination seem to put things in order. The mere fact that Kent is having a good run can end at any moment when he meets someone who knows what they are doing.

"yeah well, I have all the faith in him, and I am sure he would make some bastard who can’t let go of the past cry blood" Destiny giggles and pops a lollipop into her mouth, taking her attention from Karma.
She pretended like she hadnt just teased him.
The other just smiled and decided to forget about the two of them and focus more on the scene showing Kent landing atop a canopy-like rock.
He had searched everywhere but found no elemental source. "Looks like the source of blood isn’t here. Perhaps I was expecting too much, so this is kind of a wake-up call for me not to be too greedy"
He smiled and turned to gap... "Are you ready for the 4th floor?"
"Born ready. I just hope there will be a tough challenge so I can wield my powers some more."
"I suppose we can find out by entering the portal"
Gaap nodded and transformed into his sword form and flew into Kent’s firm grip. Soon, they entered the portal and were ready to kick ass.

chapters.title: Chapter 1323: Necromancer Unleashed
paragraphs: "Hmm, creepy,"
Kent said, the moment he appeared on the 4th floor of the Void Temple.
To his amazement and, well, not too unexpectedly, he appeared in what looked to be a cemetery.
Dirty, eerie, and strangely unsettling smoke kept rising from the thousands of graves littering the entire cemetery. The air is thick with that black and perhaps poisonous smoke.
There was no telling just what kind of place he had appeared in, but he knew there was nothing good about it.
"No names on the graves show I am about to face a necromancer." There are thousands of tombstones, so it wasn’t too hard to know the kind of person he was about to face,
Kent tried to fly into the air, but he found himself stuck to the ground.
"No flight here, huh. Strange yet anticipatory," he grinned and spread the soul map.
"Restricted to just 1 km, even more strange." Despite the restriction, Kent found himself very happy. In his mind, he was about to face someone powerful.
While that should have made him panic and alert him to take immediate action to avoid falling into any trap, he instead felt more relaxed and happy.
Obviously, there is something wrong with his head. However, with the beauties waiting for him at home, even if he were to completely lose his mind, they would snap him back.
However, being happy while standing literally in danger raises concerns about his mental health.

Thankfully, when the next big thing happened, he found himself suddenly getting ready to fight back. His grip tightened on his sword when a formation that further shrunk his sense to only 500 meters appeared.

Standing 50,000 km from Kent was a skeletal figure draped in purple tattered robes, eyes glowing with necrotic starlight. His hand was bony, and in his surprisingly firm grip was a bone staff, the kind that only necromancers held.
He pointed it toward a formation that was being powered by over a hundred undead, each having the strength of a Spirit Immortal.
Suddenly, in the air over Kent’s head, far from his senses, thousands of swords, each forged from the rotting energy of Necrotic Qi, hovered, pointed, and ready to attack.
"Strange, I suddenly felt like my life is in—"
Kent wasn’t done when the swords shot toward him, each pointed at his head. He had no time to even dodge or raise defence before all of them reached him.
He used the soul map to move while summoning the [Chaos Scale Shield].
CLANG CLANG CLANG CLANG
The sound of metal striking metal filled the cemetery as the swords struck Kent’s defence.
Kent manifested the Chaos Scale Shield, forming rotating shields around him. No matter how fast or curved the swords were, they were not able to penetrate the Chaos Scale Shields.
"Yet again, I found myself under the assault of someone hidden from sight. Makes me wonder just how strong they are this time around and how much they have up their sleeve."

The tower said nothing, showing that even she didn’t know. However, Kent knew it was only a matter of time before he did. After all, with this standoff, it would be wise for the attacker to make more moves and hope he lucks out.

As expected, standing outside, the bony figure raised his staff and pointed it at the formation. A golden beam shot from his staff and entered the formation. When he merged with it, the swords stopped shooting at Kent.
They instead reformed, forming a dragon.
It was colossal, about 2000 meters long, with razor-sharp talons and hollow eyes.
"Another danger," Kent said, looking up.
His instincts screamed at him to make strength his shield, so he did. He summoned blood runes and made them merge with the shields.

The moment he did that, a terrifying dragon descended, talons stabbing toward him as it took a nose-dive toward him. Kent stacked the shields and punched them forward, meeting the dragon in a resounding boom.
However, Kent held no smile on his face. If anything, he felt played, and that could be seen from the arrow embedded in his chest.
"I didn’t see that come." A slight shock crossed his face as he gazed at the arrow, which emitted a faint cloud of poison smoke. Although it wasn’t poison, he was struck, and that said something.
He wasn’t invincible as he believed, and this temple master had revealed that.
With the pain still coming from his chest, he slashed his sword, cutting another arrow that appeared out of nowhere. It was like it didn’t exist, yet it existed.
The third arrow came, and yet again, his 6th sense picked it up even when his soul map didn’t.
The dragon was stopped, but it appeared to be a decoy employed by his attacker to fool him. By the time he saw through this scheme, he was already injured.

He had no chance to even make a move against his opponent. However, even worse, he couldn’t tell where the arrows were coming from. If he saw a direction, he would be able to make a move against them.
However, he was blinded, restricted and limited.
[It is the formation. It is connected to a Core Immortal’s domain. I don’t know much about him, but I can only say this much: the domain seems to allow the attacker to manipulate space.
He is merely bending space, making sure the arrows arrive before your soul map could sense them.
This means as long as you are under this formation and inside this domain, you would be under the continuous barrage of arrows, and there is nothing you can do about it.]
Kent thought for a moment, processing everything he had heard. In the end, however, after managing to dodge the 19th attack barely, he grinned and waved his hand, unleashing ten soul spirits.
"Spread out," they moved, and soon, they formed a circle around him in a 500-meter radius.
Kent then formed a hand seal, and from all around him, a loud soul explosion rocked the space, filling it with so much soul energy.
On the outside, the bony figure flinched and coughed; however, nothing came out. Perhaps he had no blood in his body, so he couldn’t cough up anything.
But while his cough yielded no results as one would expect, Kent had a different breakthrough...
Just when he coughed, his focus shifted from the formation, making it flicker. It was just a small flicker, the kind one pays little to no attention to.
However, Kent only needed that to make his move. So, on the flicker, Gaap vanished and appeared outside the formation.
That temporary flicker lifted the flight ban, and Gaap slipped through. The moment he was gone, Kent sat in a lotus posture, a smile playing on his lips.

"Let’s see how your arrows find their mark when there is no way to get through my defence." Kent unleashed his Chaos Scale Shield again, but this time, he created pentagon-shaped shields, stacking them large enough to form a giant dome around himself.
Then, manifesting 30,000 blood runes, he coated the shields, making them nearly indestructible. With that, all arrows coming at him were being deflected like they were made of cotton.
Kent sat inside, allowing the time to pass. This battle, he knew, while the opponent had the upper hand, he would turn things around in a few minutes.
For now, he could continue bombarding his shield with his pointy yet deadly arrows.

chapters.title: Chapter 1324: Underworld Soul River Unleashed
paragraphs: On the outside, Gaap circled around, observing the formation without the bony figure noticing his presence. He was outside the domain’s range of coverage, so he couldn’t be sensed.
But even if he could sense him, it wasn’t like he could attack him. Risking it has a high chance of making things even worse for him.
After about ten minutes, Gaap saw something that made him smile. He quickly transmitted his thoughts to Kent, who was seated inside the dome formed by his Chaos Scale Shield.
"Master, it seems I have found the key to destroying his domain. However, you are not going to like it."
Kent furrowed his brow.
"How hard are we talking?" he asked.
"Like killing tens of thousands of undead beings before getting to their master kind of hard."
"That hard, huh?"

"Very. The guy is a necromancer for sure. However, there is something strange about him that I find creepy and a bit unsettling. Of course, I can’t see how many Immortal Qis he has, but he is a Core Immortal."
"Then it seems we have to move fast and deadly. They are undead, meaning they wouldn’t really die. He can summon them over and over again, so before he can do that, we must go deadly upon him."

"That is going to be a little dangerous, master. There is no telling what he has planned, and from what I can see here, he even has several Spirit Immortal undead in his legion, so taking all of them in one fell swoop isn’t going to be simple at all.
In my opinion, we should create a formation to counter this one. I already have one in mind, but it would take five hours to create.
However, when done, it would even allow us to break this formation and face him in a fair fight.
He has so many warriors on his side that fighting all to get to him would be a headache, even for someone like you. But breaking the formation is a step closer to getting to him."
Kent said nothing, but he sat there, surrounded by the protective embrace of his Chaos Scale Shield fashioned into a dome, letting all Gaap said settle in.

In moments like this, one may have the strength, but they would be so restricted that they couldn’t harness it. In fact, Kent had finally seen what happens when one steps into the playing field prepared by the opponent.
He was trapped inside the formation, and the only way out was to break it. But to break this formation, he must fight thousands of opponents that cannot die even if they wanted to.
They are undead, with the only way they die being if the one summoning them also dies. Naturally, reaching this person would be a headache, and Kent knew that.
If not because of the domain restricting his senses to only a 500-meter radius, he would have already made his move, killing the bony figure swiftly. But it seemed he had finally met his match...
He had the strength to topple mountains, but he could not use it. His opponent prepared for him and set the perfect trap.

"It is indeed annoying knowing I can kill this bastard with a single slash, yet I am shackled in place," Kent smirked, then issued a command to Gaap. "Return, buddy. If we can’t fight them, then we might as well drown them."
"You don’t mean?"
"Yes. While I never expected to unleash it this early into my battle, it wouldn’t be too bad to see the power of the Underworld Soul River."
"Damn, I can’t wait to see it." Gaap appeared inside the dome, still completely evading the senses of the bony figure.
Kent stood up and dismissed the domain, leaving five shields circling around him.
"I know you can hear me, so listen carefully. I wanted to fight you on fair grounds; however, since you have made it impossible for me to do that, I have no choice but to drown you and your army."
Kent paused and let out a chuckle. "Be happy, though, for you are the first person I will be using the technique against. And don’t worry, you are guaranteed to die, so rest in peace, I guess."
Kent took a deep breath, and he tapped into the Underworld Soul River technique. Inside his soul sea, the large dark door shuddered and vanished, appearing on the outside.
Just when it appeared, the entire cemetery shuddered, causing the formation to shatter like glass.
Kent even took several steps back, feeling his soul tremble as he beheld this terrifying gate. However, he had no time to waste since the longer it stayed outside, the more soul essence it consumed.
"Behold, the fury of the Underworld River, Styx."
CRACK

A cracking sound appeared, and the door parted, revealing the darkest river any being would only set their sight on when they die. Kent opened it into the world of the living, and from within it surged like a sea, releasing loud wailing, screaming, groaning, howling, and all kinds of chilling sounds.
Kent watched as the dark water surged through the barely opened gate and began to fill everywhere, drowning the undead and quickly spreading over several kilometres.
As the undead were pulled into the river, their screams and fear were absorbed as well. Kent, who was on the side, nearly freaking out, could sense the river growing stronger and more devastating.
The bony figure who was having the upper hand now found himself surrounded, fear gripping him like shackles.
He had been rooted to the same spot, his bony legs squeaking like they were about to fall off. It was like gazing into the chill expanse of the Underworld River had completely immobilised him.
However, just five seconds into the activation of the Underworld Soul River, Kent felt an invisible force pressing on his soul.
’Damn, does this mean I can only use this for less than ten seconds?’

Kent muttered, then he cut the connection to the Underworld Soul River, causing the water to quickly retreat back to the door. It closed, and in less than two seconds, it was back inside his soul sea.

However, the damage had already been done. The bony figure had been scared to death. The river didn’t even reach him, but he died from sheer fear, bringing an end to what could have been Kent’s longest battle.
"Well, that went better than it should have." Kent expected the Underworld Soul River to be dangerous—which it was—however, he most certainly didn’t expect it to be this dangerous.

Scaring a Core Immortal to death is just too much to even think about. That shouldn’t even be possible. However, it happened, and the result is the messages showing before him that he had indeed killed his opponent.
Aside from that, he also didn’t expect the Underworld Soul River to be this draining. While he wasn’t running out of soul essence anytime soon, the pressure he felt could have crushed his soul.
Just five seconds into the skill activation, and he felt the pressure that deep and strong.
"Damn, I should be careful next time."
He sighed and waved his hand, taking the storage pouch...

sentences.text: On the outside, Gaap circled around, observing the formation without the bony figure noticing his presence.
He was outside the domain’s range of coverage, so he couldn’t be sensed.
But even if he could sense him, it wasn’t like he could attack him.
Risking it has a high chance of making things even worse for him.
After about ten minutes, Gaap saw something that made him smile.
He quickly transmitted his thoughts to Kent, who was seated inside the dome formed by his Chaos Scale Shield.
"Master, it seems I have found the key to destroying his domain.
However, you are not going to like it."
Kent furrowed his brow.
"How hard are we talking?" he asked.
"Like killing tens of thousands of undead beings before getting to their master kind of hard."
"That hard, huh?"
"Very.
The guy is a necromancer for sure.
However, there is something strange about him that I find creepy and a bit unsettling.
Of course, I can’t see how many Immortal Qis he has, but he is a Core Immortal."
"Then it seems we have to move fast and deadly.
They are undead, meaning they wouldn’t really die.
He can summon them over and over again, so before he can do that, we must go deadly upon him."
"That is going to be a little dangerous, master.

There is no telling what he has planned, and from what I can see here, he even has several Spirit Immortal undead in his legion, so taking all of them in one fell swoop isn’t going to be simple at all.
In my opinion, we should create a formation to counter this one.
I already have one in mind, but it would take five hours to create.
However, when done, it would even allow us to break this formation and face him in a fair fight.
He has so many warriors on his side that fighting all to get to him would be a headache, even for someone like you.
But breaking the formation is a step closer to getting to him."
Kent said nothing, but he sat there, surrounded by the protective embrace of his Chaos Scale Shield fashioned into a dome, letting all Gaap said settle in.
In moments like this, one may have the strength, but they would be so restricted that they couldn’t harness it.
In fact, Kent had finally seen what happens when one steps into the playing field prepared by the opponent.
He was trapped inside the formation, and the only way out was to break it.
But to break this formation, he must fight thousands of opponents that cannot die even if they wanted to.
They are undead, with the only way they die being if the one summoning them also dies.
Naturally, reaching this person would be a headache, and Kent knew that.
If not because of the domain restricting his senses to only a 500-meter radius, he would have already made his move, killing the bony figure swiftly.
But it seemed he had finally met his match...
He had the strength to topple mountains, but he could not use it.
His opponent prepared for him and set the perfect trap.
"It is indeed annoying knowing I can kill this bastard with a single slash, yet I am shackled in place," Kent smirked, then issued a command to Gaap.
"Return, buddy.
If we can’t fight them, then we might as well drown them."
"You don’t mean?"
"Yes.
While I never expected to unleash it this early into my battle, it wouldn’t be too bad to see the power of the Underworld Soul River."
"Damn, I can’t wait to see it." Gaap appeared inside the dome, still completely evading the senses of the bony figure.
Kent stood up and dismissed the domain, leaving five shields circling around him.
"I know you can hear me, so listen carefully.
I wanted to fight you on fair grounds; however, since you have made it impossible for me to do that, I have no choice but to drown you and your army."
Kent paused and let out a chuckle.
"Be happy, though, for you are the first person I will be using the technique against.
And don’t worry, you are guaranteed to die, so rest in peace, I guess."
Kent took a deep breath, and he tapped into the Underworld Soul River technique.
Inside his soul sea, the large dark door shuddered and vanished, appearing on the outside.
Just when it appeared, the entire cemetery shuddered, causing the formation to shatter like glass.
Kent even took several steps back, feeling his soul tremble as he beheld this terrifying gate.
However, he had no time to waste since the longer it stayed outside, the more soul essence it consumed.
"Behold, the fury of the Underworld River, Styx."
CRACK
A cracking sound appeared, and the door parted, revealing the darkest river any being would only set their sight on when they die.
Kent opened it into the world of the living, and from within it surged like a sea, releasing loud wailing, screaming, groaning, howling, and all kinds of chilling sounds.
Kent watched as the dark water surged through the barely opened gate and began to fill everywhere, drowning the undead and quickly spreading over several kilometres.
As the undead were pulled into the river, their screams and fear were absorbed as well.
Kent, who was on the side, nearly freaking out, could sense the river growing stronger and more devastating.
The bony figure who was having the upper hand now found himself surrounded, fear gripping him like shackles.
He had been rooted to the same spot, his bony legs squeaking like they were about to fall off.
It was like gazing into the chill expanse of the Underworld River had completely immobilised him.
However, just five seconds into the activation of the Underworld Soul River, Kent felt an invisible force pressing on his soul.
’Damn, does this mean I can only use this for less than ten seconds?’
Kent muttered, then he cut the connection to the Underworld Soul River, causing the water to quickly retreat back to the door.
It closed, and in less than two seconds, it was back inside his soul sea.
However, the damage had already been done.
The bony figure had been scared to death.
The river didn’t even reach him, but he died from sheer fear, bringing an end to what could have been Kent’s longest battle.
"Well, that went better than it should have." Kent expected the Underworld Soul River to be dangerous—which it was—however, he most certainly didn’t expect it to be this dangerous.
Scaring a Core Immortal to death is just too much to even think about.
That shouldn’t even be possible.
However, it happened, and the result is the messages showing before him that he had indeed killed his opponent.
Aside from that, he also didn’t expect the Underworld Soul River to be this draining.
While he wasn’t running out of soul essence anytime soon, the pressure he felt could have crushed his soul.
Just five seconds into the skill activation, and he felt the pressure that deep and strong.
"Damn, I should be careful next time."
He sighed and waved his hand, taking the storage pouch...

chapters.title: Chapter 1325: Aftermath
paragraphs: "Wow, more void stones, huh?" Kent smiled, looking into the 4th temple master’s pouch.
He pulled out five void stones, each filled with so much void energy. It was clear he was happier looking into this pouch than he was after killing the third temple master.
While this guy nearly forced him into an extended battle, he also allowed him to see the nature, strength, and limitations of his [Underworld Soul River].
Kent was already aware that the Underworld Soul River was a dangerous technique. He knew it would grow stronger the more he used it.
Whenever a person dies within, their resentment is absorbed, strengthening it. So, in reality, the more he uses it, the more devastating it becomes, and the more it consumes also.
Of course, with Kent having more soul essence than he could use, he wouldn’t have to worry about running out of energy. The limitation comes in when the pressure starts mounting on his soul.

Initially, he had no idea there would be such a requirement to use the Underworld Soul River. He only expected there to be the need to have enough soul essence; however, it turned out that soul strength was also required, and as such, he was lacking in that regard.
With his Tier 19 soul strength, he could only last for ten seconds. While that is enough time to kill a lot of people or injure them greatly, Kent was at the moment torn between two things.

First, his soul strength was still limited, and as such, he could only harness the devastating power of the Underworld Soul River for ten seconds. However, if he were to strengthen his soul, he could at least last a little longer, or at least that should be how it works.
Unfortunately, the second headache comes in. While it isn’t necessarily a bad thing, it is, in a way, more limiting.
The Underworld Soul River is a technique that grows with the owner’s soul. This means that as Kent’s soul strength increases, so does the Underworld Soul River.
Meaning the power of the Underworld Soul River he had seen isn’t even half of its true power. He was limited only to what he had seen because he had a weak soul.

This also means instead of getting to keep the Underworld Soul River active for a few more seconds, he now runs the risk of even lasting less than the ten seconds, the stronger the Underworld Soul River gets.
So he has a powerful technique, but he is severely limited in how long he can use it.
"Still, having 5 more void stones isn’t too bad," Kent said with a smile, Gaap materialising into his humanoid form to have a closer look at the void stones.

"The Underworld Soul River is very powerful. I am sure not even True Immortals can survive a few seconds inside it," Gaap said, turning away from the void stones and gazing at the dead body of the bony figure.

"He was a Core Immortal with probably three Immortal Qi, yet he died from gazing into the dark expanse of the river. If I didn’t know better, I would say even gods would be afraid of the current version of the Underworld Soul River."
Kent chuckled and stored the five void stones away... "That is to be expected. After all, the plan is to possess something as powerful as the Underworld Soul River for what is coming ahead of us.
So if I have this technique now, then with it, the Blood Fist, Divine Flame Armament, Finger of Destruction, and Void Cleave, I am sure we will be able to traverse the Star Gateway safely."
"True," Gaap nodded. "However, you have to be able to use it for more than ten seconds. Also, after using it once, how long until you can use it again?"
Kent furrowed his brow, completely forgetting to check that. He tapped into the Underworld Soul River and tried to activate it; however, he found out it was impossible.
The runes that activated it were dim and now recovering, so he was limited to at least "45 minutes cooldown at most."
"That is a long time to have such a skill dormant. However, since that is the cooldown time, you must at least be able to keep it active for 20 seconds."
"How do I go about that?" Kent asked, and Gaap could only stare at him...

"So you have no way for me, huh. Maybe I should brute-force my way into making my soul more resilient. Perhaps that would give me a better hold on the active time and keep it going for more than 10 seconds."

"I don’t think that is wise. Especially not when a major mission lies ahead of us that cannot be taken lightly. Forcing your soul can injure it, and while healing it might be simple for you, know that an injured soul is a fragile soul.
So, if possible, find a way to transfer some of the pressure to a third party. This way, even if the pressure is mounting, you can keep the Underworld Soul River active."

This time, Kent nodded and let his mind wander for a few minutes. He is severely limited in the aspects of soul knowledge. However, there was no telling just what he could achieve when he unlocked the potential of his Underworld Soul River.
"Hmm, now, I know this is a long shot, but the soul universe is basically something I can design as I see fit, right?"
Gaap was lost at what Kent was trying to say. However, he nodded just so he could continue with what he had to say...
"If the soul universe allows me to create any weapon I want, then how about I create a weapon I can channel the pressure into?"
Gaap raised his brow, an understanding slowly creeping into his mind.
"That could work. However, what kind of weapon would be able to handle that kind of pressure?"
Kent smiled and answered, "The kind that requires pressure to work. In other words, I need to create the kind of weapon that would require soul pressure as the energy source."
"So it would be a multipurpose type of weapon. It first takes in the soul essence and then releases it."
"Yes. I already have a weapon in mind."
"Can I have a general idea of it?" Gaap became more intrigued and seemed eager to learn more. After all, he wanted to understand Kent better so he could serve him well.

"Sure. Now, imagine a large orb with a terrifying, long and thin cannon attached to it. The orb would take in the pressure, which then can be compressed and transformed into a beam of soul attack, the kind that would travel with the same pressure it had compressed."
Gaap said nothing, perhaps trying to make sense of what had just been said. In the end, he sighed and shook his head, "I would perhaps understand it when I see it."
"Don’t worry, you would be impressed when the Death Star Cannon is ready."
Kent relaxed his nerves and sat down. Then he entered the soul universe to see what he could do. Since there was no danger on the 4th floor now, Gaap didn’t even have to stand guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1326: The Sixth Floor - The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (1)
paragraphs: [5th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon]
With literal goddesses and demigods joining the search, it took less than a day for the legion to find all they were looking for.
What they found were merely some worn-out drawings that, in a strange way, after Unity laid her eyes on them, woke her Primordial Spirits.
They had been in a deep sleep for a long time due to overexertion. However, the painting deep in the Dark Princess’s cave helped jolt them awake.
The previous floors had techniques and hidden information. Thankfully, they weren’t merely paintings; they held some form of recognition of the goddess of love.
They later went back to Holix City, where, under the authority of the Goddess of Light (Yuyin), a new pope — the true pope — was crowned.
She also made sure they would handle the rebuilding of the villages and deploy more holy guards to protect them, to ensure nothing like what happened with the Dark Princess happened again.
Lastly, under her authority, a special unit called the Light Bearers was formed. Their mission was to spread the word that the Goddess of Light had risen.
The main aim was to restore people’s hope in the Goddess of Light so they would keep worshipping her. This would, of course, strengthen their fate.
After that, they left the city.
"Big sister, is it really necessary to let people know the Goddess of Light has been reborn?" Yuyin asked, walking beside Vexthra and the rest of her sisters.

"Of course, it is necessary. You are not a goddess like Miryssa and me. We are Domain Goddesses, so without the power of faith, we will keep rising in strength and divinity. All that is required of us is to comprehend our laws and keep going until we reach the peak, which is Celestialhood.
However, you are a Faith God, so you need faith power to grow."
Vexthra paused, turned to Yuyin and asked, "Or do you think my divinity comes from hatred and resentment?"
Yuyin blushed and nodded.
"Well, I get that a lot. Many people think my power comes from the hatred and resentment of mortals and immortals. The truth is, I don’t get empowered by them.

My divinity came from my comprehension of hatred and resentment." Vexthra smiled. "And yes, I chose to comprehend that law since at that time, I was in a very bad place. However, I am not anymore, but I cannot go back and change it either, so I guess I am the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment."
Unity, being the one more in tune with emotions, gave Vexthra’s hand a gentle squeeze, making sure she knew they all were there for her.
Vexthra smiled, appreciating the support. "Of course, there is a god of hatred and a goddess of resentment out there. My case is special because I have both domains—Hatred and Resentment.
However, you, Unity, Val, and Neomi are Faith Goddesses. This means your divinity would be empowered by your followers’ faith in you. So the earlier they start worshipping you, the better."
Yuyin nodded.

If it were up to her, she wouldn’t have made a move now until she became the Goddess of Light. However, it seemed Vexthra had a much better plan, and since she is a goddess, she knows what is best, so if she had a plan, it must be the right one for her.
"Relax, you have us to help when the time comes. With me around, you all are going to become powerful goddesses in the future."
Yuyin and her sisters nodded, letting a smile appear on their faces.
A few minutes later, they met up with the legion and decided to head to the 6th floor.

"We will follow the same play. If the threat isn’t much, only a select few of you would handle it. Of course, since some of you fought here, you should expect a chance, should it come down to picking only a few of you.
But if we face a harrowing threat, then you might have the chance to fight with everyone."
They nodded.
"Also, after the next floor is cleared, we will use the rewards for that floor and this one before heading to the 7th floor." They nodded again.
Each will receive a Limit Breaker Key and an Innate Talent Booster Pill. Although not all of them participated, their presence means they would receive the same reward as those who fought.
Even Vexthra, who is a goddess, would receive some, and the best part is that, when consumed, it would work just fine on her as it would for her sisters, who are mortals.
It is one of the benefits of being in the team that is clearly one of the Calamity Dungeons in the Universe.
"Okay. Let’s go to the 6th floor."
She opened the portal, and soon, they all walked through.
[Sixth Floor - Fire Country]
"Damn, this place is hot," Elaine said, standing on scorching earth, surrounded by a burning forest, molten rocks, and remains of both humans and beasts alike.

"Let me take care of it." Aetheris, the leader of the Eternal Wrath legions, drew his long sword and stabbed it into the ground. At once, the heat in the air and the burning surrounding them were absorbed into his sword.
"Thank you," Elaine said before turning to Vexthra...
"Looks like a dangerous battle happened here," Vexthra muttered, looking at the remains of the dead humanoids and beasts scattered across the scorched ground.
Suddenly, the ding sound echoed in her head. She knew the details of their mission had been revealed, so she shared it with her sisters and the legion.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (6th)⟧
⟦Power Level: Empyrean⟧
⟦Description:⟧

↠ Three weeks ago, a group of zealots performed a forbidden ritual with the aim of summoning a Calamity Beast from the forbidden lands and harnessing its power to take over the Fire Country and eventually the entire world.

↠ However, when the ritual was completed, and the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was summoned, they realised their control over it wasn’t enough to command it. In the end, they were burnt alive, and a Calamity-level beast was unleashed in the Fire Country.
↠ The Fire King had mobilised his army, but after their first confrontation, it became clear they could not fight it head-on. It was just too powerful for them.
↠ Thankfully, the Water King, Earth Queen, and Ice Empress joined hands with the Fire King and managed to place a temporary seal on the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion.
↠ The seal is only strong enough to hold it for 16 days.

↠ They had evacuated the civilians and prepared a counter-offensive battle formation and plan for when the seal breaks. They have also posted a bounty for neighbouring planets to come to their aid. However, in two days, when the seal breaks, every last warrior would perish.
↠ Your mission is to prevent as many deaths as possible and kill the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion.

⟦The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion is a Level 5 Empyrean with the combat power of a Peak-Level Empyrean. Also, the longer it remains in these plains, the more powerful it gets. So it must be killed as quickly as possible.⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 20 Billion Tower Points
↠ 400 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Awakening Pill
↠ Flame Core of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion

[Sixth Floor - Fire Country]
"Damn, this place is hot," Elaine said, standing on scorching earth, surrounded by a burning forest, molten rocks, and remains of both humans and beasts alike.
"Let me take care of it." Aetheris, the leader of the Eternal Wrath legions, drew his long sword and stabbed it into the ground.
At once, the heat in the air and the burning surrounding them were absorbed into his sword.
"Thank you," Elaine said before turning to Vexthra...
"Looks like a dangerous battle happened here," Vexthra muttered, looking at the remains of the dead humanoids and beasts scattered across the scorched ground.
Suddenly, the ding sound echoed in her head.
She knew the details of their mission had been revealed, so she shared it with her sisters and the legion.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (6th)⟧
⟦Power Level: Empyrean⟧
⟦Description:⟧

↠ Three weeks ago, a group of zealots performed a forbidden ritual with the aim of summoning a Calamity Beast from the forbidden lands and harnessing its power to take over the Fire Country and eventually the entire world.
↠ However, when the ritual was completed, and the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was summoned, they realised their control over it wasn’t enough to command it.
In the end, they were burnt alive, and a Calamity-level beast was unleashed in the Fire Country.
↠ The Fire King had mobilised his army, but after their first confrontation, it became clear they could not fight it head-on.
It was just too powerful for them.
↠ Thankfully, the Water King, Earth Queen, and Ice Empress joined hands with the Fire King and managed to place a temporary seal on the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion.
↠ The seal is only strong enough to hold it for 16 days.
↠ They had evacuated the civilians and prepared a counter-offensive battle formation and plan for when the seal breaks.
They have also posted a bounty for neighbouring planets to come to their aid.
However, in two days, when the seal breaks, every last warrior would perish.
↠ Your mission is to prevent as many deaths as possible and kill the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion.
⟦The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion is a Level 5 Empyrean with the combat power of a Peak-Level Empyrean.
Also, the longer it remains in these plains, the more powerful it gets.
So it must be killed as quickly as possible.⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 20 Billion Tower Points
↠ 400 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Awakening Pill
↠ Flame Core of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion

chapters.title: Chapter 1327: The Sixth Floor - The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (2)
paragraphs: Everyone was left stunned, unsure of what to say after reading the description of the mission that they must complete this time around.

Some of the details are just too much for them to understand, and as such, aside from the fact that this strange beast is even stronger than a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior, it also seems to be from a different category of beasts.
However, the confusion is coming from the fact that they had no idea what any of this meant.
Of course, Vexthra knew, so after reading, they all focused their attention on her.
She nodded and started to reveal what she knew.
"To understand the dangerous nature of this mission, we must first learn about the Calamity Era and the horrors it brought to the universe.

I, just like before, only know a few details about the Calamity Era. However, from what I know, just like how the Dark Era brought the Dark Creatures or like how the Chaos Era brought the Chaos Beasts, that era brought a special breed of beasts called Calamity Beasts.

Of course, it was just like any era where a universe-ending battle happens; however, in that era, the beasts that came were just too powerful. They are like the forbidden race; the world’s restrictions don’t apply to them.
So a god-level Calamity Beast can roam freely in a medium world. This is why the beast we have to kill this time around is an Empyrean in a high world, something that shouldn’t have been possible.
But like always, every universe-ending level beast comes with their own pros and cons. In the aspect of this nine-headed flaming lion, its core is loaded with what we call flame law."
"You mean to say the beast we have to kill has absolute flame?" Lilian asked, her expression turning dull. She is an absolute flame user herself after Kent gave her a primordial flame sea to absorb.
So she knew just how harrowing the absolute flame can be. Learning that her potential opponent is also a flame user, she felt threatened.
And it isn’t just her; even Aetheris, the flame brute, also felt like their next opponent is not going to be a weakling at all.
Vexthra looked at them and smiled, "Of course it has absolute flame, but it is killable if you put your mind to it. However, it is not going to be easy."
They said nothing, but they all knew she was right. The beast had to be killed, and as such, regardless of what the beast is made of, it must be killed
"I say the reward is worth the headache, so we have to end it as quickly as possible. Also, only five of you will fight since it is only an Empyrean." Vexthra paused and scanned everyone’s faces...
"Obviously, Aetheris and Lilian, you will be part of the fight thanks to your flame elements." Lilian nodded with a smile while Aetheris became ultra-happy.

Just like Lilian, he also received a primordial flame seed, and so he has reached the absolute flame stage. If he faced this beast, he would finally be able to see how far his flame element could take him.
Vexthra looked around for a few more seconds until her gaze landed on Velyra. The moment the redskin beauty felt her big sister’s gaze, she smiled.
"You will join them too, Velyra." She nodded with a smile.
She draws her strength from blood, so at least this is a good thing. She is in no way at a severe disadvantage. Just like how the flame will burn her, she, too, could bleed the poor beast dry.
They both have their strengths and weaknesses.

Unity decided to wear puppy eyes to make her big sister pity her and add her to the team. However, Vexthra merely smirked and looked away from her. This made her pout... "Big sister, you are a bully."
Vexthra chuckled and focused on Alina, "You must join the team and make sure a containment formation is deployed to prevent some overachievers from getting close and losing their lives stupidly.
Also, it should be strong enough to contain the beasts. When that is achieved, you can deploy your attack formations."
"Favouritism." Val joined Unity, and they started throwing tantrums.
However, a goddess like Vexthra isn’t easily manipulated, so she merely brushed aside their words and focused on the last teammate for this mission.
After looking through, her gaze landed on Veydris, who stood on the side with his metallic face and nonchalant expression.
"Buddy, you are the 5th member."
Veydris said nothing—since he can’t speak or show expressions—but Vexthra knew he understood what she said, and he would be ready to go into battle.
Irina stood by Veydris’ side, her arms wrapped around his.
Her obsession with the Lost Knight is just too shocking and perhaps admirable. Veydris had never spoken, not once, yet for years now, Irina never left his side.
Even Kent couldn’t help but wonder a few times what she saw in his metal knight. However, knowing there is someone there for the most dangerous void user in his legion made him happy.
But it is weird, though.

After the team was formed, Vexthra focused only on the five members, who comprised Aetheris, a flaming tyrant. He is a member of the Eternal Wrath Legion and a being made from the flaming source of a dying star.
There is also Lilian, who has two deadly cores, one for ice and the other for fire. She is a dragon and one of the best mortal combat mages in Kent’s harem and legion.
There is Velyra, who is among the best swordsmen in the harem and legion. She has control over blood and can harness its bleeding power far more deadly than one would expect.
Alina, of course, is the undisputed formation expert in the harem and legion. Her intelligence in runes, arrays, and formations makes her a formidable opponent.
Then finally, there is Veydris, whose control over the void is even more advanced than Ingrid, who is a voidling.

Naturally, the team is perfect. Alina will contain the beasts. Lilian, being a mage, would attack from afar, Aetheris and Velyra would go for close combat, and Veydris would be their killing weapon, hidden within the void.
It is a perfect team, the kind that has all the elements needed to battle a beast of this magnitude.
"You five will go to the Fire Nation’s main city and register as adventurers who have answered the call for help and have come to kill the beasts.
You don’t have to tell them to let you handle it. I believe when the beast is free, many would run, so just relax and let them clear out.
Once you have the battlefield, Alina will coordinate the battle, and hopefully, it will be over before we know it.
Of course, we will be nearby to make sure nothing bad happens."
"Rest assured, big sister, we five are more than enough for this mission," Alina said, giving a sidelong glance to Unity, who smirked and turned away.
"Good to hear that. Now, you can leave; the city is 3 hours’ flight to the west."
