chapters.title: Chapter 1328: The Sixth Floor - The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (3)
paragraphs: [Two Days Later]
The beast was sealed only 30 km away from the Fire Country’s main capital after it had rampaged through over a dozen smaller cities.
Because of this, over a hundred thousand warriors had gathered at the entrance of the city, since there was only an hour before the seal was broken.
The majority of these warriors are Peak Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivators who have come to kill the beast, claim the reward, and make a name for themselves.
Of course, it is the perfect time to farm for fame. The beast is far more deadly than any beast they have ever faced, and as such, they want to use it to rise above many.
Unfortunately for them, in an hour, they would all see the horror they planned to use as a stepping stone.
Alina and her team were seated on the side — well, Veydris is standing on the side, his expression straight and bland. Many keep looking at him, wondering whether he is a doll or a person.
However, since none dare come forward to ask, they keep looking. Alina and her teammates are meeting to discuss how to approach this issue.

"Lilian, since your ice is not an absolute ice, it would have little to no effect on the beast, so we will be fighting fire with fire. This means all your spells should be fire-based." Lilian nodded, already aware of the limitations of her ice element.
No matter how monstrous she is, she cannot effectively fight absolute flame with perfect harmony stage ice. It is just not possible, so she had to tap into her flame element.
"Once the battle begins, Aetheris and Velyra would draw its attention for three seconds for me to open three formations.

The first formation will contain it as the big sister instructed. The second formation would allow me to spot openings and weaknesses in its defence, and the third would grant you both speed and stamina. It would also speed up your healing and enemy recovery.

Once all formations are active, Lilian would start distracting it while Aetheris and Velyra go in hard and make sure you injure it. Once that happens, Velyra, you must make the best of it. Even if to slow it down, put your all into it.
The rest, however, would depend on Veydris and me. I have been working on some combat formations since I hit a roadblock with my Battlefield Matrix Formation.
Using it on this beast seems like the best thing. It would even help me fine-tune it some more and make it better for future battles."
Lilian and the others nodded. They are happy to have Alina as their leader since they know what she is capable of. If she put her mind to it, she alone would be enough to handle this beast.
"Let’s get this done as fast as possible. We still have 31 more floors to climb and less than eleven years to do that, so we must hurry."
They nodded but remained seated.
A few minutes later, four people, each radiating the aura of seasoned warriors, appeared in the air. They are the leaders of the various countries on Planet Gana.
The one with red hair is the Fire King, while the brown-haired lady is the Earth Queen, the silver-haired beauty is the Ice Empress, and the blue-haired handsome man is the Water King.

They came together to create the seal that trapped the nine-headed flaming lion for the past two weeks. Although it wasn’t their country under attack, they came to help the Fire King because they knew that once the Fire Country fell, they would be next.
So they brought their finest warriors over to help handle the monster before it becomes an unstoppable plague.
The Fire King started to speak:
"Thank you all for coming on such short notice. As you all know, in a couple of minutes, the beast that had rampaged through my kingdom will break free and attack.
I plead with you all to join me, and let’s vanquish this threat before it becomes unstoppable. And as promised, when this is done, your rewards will be generous.
I don’t want to say much, but all I ask is your help to save the Fire Country and save the entire world."
The warriors there started bragging, making all kinds of bold claims, and some even asked to be given the first chance to take on the beast.
Naturally, they want the rewards promised, and even better, they want to have it all if they end up being the ones to kill the beast.
Alina and her team remained at the back, paying these people no attention. In a few minutes, they would all run with their tails tucked between their legs.
As expected, about 20 minutes later, a powerful heat suddenly enveloped everyone, leaving many turning pale.
The Fire King spoke again...
"The moment has come, let’s all move out." He and the other leaders began flying toward the seal’s location. Many followed, but some remained in the back, clearly not planning on joining the battle.
Just the heat had made them lose their resolve. If they met the beast, they would probably shit their pants.
"Let’s go," Alina said, and the four of them moved while Veydris slipped into the void.
Thirty kilometres away, a large crack had appeared in the air, releasing so much heat that it compelled many to stop several kilometres away from the crack.

"Looks like we wouldn’t have to worry about getting a spot; many have already disqualified themselves," Lilian said when they were just 3 km away. In front of them, only a few warriors remained, most being warriors from the Fire Country.

The heat isn’t that hot, but the pressure it contains is what many fear. They can tell the danger coming isn’t one they can handle. However, they also didn’t want to look weak, so they stopped and continued watching.
Suddenly, another crack appeared, and more heat came from within. This time, many started stepping back, some already distancing themselves further.
Suddenly, a third crack appeared, and with it, more appeared, completely shattering the seal and throwing dust and smoke into the air.
ROAR

Nine distinct roars spread across the area, sending many running like rats. When the smoke cleared, a 120-meter-tall lion with nine terrifying heads was revealed, causing everyone, Alina’s team included, to suck in a cold breath.
"Well, looks like we have our work cut out for us," Alina muttered.
"ATTACK!"

The Fire King gave the command, but to everyone’s shock, only a handful rushed forward, showing what he had feared. Many came with expectations, but when they saw the horror they had to deal with, they panicked and ran.
The handful who attacked were he, the leaders from the other countries, and a few of the warriors. Even his own fire warriors panicked, some even running back.
"Any moment now," Velyra said, watching as some warriors were sent flying back, their bodies burnt in more than one place.

In less than a minute, it became clear that the battle was lost. Two weeks ago, it was only 45 meters tall. Now, it had become a monster standing 120 meters tall. That is just not something they can fight.
Luckily, Alina and her team made their move. "Let’s get it down."

chapters.title: Chapter 1329: The Sixth Floor - The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (4)
paragraphs: Many came with their egos as large as a mountain but flew with no shame.
Meanwhile, while thousands of warriors decided to save their skins instead of facing the monstrosity, shooting beams of fire from all nine heads. Alina and her team advanced.

As they moved, Alina opened her palm, and three disc-shaped items appeared. She made one float up, and then, when she was just 500 meters away from the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, she formed a hand seal.
The formation disc released a purple light, then a beam shot up, manifesting a large formation. It opened and expanded at once, reaching a width of 4 km.

It created a containment field that encased both the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion and her team. This was to ensure no one disturbs them and to keep the beast confined so it does not run rampant, causing more destruction as it did two weeks ago.
Of course, under normal circumstances, if this containment were created by the beast, it would be bad for them. However, the moment the formation had taken effect, the beast felt trapped.
"Aetheris, Velyra, get on it."

Aetheris transformed, taking on his towering form, becoming the flaming tyrant for this battle. He stood 40 meters tall, but even with this transformation, he was still dwarfed by the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, who stood 120 meters tall.

However, his sword also took on a 60-meter length and became more colossal, enabling him to channel more of his strength, so he could unleash a terrifying slash, the kind that causes the ground to tremble and crack.
The impact pushed the beast back, but it sustained no injuries.

Velyra didn’t stand idle either. She may appear like an atom in front of this colossus; however, when she unleashed a terrifying sword arc made from blood, it pushed the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion back a few steps.
ROAR
All nine heads roared, but before it could move, Lilian raised her staff and summoned a flaming dragon, one that dwarfed the colossal lion.
Its wings expanded, and just when the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was about to make a move on Aetheris and Velyra, the flaming dragon unleashed a dragon breath.
This forced the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion to move back a few steps.
Velyra took the chance to move closer and land a cut. However, just when she was advancing, one of the giant heads saw her and attacked, shooting a flame beam.
Velyra conjured a blood shield, but when the beam landed on it, it cracked and shattered. Thankfully, before the beam could land on her, Alina formed a hand seal and teleported her away.
"Thank you," Velyra said, but wasted no time, running back into battle.

Alina, however, seemed to have sensed something, making her frown... "All nine heads are aware, meaning to catch it off guard, we must engage all nine heads, taking hold of its focus completely. However, it will be difficult.
"Aetheris was already keeping it occupied like the brute he is. However, whenever Velyra tries to get close, one of the nine heads always notices her.
"It was like the heads had been programmed to become aware just when a threat was coming, regardless of how engaged or occupied they were.
"Even worse, all the openings I am seeing are false. It is like it allowed me to see those openings so it could ambush us."
Alina focused her attention on the battlefield.
Overhead, three layers of formations were spinning: one creating a containment around them, one looking for openings, and the last boosting the strength and stamina of her teammates.
The three formations weren’t at all strong, but the more they remained active, the stronger they became. Alina always made her formations adapt as they stayed active longer.
"I hate to admit it, but an archer would come in handy right about now," Alina said to herself, the image of Unity’s smug expression appearing in her mind.
She quickly wipes that image from her mind.

Lilian was perfectly distracting the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion like she was instructed to; however, the moment Velyra or Aetheris tried to make a close move on it, one of the heads always spotted them.

Suddenly, Lilian made a bold move, transforming her staff into a spear and moving at blinding speed. She managed to get within 3 meters of the lion. However, before she could attack, one of the nine heads noticed her and attacked.
However, before the fire beam could reach her, she smiled and winked. "Gotcha."
She burst into flames and spread away. She reformed into her stunning self. However, the near-death move she made gave Velyra an opening.
She slipped under the lion’s surveillance, and before it could sense her, she was already standing beside one of its four legs.
Her sword moved with blinding speed and landed on its leg. However, instead of seeing a cut and blood pouring out, what occurred was rather heartbreaking.
CLANG
When Velyra’s sword connected with the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion’s leg, the sound of metal striking metal was what happened.
The cut she expected didn’t happen. Instead, she found herself in danger of being crushed to pulp. The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion raised its leg and took a heavy stomp, aiming to crush Velyra.
Velyra smirked and turned to blood mist. She reappeared and reformed into her stunning self several meters from the lion.

However, it seemed to have marked her, since she had managed to land a blow on her. So when one of its heads saw her reappear, it blasted through the barrage of attacks it was being bombarded with and aimed to kill the red-skinned beauty who dared to sneak up on it.
Velyra held a calm gaze; however, she felt the pressure fall on her. Luckily, Alina had already deployed her 4th formation.
A green formation with so many complex arrays appeared in the air, and from its centre, a large dagger appeared.
She pointed toward the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, and the dagger shot forward, forcing the lion to prioritise its heads over killing a bug.
Naturally, it was much more intelligent than one would expect, so it chose to save its skin. What followed, however, was barrages of daggers, each radiating intense power.
They rained down with deadly intensity. Velyra retreated back and stopped beside Alina... "Looks like we have a huge metallic problem."
Alina smiled, looking at the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion taking on the rain of daggers and barrage from Aetheris and Lilian.
They were doing their best, but not even a drop of blood could be seen on its colossal body. In fact, all their attacks were being stopped by the metallic coating on the lion.
"Yeah. It seems we are in hot soup this time around." Alina took a moment to examine the scene of the battle before turning to Velyra.
"How about we play dirty?"
"I am open to anything," Velyra said, looking at the giant metallic lion tanking all bombardments coming from Aetheris, Lilian, and the formation.

"Since Veydris hasn’t made his move yet, it means he had long seen the beast had a much tougher hide than what his sword could cut. If he could speak, I am sure he would have alerted us, but since we found out the hard way, we must change plans.
"So how about we shamelessly play hide and seek with it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1330: The Sixth Floor - The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (5)
paragraphs: Velyra stared groggily, stunned at Alina, unsure of what to say to what she had just said. Eventually, she managed to say something...
"If I didn’t know you better, I would have said you are losing your mind. However, it is you, so why don’t you elaborate? What do you mean by we should play hide-and-seek with a behemoth?"
Alina smiled and quickly explained, considering that the beast was adapting to her formation much faster than she had anticipated.
"So Kent once played this game with the troublemakers called Hide and Seek. He said it is a game from his home planet where one or more people hide, and one person finds them."
"Yeah, I know that. But how does it help us fight this behemoth?"

"Very simple, actually. Since the beast is impenetrable on its skin, we need to target its eyes. However, getting close to it is proving difficult, so why don’t we lure it into a game of hide-and-seek, where, while we hide, we also seek it and attack when it is caught off guard?

"We only need to take out one of its eyes for you to do your blood work. I believe that would work. The moment you get hold of its blood, don’t slow it down; instead, mess with its brain. That would give Aetheris and Lilian the chance to attack more and create an opening for Veydris."
"That could work. However, there is one thing you are forgetting... Our surroundings are bare. There are no mountains or rocks to hide under."
Alina smiled and proceeded to another formation disc. "I planned to use this to create a playground inside the tower; however, since we are here now, I might as well use it."
She threw it forward, and when it was about to land on the ground, she activated it, manifesting a formation that instantly started changing the terrain.
Mountains, trees, rocks, rivers, and even houses appeared. In a span of three seconds, the entire 10 km radius was transformed, pushing back all the onlookers.
A beautiful playground filled the place, leaving Velyra stunned.
"Unbelievable. So this was what you were doing inside your primordial space while we were waiting for you."
"All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy," Alina said with a chuckle, and then she transmitted to Aetheris and Lilian, who found themselves inside a cave and atop a mountain.
"Alina, what the fuck?" Lilian screamed after she and Aetheris teleported, appearing beside Alina and Velyra.
"Relax, this is a good thing. Just take a look for yourself."
Lilian looked far into the distance where the lion was rampaging, shooting flame beams from all nine heads, breaking the trees, and crashing into the mountains.
However, whenever a mountain came crumbling down, the next second, it rose back up as if nothing had happened. And whenever they restored themselves, the lion was compelled to attack again.

"This is our chance to create the first advantage that would allow us to kill it. The formation is self-healing, so as long as we can hide and seek effectively, it wouldn’t be too difficult to injure it. The best part is, I have created hidden pathways inside the formation that I can open for you to move quickly and sneak up on it"
"I thought you said this was a formation for us to play hide and seek in," Lilian asked, her brow furrowed.
"That was the idea, yes."
"So if that was the case, then does that mean you were trying to cheat by creating secret pathways?"
Alina was left standing, unsure of how to answer the question. She was indeed aiming to cheat and always win; however, she was discovered before she had a chance to implement her plan.
"What a bitch. As if she hadn’t won enough with her big butt, she now wants to win in mere games," Velyra said with a chuckle, leaving Alina blushing like a child.
Aetheris could only stare at the three ladies with an expression that said, ’Girls, are you aware we are in the middle of a dangerous battle?’
"Tsk. How long can you hold the formation?" Lilian asked, looking as their opponent continued to rampage.
"I can keep it active for an hour, 30 minutes if I make use of some hidden mechanisms that—"
Alina paused, looking at Lilian and Velyra glaring at her. It seemed that, aside from the hidden pathways, there were some hidden mechanisms she could use to her advantage.
"Cheater."
"Nobody is going to play hide and seek with you."
"What if I promise to teach you the mechanisms?" Alina asked, her expression turning sinister like an old scammer who had just hooked their claws into two innocent victims.

As expected, the ladies paused what they were about to say and took a second to ponder her offer. In the end, they fell for her scheme. "Fine, but we will talk about the details later. Now, get to work and help us win. I don’t want Unity coming to our aid."
"Yes, knowing her, she by now was already badmouthing our efforts."
Of course, they were right. Unity had her legs wrapped around Vexthra, hugging her from behind, crying into her ears to let her join the battle.
"Cry all you want, I would not fall for your scheme this time around."
The legion and the rest of her sisters could only continue to laugh at her antics while also paying attention to the battle.

Meanwhile, the Fire King and the various warriors who were pushed away from the battlefield could only watch in amazement as the battlefield shifted and several obstacles appeared here and there, causing the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion to aimlessly attack.
"Who are these people?" was the only question on everyone’s mind.

One moment, they were fleeing from the battle; the next, a group of unknown beauties, a giant made of molten lava, and a battle doll that had since vanished into thin air charged forward without fear and started battling the beast they knew, deep in their hearts, none of them could handle.
If anything, at least a name should suffice. However, they were complete strangers to everyone. This, in a way, showed they were from a faraway planet.
But if that was the case, then does that mean the mission they had posted on the other planets had reached that far?
A lot of questions kept popping up in everyone’s mind. However, as the minutes slowly passed, they began to see that the battle would soon come to an end.

That was because, for several minutes now, the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion had been rampaging, but not a single attack had landed on the four people battling it. In fact, the veterans among them started to see something deeper.
The more the lion rampaged, the more its focus shifted from Lilian, Aetheris, who had reduced its size to 5 meters, and Velyra, who were slowly making their way toward it.
Alina stayed back, coordinating everything. She kept opening secret pathways, activating mechanisms, and occasionally attacking to draw attention away from her teammates.
Slowly, they were making progress.
Eventually, on the 22nd minute, a window opened for all three of them.
"On my mark, execute the plan," Alina transmitted to her teammates, who nodded. Inside the void, Veydris also seemed to have a read on the play, so he started charging his sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 1331: The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion (6)
paragraphs: Lilian, Aetheris, and Velyra positioned themselves in front of the giant lion, waiting for Alina to make her move. She had, in a way, delivered on her promise by sneaking them around using the secret pathway.
This made Lilian and Velyra wonder just how miserable they would have been if it had been a hide-and-seek game between Alina and the rest of their sisters.
Alina would have remained hidden for as long as she wanted without anyone finding her. Thankfully, they were now in on her scheme, so things wouldn’t be too disadvantageous to them.
But for now, the pathways had helped them get close to the beast, and in less than a minute, they would attack. Naturally, that was a good use for Alina’s shamelessness.

Just as the lion continued to rampage, the green formation that was previously raining down daggers appeared again. However, instead of manifesting daggers, this time, nine 5-meter-long spears appeared, each locked on a head.
The moment they locked on the lion, it sensed them and focused its full attention on them.
Alina smiled despite pouring almost half of her energy reserve into creating the nine spears. "Be ready."
She transmitted to her teammates. Then, when all of the lion’s focus became rooted on her attack, she gestured forward, and the spears moved, each travelling with so much speed.
In under a second, the spears arrived before the nine heads.

The ground shook, and another spear, made from fire, erupted from the ground, shooting toward one of the nine heads. Lilian made her move, creating a bang. The spear moved, aiming for one of the eyes on the nine heads.
But she wasn’t the only one who attacked. Aetheris also teleported and appeared in front of one of the heads just when the spear from Alina landed on a metallic coating on the lion’s forehead.
His sword stabbed forward, aiming to pierce one of its eyes.
In that same moment, Velyra also appeared, aiming for yet another eye. All three, including the nine spears manifested by Alina, were aimed to injure the lion through the eye.
However, against all odds, the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion managed to defend against all the attacks, not even a single one finding its mark as they intended.
ROAR
The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion released a powerful roar as it was moved back from the bombardment Alina and her team had rained down on it.
Velyra and Aetheris, who went in for the attack, were blasted back. However, before they could crash into a mountain, a path opened, and they fell in.

Their one chance had been missed; however, they didn’t seem to care. That was because just when they were blasted back, Veydris suddenly appeared from the void, and before the lion could make a move to stop him, his sword moved, coated in thick void energy.
The sword moved toward one eye, and before the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion could create countermeasures, a deep cut appeared on just one of its 18 eyes.
From within, blood gushed out, spraying into the air. Veydris was long gone by then.
"Velyra, the rest is on you."
Inside the fake mountain, Velyra and Aetheris ran back, escaping the fury of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, who had just sustained its first injury.
It had played its attacks and defence so well that, while it could have sustained many injuries from previous attacks, none of them managed to achieve their goal.
But unexpectedly, out of nowhere, a nobody left one of its eyes blinded, blood spraying out like a fountain.
Soon, however, it sensed why the bugs it was fighting were aimed at its eye the entire time.
A very dangerous sensation moved through its blood, then through the blinded eye, and before it could create any mental defences, it found itself battling brain assaults.
Velyra had moved 3 km back and tapped into the blood, moving it into the lion’s brain and using its own blood to attack its brain.
She formed small needles from the blood and started poking its large brain.
It may have nine brains, but the moment one is affected, Velyra begins to slowly gain access to the other eight.
"Velyra and Aetheris, don’t hold back your attacks," Alina instructed, and as she expected, the bombardments from Lilian and Aetheris grew even more devastating.
Slowly, as the minutes passed, one could tell the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was slowing down. Aetheris had even taken on his giant form again, so his attacks were loaded with so much strength.

It’s now bleeding in more than one place. Naturally, that allowed Velyra to increase her assaults. She even managed to blind a few eyes, allowing Aetheris and Lilian to have more blind spots to attack from.
Though it was extremely draining, the more blood that flowed out, the less energy Velyra needed to keep her attacks going.
Eventually, as Velyra’s mental assault grew more ferocious, the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was pushed back even further. But that didn’t do much to show it was in danger.
That was the case until the sudden appearance of the Lost Knight Veydris caused it to lose one head.
Aetheris managed to leave a cut on the neck of one of the heads, so Veydris timed it, and when the opening presented itself, he attacked. Its head came clean off its body.
The moment that happened, Velyra let a smile appear on her beautiful face. With so much blood coming out from the severed neck, she basically had only one thing left to do.
"Blood Poison."
She activated the insidious innate talent she had awakened after her True Name awakening. It took effect the next second, causing the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion to start slowing down considerably.
In no time, its legs stopped moving. Then one of the heads rapidly swelled, becoming larger and puffier.
BOOM
Before long, the head exploded, leaving it only seven.
But in the next minute, those heads also exploded like a bunch of melons. Before long, all nine heads exploded, or more like the brains exploded, taking the heads with them.
When the last head exploded, the 120-meter-long, colossal body of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion dropped, creating a powerful thud that sent a shockwave several km wide.

Far away, Vexthra and her sisters, along with the legion, cheered. But they weren’t the only ones who did; the various warriors who came to support the fire country also cheered, seeing the behemoth drop dead.
While it pained many for not being the ones who brought down the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, the fact that it is dead made them happy.
To most, protecting civilians’ lives is all that matters. The rewards are nothing if the people are safe and sound. So the lion’s dying was a good thing to them.
Alina deactivated all her formations, causing the playground she had built to crumble and return it to the barren ground it had been from the start.
Aetheris, on the other hand, walked to the beast’s body and took the basketball-sized core radiating intense heat, storing it in his space ring.

When the people saw this, they became jealous; however, considering they had just witnessed what Alina and her team were capable of, they kept quiet and only continued to watch what they would do next.

sentences.text: Lilian, Aetheris, and Velyra positioned themselves in front of the giant lion, waiting for Alina to make her move.
She had, in a way, delivered on her promise by sneaking them around using the secret pathway.
This made Lilian and Velyra wonder just how miserable they would have been if it had been a hide-and-seek game between Alina and the rest of their sisters.
Alina would have remained hidden for as long as she wanted without anyone finding her.
Thankfully, they were now in on her scheme, so things wouldn’t be too disadvantageous to them.
But for now, the pathways had helped them get close to the beast, and in less than a minute, they would attack.
Naturally, that was a good use for Alina’s shamelessness.
Just as the lion continued to rampage, the green formation that was previously raining down daggers appeared again.
However, instead of manifesting daggers, this time, nine 5-meter-long spears appeared, each locked on a head.
The moment they locked on the lion, it sensed them and focused its full attention on them.
Alina smiled despite pouring almost half of her energy reserve into creating the nine spears.
"Be ready."
She transmitted to her teammates.
Then, when all of the lion’s focus became rooted on her attack, she gestured forward, and the spears moved, each travelling with so much speed.
In under a second, the spears arrived before the nine heads.
The ground shook, and another spear, made from fire, erupted from the ground, shooting toward one of the nine heads.
Lilian made her move, creating a bang.
The spear moved, aiming for one of the eyes on the nine heads.
But she wasn’t the only one who attacked.
Aetheris also teleported and appeared in front of one of the heads just when the spear from Alina landed on a metallic coating on the lion’s forehead.
His sword stabbed forward, aiming to pierce one of its eyes.
In that same moment, Velyra also appeared, aiming for yet another eye.
All three, including the nine spears manifested by Alina, were aimed to injure the lion through the eye.
However, against all odds, the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion managed to defend against all the attacks, not even a single one finding its mark as they intended.
ROAR
The Nine-Headed Flaming Lion released a powerful roar as it was moved back from the bombardment Alina and her team had rained down on it.
Velyra and Aetheris, who went in for the attack, were blasted back.
However, before they could crash into a mountain, a path opened, and they fell in.
Their one chance had been missed; however, they didn’t seem to care.
That was because just when they were blasted back, Veydris suddenly appeared from the void, and before the lion could make a move to stop him, his sword moved, coated in thick void energy.
The sword moved toward one eye, and before the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion could create countermeasures, a deep cut appeared on just one of its 18 eyes.
From within, blood gushed out, spraying into the air.
Veydris was long gone by then.
"Velyra, the rest is on you."
Inside the fake mountain, Velyra and Aetheris ran back, escaping the fury of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, who had just sustained its first injury.
It had played its attacks and defence so well that, while it could have sustained many injuries from previous attacks, none of them managed to achieve their goal.
But unexpectedly, out of nowhere, a nobody left one of its eyes blinded, blood spraying out like a fountain.
Soon, however, it sensed why the bugs it was fighting were aimed at its eye the entire time.
A very dangerous sensation moved through its blood, then through the blinded eye, and before it could create any mental defences, it found itself battling brain assaults.
Velyra had moved 3 km back and tapped into the blood, moving it into the lion’s brain and using its own blood to attack its brain.
She formed small needles from the blood and started poking its large brain.
It may have nine brains, but the moment one is affected, Velyra begins to slowly gain access to the other eight.
"Velyra and Aetheris, don’t hold back your attacks," Alina instructed, and as she expected, the bombardments from Lilian and Aetheris grew even more devastating.
Slowly, as the minutes passed, one could tell the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was slowing down.
Aetheris had even taken on his giant form again, so his attacks were loaded with so much strength.
It’s now bleeding in more than one place.
Naturally, that allowed Velyra to increase her assaults.
She even managed to blind a few eyes, allowing Aetheris and Lilian to have more blind spots to attack from.
Though it was extremely draining, the more blood that flowed out, the less energy Velyra needed to keep her attacks going.
Eventually, as Velyra’s mental assault grew more ferocious, the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion was pushed back even further.
But that didn’t do much to show it was in danger.
That was the case until the sudden appearance of the Lost Knight Veydris caused it to lose one head.
Aetheris managed to leave a cut on the neck of one of the heads, so Veydris timed it, and when the opening presented itself, he attacked.
Its head came clean off its body.
The moment that happened, Velyra let a smile appear on her beautiful face.
With so much blood coming out from the severed neck, she basically had only one thing left to do.
"Blood Poison."
She activated the insidious innate talent she had awakened after her True Name awakening.
It took effect the next second, causing the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion to start slowing down considerably.
In no time, its legs stopped moving.
Then one of the heads rapidly swelled, becoming larger and puffier.
BOOM
Before long, the head exploded, leaving it only seven.
But in the next minute, those heads also exploded like a bunch of melons.
Before long, all nine heads exploded, or more like the brains exploded, taking the heads with them.
When the last head exploded, the 120-meter-long, colossal body of the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion dropped, creating a powerful thud that sent a shockwave several km wide.
Far away, Vexthra and her sisters, along with the legion, cheered.
But they weren’t the only ones who did; the various warriors who came to support the fire country also cheered, seeing the behemoth drop dead.
While it pained many for not being the ones who brought down the Nine-Headed Flaming Lion, the fact that it is dead made them happy.
To most, protecting civilians’ lives is all that matters.
The rewards are nothing if the people are safe and sound.
So the lion’s dying was a good thing to them.
Alina deactivated all her formations, causing the playground she had built to crumble and return it to the barren ground it had been from the start.
Aetheris, on the other hand, walked to the beast’s body and took the basketball-sized core radiating intense heat, storing it in his space ring.

When the people saw this, they became jealous; however, considering they had just witnessed what Alina and her team were capable of, they kept quiet and only continued to watch what they would do next.

chapters.title: Chapter 1332: Kent Madson Sent Us
paragraphs: Alina, Lilian, and Velyra also walked toward the colossal body of the beast. It took them an hour and 4 minutes, but they finally managed to bring it down.
"What are we going to do with it?" Lilian asked. Any warrior would love to have their hands on such a colossal body. It is perfect for crafting and much more.
"Nothing. We already have the core, so the next thing we will be doing is to get out of here," Alina responded, turning toward the direction of the Fire King.
After a few moments of contemplation, she flew toward him... "You can have the body of the beasts; we don’t need it."
While having the body of an Empyrean will surely come in handy, Alina knew it was too disfigured to contribute much to anything.
The one who would have benefited the most is Veera. She is a Necromancer after all.
However, even she has several stronger dead bodies than this beast. Their time in the Paragon Universe gave them so much that this beast body is nothing in their eyes.
"Are you sure?" the Fire King asked, and Alina nodded.

"The core is enough. You can also share the rewards with those who made a move on the lion when it broke free. Of course, if it is huge enough, use it to take care of the families of those who lost someone during the rampage."
The Fire King cupped his fist and bowed, showing his gratitude to Alina and her team for coming through for him.
"Don’t worry about it." Alina smiled and started flying back. However, before she could get far, the Fire King asked...
"At least, can we know the names of our benefactors?"
Alina stopped and answered, making sure her words were heard by quite a lot of people... "Our names are not important. Just know that Kent Madson sent us."
With that, she teleported away, appearing beside her team. Then they both teleported back to Vexthra and the rest of the team.
Everyone who heard what Alina said became stunned. The Kent Madson everyone keeps hearing about turns out to have even a monstrous team on his side. That is just something many didn’t see coming.
Words quickly started spreading, announcing to everyone the appearance of five powerful warriors who claimed to be warriors under the infamous Kent Madson.
Some who were smart enough to record most of the battle, and where Alina revealed their identity, started selling the videos, making millions in high-grade spirit stones.
Meanwhile, just when Alina and her team arrived beside Vexthra and the rest of the team, a message indicating a successful mission completion appeared, making everyone happy.
"Congratulations, Alina. You have successfully led a team of your own in clearing a dungeon floor. That is wonderful."
Alina smiled, feeling happy to be praised by her big sister. While Vexthra is indeed her sister, the fact that she is a goddess yet praising her made her happy.

Unity, of course, wasn’t happy to hear Alina being praised. However, she said nothing and only continued to pout. While she is the sweetest of them all, they know that if they keep falling for her schemes, she will continue to be a spoiled brat.
So Vexthra and her sisters decided to make sure she never got her way again, at least while Kent is away.
"So where do we search this time around?" Elsa asked, seeing the mission on the 6th floor finally come to an end.

"I have already scanned the entire planet, but it seems there is nothing to look for here. The place where the beasts were summoned is completely destroyed, so I believe we have nothing to look for here."
"Then are we going to the seventh floor?"
"No. We each have two Limit Breaker Keys, an Innate Talent Awakening Pill, and an Innate Talent Booster Pill. We have to go back to the tower and use them before heading to the 7th floor.
Very soon, we will start facing even immortals, so we must be prepared. Breaking two more limits and awakening an Innate Talent is going to go a long way for sure."
"Okay, big sister."

Vexthra opened the portal to the legion tower, and they all entered. Soon, they were back inside the tower, where time is on their side. Vexthra quickly shared the rewards, then she and her sisters teleported away, appearing in the Harem Tower.
"Let’s get to work." They nodded and vanished, appearing in their various treehouses. The only ones left were Miryssa, Yuyin, and Vexthra.
Vexthra took them to the Yin Pool, where they stripped naked and entered. Since Kent was not around, Miryssa and Yuyin didn’t mind getting naked.
"Use the Limit Breaker Keys first, then focus on the Innate Talent Awakening Pill and Booster Pill."
Vexthra said before pressing the key against her forehead. This isn’t her first time doing this. She had done it four times already, so it was nothing new to her.
Miryssa watched as Vexthra’s soul energy started to stir. This sent her into a wave of shock.

She knew breaking a limit while at the god stage was near impossible. While breaking a limit benefits them greatly, the resources required to even dare attempt such a risky endeavour are mind-blowing.
It is why many go above and beyond to break more limits while mortal and at the immortal stage. The moment they become gods, that luxury becomes something so distant.
’I can’t believe I am about to break two more limits after billions of years of no progress.’ She became emotional just thinking about this prospect.
In the end, however, she pressed the key against her forehead, and her soul energy began to stir, indicating she was about to break a limit on her soul.
As for Yuyin, the moment she pressed the key against her forehead, she felt her mind clear, then, as if she had undergone enlightenment, her comprehension speed and ability surged.
’Amazing, after so many years of trying, I have finally broken the first mind limit.’ She smiled, tears rolling down her face.

She had only broken 6 limits on her body, despite being a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator. Unlike most, she and her people didn’t have the luxury to cultivate in peace, so the least she was able to do was break six—two on her soul, body, and cultivation.
Now, she had broken her 7th, and soon the 8th was broken on her mind again, making her see more than she had been able to perceive before.
The same was for Miryssa, who managed to break her 65th and 66th limits. Vexthra had finally broken her 69th and 70th limits, making her mental and soul strength surge.
’Looks like my Law Domain has already reached the Supreme stage, but I can make it better,’ Vexthra said inwardly with a smile.
Just one limit more broken in her mind, and she had already seen this deep into her law comprehension.
Perhaps the Stardrop Noir she drank while at the god realm may have also played a part. But this breakthrough would have taken her thousands of years.
’I guess I will thank Kent properly when he is back.’
After saying that, she swallowed the Innate Talent Awakening Pill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1333: Death Star Cannon
paragraphs: While the ladies and the legion are busy working on breaking their limits and awakening their innate talents, Kent was also hard at work, using all his understanding to create a weapon of mass destruction: the Death Star Cannon.
The idea is to create something that can absorb the pressure his soul goes through when he activates the Underworld Soul River for more than ten seconds.
From the idea he had in mind, he would create a containment-type treasure that would absorb the pressure that would come from his soul.
Once that is absorbed, he also planned on adding a cannon, one that would direct the pressure he had absorbed into a concentrated beam.
He wouldn’t just be creating a container to store the pressure. Kent is an overachiever, so he aims to create a concentrated beam that can kill even powerful foes.
If he is going to suffer soul pressure, he might as well benefit from it.
Thankfully, he had already seen what he wanted to create many times back on Earth. He even used LEGO to build it, just like any kid, teenager, or adult.
Although it is not the same thing, since he planned to make modifications, he has a general idea, and now all he needs to do is handle the absorption function and how to convert it into a beam.
So for the past few days, he had been inside the Soul Universe working on the foundation of the Death Star Cannon.
He had made so much progress; however, he still lacks something crucial: how to compress the pressure into a source worthy of becoming a beam.

He already figured out how to absorb the pressure and also transform it into a beam. However, that isn’t the only thing he is after. If he were to directly shoot the beam after absorbing it, the beam would be rather weak.
However, if he compresses it and channels it through the cannon, then there is no telling just what kind of unholy armament he would be creating.
He also aims to use the Underworld Soul River more, so he needs a way to store more pressure and save it over time for use when he truly needs it.
So aside from merely compressing it, he also needs to create a containment for the stored pressure.
"Let me review this again," Kent said, using his fingers as counters.
"I need to create a way to absorb the soul pressure that would be produced from keeping the Underworld Soul River active for over ten seconds.
Then I must compress that pressure into a minute form, perfect for channelling into a beam, and also store them.
But once compressed, if I didn’t need it right away, I would have to store it and keep it contained, or it would explode within my Soul Universe.
Once that is achieved, the next thing is to transform it into a beam and fire." He took a breather, and then he let a weak smile appear on his face.

"Compressing and storing is now the issue. There is just too much volatility if I don’t handle it well. However, if I were to first break it down and compress, then there would also be severe loss, the kind that would make it difficult to even store it."

He laughed and then sent his mind back to his life on Earth. Before he became a movie director, he was one of the brilliant computer engineers. He had two master’s degrees in computer engineering, so he could be considered a prodigy.
However, here he was, cracking his brain to solve a mystical problem. What he is attempting is something impossible when many parameters are included.
Compressing pressure and turning it into a beam is just not possible.
So, despite being a prodigy in engineering and technology, what he is attempting is not easily solved.
He needed to understand the nature of things and how best to handle all forms of variables before attempting to compress pressure, let alone store it.
"This is some interdimensional shit; however, I didn’t get my two master’s degrees by playing around. This is where I apply it."
Kent dug deep into his mind, reviewing many engineering formulas and doing his best to make sense of them. If he can’t solve the mystery with mysticism, then he must apply technology.
Several hours later, an idea popped into his mind, making him smile weakly.
"This could work."

He waved his hand, and a pen appeared. Then, like drawing in the air, he drew a much smaller version of the Death Star Cannon. Then, once that was done, he created several tentacles and linked them to the main weapon.
Then, at the end of each tentacle, he drew several orbs (containers).

"If I can’t compress and store the soul pressure in the same chamber, then why not store them in separate chambers. This way, I just need to tap into the chambers separately and unleash the compressed pressure stored in them."
A smile appeared on his face as he watched the architecture of what he aimed to achieve float before him.
"This could indeed work. Although it would take a lot more soul essence, there is no doubt that this is the solution. I can even add more storage orbs later, should in case Ineed more."
Kent allowed himself to feel proud. Then, once that was out of the way, he refined the architecture and system design, ensuring every atomic detail was refined and perfected.
Once all these things were in order, he initiated the creation process.
[Creation Process of the Death Star Cannon has started. Duration: 60 days]
"It can take all the time in the universe. As long as the end product comes out how I wanted, I have no problem with how long it would take."
Kent stayed inside the Soul Universe for a few more minutes before coming out. Once he was out, he looked up and gazed at the portal to the 5th floor of the Void Temple open.
"I hope the next opponent is strong enough so they can push me to use more of the Underworld Soul River. If possible, I want to even be able to use the Blood Calamity Fist."
It is no exaggeration to say he had been disappointed in the Void Temple masters so far. They didn’t pose much threat to him, not even by a long shot. So he was disappointed.
However, he is also aware that he has become much stronger than when he entered the Void Forest, so there is that. But he expected better from them.
"Gaap, let’s go. The faster we finish this, the better. We can even focus on other things."
Gaap nodded and transformed into his sword form and flew into Kent’s hand. Then, with a sudden leap, he entered the portal.
[5th Floor]

Just when Kent appeared on the 5th floor, his gaze turned cold, and a pale look appeared on his face. Suddenly, his body froze in place, and, as if he were being moved, an invisible force took hold of him and pulled him forward.
He travelled several km in less than a second. When he was freed, his gaze turned even colder, and the paleness on his face became even whiter.

[Creation Process of the Death Star Cannon has started.
Duration: 60 days]
"It can take all the time in the universe.
As long as the end product comes out how I wanted, I have no problem with how long it would take."
Kent stayed inside the Soul Universe for a few more minutes before coming out.
Once he was out, he looked up and gazed at the portal to the 5th floor of the Void Temple open.
"I hope the next opponent is strong enough so they can push me to use more of the Underworld Soul River.
If possible, I want to even be able to use the Blood Calamity Fist."
It is no exaggeration to say he had been disappointed in the Void Temple masters so far.
They didn’t pose much threat to him, not even by a long shot.
So he was disappointed.
However, he is also aware that he has become much stronger than when he entered the Void Forest, so there is that.
But he expected better from them.
"Gaap, let’s go.
The faster we finish this, the better.
We can even focus on other things."
Gaap nodded and transformed into his sword form and flew into Kent’s hand.
Then, with a sudden leap, he entered the portal.
[5th Floor]
Just when Kent appeared on the 5th floor, his gaze turned cold, and a pale look appeared on his face.
Suddenly, his body froze in place, and, as if he were being moved, an invisible force took hold of him and pulled him forward.
He travelled several km in less than a second.
When he was freed, his gaze turned even colder, and the paleness on his face became even whiter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1334: The Void Legion
paragraphs: Everything happened so fast that before Kent knew it, he was standing before three dangerous-looking void beasts.
Before even looking at their appearance, Kent’s focus shifted to something else, something that made him feel like he had finally stepped into a deep one...
The three void beasts before him are immortals, just like how he expected.

However, their strength is just beyond what he expected. One of them is a True Immortal with seven immortal Qi, the second is an Immortal King with 8 immortal Qi, and the last is an Immortal Monarch with 9 immortal Qi.
Basically, there is no telling just what kind of monsters he was about to face. In fact, the Immortal Monarch has a terrifying appearance.

He is a hooded humanoid with six appendage-like wings on his back. In his grip are two curved swords, each about 3 meters long, and a halo-like diagram hovers behind him, designed with intricate void runes.

As for the Immortal King, he is also a humanoid; however, unlike the Immortal Monarch, he has no appendages on his back. Instead, a batlike wing folded behind, exuding a shadowy mist. There is also a razor-sharp spear in his firm grip.
And for the True Immortal, he has green eyes and a humanoid appearance, but with loads of face tattoos. They each glow with a deep blue hue, and the more he looks at Kent, the more they glow.
He held a bow and a quiver behind him.
Kent could tell they were far stronger than their cultivation bases simply from the aura surrounding them. However, he also didn’t focus on that since he had to get ready for battle.
"Took you long enough, Chaos Dragon." Just when Kent was getting ready for battle, the Immortal Monarch spoke, making him shift his attention to him.
Being called Chaos Dragon means he knew him personally, something he found shocking, so he chose to focus on that first.
"So you know who I am?"
"I do. In fact, I know more about you than you yourself do."

"This means you are from the Primordial Era, huh?" Kent asked despite already knowing the answer. He most certainly never expected the last floor temple masters, who appear to be from the Primordial Era.
However, that changes nothing. He still has to battle them, so he wasn’t about to become friendly with them.
"So what, did you three have some long beef with me that the passage of time couldn’t take away? I mean, waiting all this while just to battle me when I am still weak is not something healthy, guys."
Kent smirked and then tightened his grip on his sword.
The three void beasts smiled, and one of them—the Immortal King—stepped forward and pointed his spear at Kent.
"Last 5 minutes with me or defeat me in close combat, and we will tell you who we are and what we are doing here."

"Unconventional, but why not?" Kent moved and appeared before the Immortal King, landing a vertical slash. However, the Immortal King sidestepped and stabbed with his spear, aiming to pierce Kent’s shoulder. The movement was quick, showing the speed at which he could move.
Thankfully, Kent knew better than to underestimate an Immortal King. So he activate all 120,000 flame veins. That enabled him to track and dodge the spear stab.
His speed matched the Immortal King.
However, even though he managed to dodge, when the Immortal King struck forward with his palm, Kent found himself in a bind.

It was either that he used his sword to block the palm strike, which in turn would leave him open for the Immortal King to attack with his spear, or he used his left hand to brace, which would leave his left side exposed.

The only way out for him is to use a movement technique to evade. In the end, Kent chose an unconventional method. He summoned his dragon scale and coated his chest with it. Then, using his body, he took on the palm strike.
A powerful force moved through his body.
However, instead of taking in the pain, he channelled it into an attack.
The moment the Immortal King landed the palm strike on his chest, he was also left exposed to an attack from Kent.
The play that Kent came up with was very simple. He would tank the palm strike with his chest, and then take advantage of the opening that would appear in the immortal Kings defense.
Of course, the whole plan lay on the event that he can take on the attack without being pushed back.
So he first coated his body with dragon scales, then channelled 30,000 blood runes, using their power to strengthen himself.
But even so, he felt pain move deep into his ribs. However, with the advantage he got, he attacked, aiming his sword at the immortal King’s shoulder.

He moved back and tried to evade. However, the moment he did that, Kent smiled and moved forward, passing by the True Immortal like a ghost. His hand also moved with him, and before the immortal could make a move, Kent gripped his shoulder.
He channelled all his energy into his hand and then, like beating a drum, he slammed the Immortal King to the ground.
"You lost, Kailan," the Immortal Monarch said, smiling under his hood.
Kailan, who decided to remain on the ground despite Kent standing over him, also smiled and shook his head. Then, in a manner Kent never expected, he gave him his hand to pull him up.

Kent, from the moment they started the battle, knew these three void beasts were not planning on killing him. In fact, it seems they merely wanted to test him, so when he defeated Kailan, instead of killing him, which he could have easily done, he chose not to.
Now, it seems his assumption is true. The three void beasts are not his enemies. But if they are not, then what the hell are they doing in the temple that he is challenging?
After helping him stand up, Kent turned and looked at the Immortal Monarch...
"Are you going to tell me who you three are now?"
"Looks like you still have your touch, master."
"Master...?" Kent furrowed his brow, unsure of how to handle what he had just heard. An Immortal Monarch who is a Void Beast, just called him master.
There is no way in hell he is a master of void beasts.

"Looks like you are still recovering your memories. But that is also okay... My name is Axiom, a Void Architect. The one with the bow is Kol; he is a Void Archer, while the one you defeated is Kailan.
We three are a part of a group of 69 void beasts that once followed the Primordial Chaos Dragon into battle. We were once known as the Void Legion."
Kent remained standing, unsure of what to even think...

Axiom, Kailan, and Kol stood side by side, a smile playing on their lips as they watched Kent go through several emotions. His mind is going through so much that if he were to stop, he might just lose his mind.
So for ten good minutes, he remained rooted in the same spot, thinking, digesting, and doing his best to make sense of what he had just heard.
In the end, all he could say was:
"What the fuck..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1335: The Fated Call
paragraphs: This is one of those moments when nothing makes sense. No matter how hard he tried to make sense of it, he always arrived at the point where it all became a mess.

Kent is already aware that during the primordial era, when the Great War entered a dangerous phase after the universe’s guardians abandoned it and ascended, the chaos dragon used his soul to call into the future, his voice travelling through space and time to summon 13 legions.
From those thirteen, he had already met a member from the Lost Knights Legion, some members from the Undead Legion, Eternal Wrath Legion, Soul Sentinel Legion, and the Night Riders Legion.
He had already met 5, leaving him with 8 more to go.
Now it seems he had met the 6th. However, that is where the confusion starts.
If, when the chaos dragon called into the future, thirteen legions appeared, then doesn’t that mean the Void Legion, which was formed by Chaos, was already there with him?
Shouldn’t that mean only 12 legions should have appeared?
Things don’t add up.
There is just no way he is mistaken or, worse, fallen for the scheme of the three void beasts before him.
’They did not seem like the lying type. However, there is also no connection between us to show that they are indeed my legion. I have a connection to the other legions, so why not them?
Of course, inside the void temple, all connections to the tower have been severed. However, at least since they are in the same place, he should have at least some form of connection to them.
But since that is not an option at the moment, he can only resort to using questions.
"You claim you are a part of the Void Legion, right?"
"Yes."

"Then how come you three aren’t even demigods? If there is one thing I know about Chaos, he hates weaklings. So while you seven are at the moment more powerful than I, I know he wouldn’t have chosen you three as his subordinates.
I know it is harsh to hear, but Chaos would never choose you three because you are weak. I know I wouldn’t, so why don’t you tell me who you are really?"
"That is too harsh, Master Chaos," Axiom said with a little chuckle.
"Yes, Master. It seems you have become harsher than you were during the primordial era," Kailan added, also smiling with an amused expression on his face.
"I don’t know about that. I mean, we both know he is a vengeful person, and all vengeful people are bitter and harsher than you can imagine. So I think he is the same as before, just a bit grumpy."
"Kol is right. I believe he is grumpy too."
Kent stood there, his expression turning from one emotion to another, unsure of how to handle these three. While he was seriously looking for an explanation, they seemed to be having fun.
There is just no way he expected that. But even if he did, he most certainly wouldn’t have expected them to be making fun of him.
He was harsh, that much is true. However, he is in no way grumpy.
"I am not grumpy."

"There is no need to deny anything, Master. From where we stand, we perfectly understand you. I mean, we basically betrayed our race by joining your legion. We killed people who were our friends to protect your interests. So if anyone understood your grumpiness, it would be us."
Axiom and his pals laughed, leaving Kent to stand there, unsure of what to even say at this point. He took a deep sigh, and then he focused his attention back on them.
"If you are indeed part of the Void Legion, then prove it."
"With pleasure," Axiom waved his hand, and a white pebble appeared in his palm. "Everything you need to at least confirm our identity is here."
He threw it at Kent, who caught it and gave it a gentle look before placing it in his mouth. In a way, he knew just what to do with the pebble.
So he swallowed it.
The moment he did, he blacked out. However, in less than two seconds, he recovered. At once, his expression turned calm, and a sense of clarity shone in his gaze.
It appeared he had received some important memories.
He said nothing to Axiom and his pals; instead, he sat down and decided to make sense of what he had just seen.
The pebble contained memories of Chaos when he became a demigod. Kent had yet to reach the level where Chaos started clashing with the Void Beasts in the memories he had recovered before today.
However, in this memory, he was a demigod.
In a way, Kent had no idea how, how Chaos found himself in the Void Universe, the same place the Void Beasts came from.
A few hours after he arrived in the void universe, he accidentally ventured into a place similar to a prison.
There, he met 69 imprisoned void beasts, each a terror beyond measure.
At first, Chaos didn’t understand their language; however, after several days there, he began picking up a few words. This made him decide to learn their language so he could communicate with them.
After about 6 months there, he managed to finally have a meaningful conversation with them. It was then he found out they were criminals, or that was how they were branded.
All 69 of them are powerful warriors. It was through their conversation that he discovered something very peculiar.
"Tell me about the Nine, Twenty, and Forty rule." Kent suddenly asked, making Axiom and the three void beasts smile.
"Finally, we are making some progress," Kol said before Axiom started to answer the question.
"Nine leaders, twenty vices, and forty workers."
"What are you three then? Which category were you back then?"
"I was a leader," Axiom said.
"I was a vice," Kailan also answered.
"And I was a worker," finally, Kol answered, nodding.

Inside the prison, he met nine supreme void beasts, the leaders of the prison. Under them were the twenty vices, who were Universal Gods. Then came the workers, who were all within the ranks of a god.
Later, they swore an allegiance to him with a good promise. They would fight for him if he freed them. Chaos freed them since he needed help completing the mission he came to the void universe for.
Now, even after finally verifying their identities, something else is bothering him. This, of course, is the notion of the 13 legions coming from the future to aid him during the Great War.

’This is the last life for me. All 13 lives had passed, meaning all 13 legions had been formed already. So Chaos is the first, then it means there should have been 12 legions instead of 13 that came from the future.

This also means if the Void Legion was already with Chaos, considering he left the Void Universe with all 69 of them, then where did the 13th legion come from? Even better question, who is the 13th legion that heeded the Fated Call and came through the Time and Space portal?
One last question, if the Void Legion were indeed with Chaos when he made the call, then does that mean there were 14 legions instead of 13?
"What the hell is going on..."
Kent has yet again lost his mind over something he had no idea how to make heads or tails of.
Axiom and his two pals wore smiles.
Meanwhile, at the core of the universe, a different conversation was underway...

chapters.title: Chapter 1336: Beaten By a Mortal
paragraphs: [Core of the Universe]

Lady Universe held a calm gaze on the faces of the four cosmic beings who were with her at the core of the universe. On the screen before them, Kent could be seen conversing with Axiom, Kailan, and Kol.
Obviously, from the look on their faces, none of them saw this coming. None of them expected the last floor temple master to be three void beasts who, in a way, are linked to Kent.
"How did this happen?" Lady Universe asked, her expression calm. However, she seemed confused about what she was looking at.

"I have no idea. From what the timeline showed, the void legion fell before the fated call. All 69 of them died, and through their grief, the chaos dragon finally made his move. So I have no idea why they are still alive, and even worse, how they became masters of the void temple."

Enchantress, who is responsible for the correct flow of the timeline, even failed to see this anomaly. If there was a way for the void legion to survive, the only person who should have at least known was the Guardian of the Universe Timeline.
But she was ignorant of what happened, and now it seems the implications would be severe if not handled well.

"Before we point fingers, how about we examine the timeline again and see if there are any branches. We both know the moment branches started appearing, calamity would descend. So let’s see that first," Fate proposed, already sensing that the three people standing before Kent are Fateless.
They do not have fate, which, in a way, is concerning.

Someone without a fate is like a danger to the universe. They can do whatever they want without any repercussions. Fateless are branded criminals and, as such, subjected to all kinds of restrictions to keep them in check.

However, if a Fateless meant it, no matter the restriction, they wouldn’t care. So they are dangerous, and as such, all five cosmic beings are now concerned about whether their appearance was good or bad.
The Enchantress pulled up the timeline. However, even after closer examination, nothing appeared wrong with the timeline.
But that is where the problem is. As Fateless and beings that, as far as the universe is concerned, are dead, appearing alive and well should have raised red flags.
"This doesn’t make sense at all. It is like we were played by a mortal," Destiny said with a giggle, maintaining her usual smile.
Just like how the three void beasts are Fateless, they also do not have destiny, and looking at the frown on Karma’s face, it is clear he has no hold on them, either.

"But how did he do it? How was he able to keep the void beasts alive, put them inside void temples, and, worst, make them Fateless?" Lady Universe asked, her expression still calm, and the confusion could still be seen in her eyes.
None of them has any idea how. However, their interest has been piqued. They would closely examine the three Void Beasts and see if they could figure out something.
"I feel played," Karma suddenly said, looking at Kent on the screen.

"This was supposed to be a trial as payment for the karma he was owing me. However, not only did he gain more, but he also manipulated the trial from beyond the grave." He looks pissed and, well, defeated.
Kent had defeated him several times in the past. However, just when he felt like he was finally about to win, the worst happened.
"Are you going to cry about it?" Destiny, of course, didn’t care what Kent did. In her heart, someone who once saved the universe can do as he pleases. In her book, he had earned it.
So in a way, she is happy since she would get to tease Karma with it.
However, she also understood just how severe this discovery was...
"Just how did he do it? None of us saw through him."

While the five cosmic beings were left stunned, unsure of how to make sense of the fact that people who were supposed to be dead are now alive and even managed to hijack a void temple, Kent was having a different conversation with his void legion.

"So let me get this straight. You three, in addition to the void legion, died during the great war; however, I somehow managed to send you back in time to the point where you were merely Immortal Monarchs, Kailan an Immortal King, and Kol a True Immortal.

But even worse, I didn’t just send you back; I found a way to let you keep your future memories. And from those memories, I made sure you weren’t arrested by the void beast council in the first place and thrown in prison, like how it should have happened.
The rest of the course was for you losers to find a way to return to me. You three, however, decided to hijack a Void Temple, and now here you are."
"More or less, that was what happened."
"I wonder why you were arrested in the first place. Hijacking a void temple, really?"
Axiom and his pals laughed, "In our defence, living in the Void Universe is boring. It wasn’t like we could slaughter them from there. Doing so would have invoked the wrath of the Void Overlords.
However, now that we are here, we can hunt down other void temples, and since we are void beasts, we can easily enter and slaughter the temple masters."
Axiom pulled his hood, revealing a rather handsome face. He looks like a human, but he has a third eye on his forehead.
"You weren’t the only smart one, Master. We learned a lot of stuff from you, so don’t be surprised when you meet the others. Knowing the 9 leaders, we are diabolical by nature."
"Unbelievable," Kent sighed. "I mean, how did I even manage to send you back in time after you died? That is not possible, at least by the standard of how time, life, death, and space work."
"We also don’t know. However, a couple of years before the Great War, you mentioned something along the lines of Origin Law. That is all we know."
Kent was confused by Kol’s answer, but the same could not be said of the cosmic beings. They all held shocked expressions.
Clearly, this Origin Law is something powerful. Perhaps powerful enough that it allowed Chaos to even fool cosmic beings as powerful as the origin laws of the universe: Fate, Destiny, and Karma.
"I probably would know more later. However, now that you are here, what next?"
"Very simple, actually. 120 void temples were sent this time around. 119 landed in what you call the immortal worlds, and this one came here. We may have affected it somehow, causing it to end here.
Of course, knowing what you are capable of, there is no telling if the three of us are still dancing on your puppet string or if you have your fingers wrapped around Fate’s neck.
But the fact that we ended up here is no coincidence.
However, now that we are here, you must become an immortal in the next 5,000 years, or else the other void temples would open, and you already know what would happen after that."

"We still have time, so they can wait," Kent said, then an evil smile appeared on his face. "However, since you are now here, why don’t you hand over your storage pouches? I believe you brought some fancy void treasures, right?"
The smile on their faces froze.

"I knew it, he is still the shameless dragon we know. He even has no shame, robbing your own subordinates in broad daylight," Kol said in a defeated tone. In the end, he handed over his storage pouch.
Kailan and Axiom followed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1337: Bello
paragraphs: "Are you really going to take everything inside our storage pouches?" Axiom asked, almost shedding tears.
Kent ignored him, a smile playing on his face as he looked into the three storage pouches hovering before him. They are the storage pouches he took for his three new void legion.
After a few minutes, he looked up and grinned...
"Looks like you three came prepared."

"Of course, we came prepared. The moment we hijacked the Void Temple, we became criminals and can never return to the Void Universe, so we have to take all we can with us," Kailan responded, looking at Kent with a calm expression.
"Well, that is good then." Kent waved his hand, and three things appeared. When Axiom and his pals saw this, they only sighed, knowing what they feared had come to pass.

"I will be taking these three. However, that doesn’t mean if I need more, I wouldn’t ask for it." Kent stored the three things in his space ring and added in a reassuring tone... "Don’t worry, we will one day return to the Void Universe, and just like what we did the last time, we will plunder their treasure houses."

Hearing his words, the three Void beasts smiled. At least with that plan, they would recover the pain of losing a Void Liquid Essence, Void Domain Flower, and the most important of them all, the Void Rune Key.
All three of these are things that, if used, Kent’s mastery in the path of Void will take a huge leap.
"Since we have settled that, how about you three bring the true Temple Master out so I can kill him and be done with this trial?"
Axiom nodded and snapped his finger. The void cracked, and from within, a Core Immortal, shackled on both arms and legs, fell through and landed on the ground.
Kent looked at the poor guy and sighed, "One last thing, do you have any techniques on Void Mastery and perhaps a few martial void techniques?"
"I do. Does Master Chaos need them right now?"
"No. I will need them when we return home."
Axiom nodded, walking back to let Kent handle the shackled Void beast’s Temple Master.
"Should I free him so you can have a good battle with him?" Axiom asked, and Kent thought for a moment before he nodded.
"Why not?"
Axiom nodded and snapped his finger again. The chains binding the void temple master’s arms and legs broke... "Summon your weapon and let’s have a go. I need to stretch my legs at least."
One could see the fear in the poor guy’s reddish eyes. He is not afraid of Kent; his fear is directed at the three void beasts standing behind him.

However, he obeyed and summoned a bow. Seeing this, Kent’s brow furrowed. However, instead of calling off the battle since he knew it wouldn’t be close combat, the idea of dodging and defending against deadly arrows filled him with so much adrenaline.
He pointed his jagged sword at the Temple Master and muttered, "Come at me."
An arrow flew out from the bow, arriving before Kent like a ghost.
It was instantaneous, something that can take anyone by surprise if their reaction speed is dull.
However, he swung his sword, and the arrow was severed. But he was forced to duck in that instance when a second arrow came right after the first.
"Excellent display of marksmanship, but I am faster than your arrow."
Kent took a step forward and slightly turned his neck, letting a third arrow move past his cheek. He felt the cold air of the arrow pass by his cheek.
However, he took a second step and closed in by several meters on the Temple Master. Seeing this, he also moved back and fired another arrow. But this time, Kent summoned his Chaos Scale Shield.
The arrow landed on it, and instead of shattering it, it was rather the tip of the arrow that broke.
Axiom, Kailan, and Kol smiled seeing this. They saw the power of the Chaos Scale Shield when they met Chaos in the void universe.
They later witnessed its might during the many battles they fought together.
So seeing it again, past memories resurfaced.
"It seems Master had made so much progress very early into his journey this time," Kol said, already comparing the Chaos then and him now.
"What do you expect? Just like us, he also has his past life memories, so it is only normal." Axiom said, watching as Kent closed the gap between him and the Temple Master.
"It is over."
Just when Kol said that, Kent took another step, and he was before the Temple Master. His hand grabbed the arrow that had formed with the bow’s frame.
SIGH

To Kent’s shock, the Temple Master merely sighed and then let go of the bow. He had given up already, aware that this battle was lost. He is a Core Immortal with four Immortal Qi, but that wasn’t enough to stop Kent.
Of course, there was also the part where he was imprisoned inside the void for many years. He was probably weak and mentally broken, so death seemed like the easiest way out for him.
"What is your name?" Kent asked, feeling some form of sympathy for the guy. He hated the Void Beasts, but not as much as he did against the Forsaken Race.
"Bello."
"Well, Bello. It is either you die, or I do. However, I have over two dozen angels waiting for me back home, so I would have to kill you now."
He said nothing; however, he had already resolved to die. Seeing this, Kent just sighed and gently tapped on his chest. He closed his eyes, and that was that.
Kent didn’t want to stab him with his sword or use any other painful way he uses to kill enemies, so he merely snuffed his soul, ending him peacefully.
"You have become soft, Master," Axiom said, flying toward Kent. Kailan and Kol followed.
"He had suffered enough thanks to you three, so I just freed him. Now I have a Void Bow."
"Yeah. If you knew what the Void Beasts are planning for your precious universe, I am sure you would have a different opinion of them," Kol said; however, Kent didn’t seem to care.
"Sometimes, it is best to remind yourself that in this battle for survival, not all of us are emotionless. If I can’t show simple compassion, then I might as well join the Void Beasts."
"Yeah, I hate compassion, so when they come, I will be killing them all using the most painful way possible."
Kent turned, looking dumbfounded at Kailan. "Remind me how they arrested you and dumped you in the prison in the first place."
"I killed my friend’s girlfriend because she cheated on him with my bro’s enemy."
"Well, I would have done the same, but the point here is, you could have tortured her and made sure her heart only had one room for your friend."
"She was the daughter of a Void Shaman. Torturing her was impossible," Kailan said with a grin, making Kent chuckle.
"I guess you did nothing wrong."
"I knew you would understand, Master."
"Whatever..." Kent turned his focus from the three Void Beasts so he could see the message that appeared after he killed the Temple Master.
[You have killed the fifth Temple Master, Bello Voidchild]
[You have received the Fifth Temple Key.]
[Congratulations, you are now the master of the Void Temple.]
[You have obtained a Soul Warrior Candidate]
