chapters.title: Chapter 1338: Leaving The Void Temple
paragraphs: ’Another one, huh?’
Kent smiled, seeing he had obtained yet again another Soul Warrior Candidate.
This means, aside from Calix and the one he was in the process of creating, he had obtained a third candidate who, from the look of things, would become a Core Immortal after the creation process.
’I wonder if he will maintain all four Immortal Qi after becoming a Soul Warrior,’ Kent said inwardly, his mind already looking forward to seeing what would become of his three Soul Warriors.
Vexthra already told him that when entering the Star Gateway, he cannot take anyone with him or summon anyone once he is inside.
This means he will not be able to talk to his wives and legion.
However, what if he doesn’t have to summon anyone—what if the summon is instead a technique he can use in a way it cannot be considered summoning?

In a way, the Soul Warriors are merely a technique linked to his Soul Universe, so since he won’t be barred from using his technique while inside the Star Gateway, it means he can summon his Soul Warriors to aid him while there.
The heavens know he will need them for what is coming.

Unlike the Void Temple that was compromised by his Void Legion, the Star Gateway isn’t going to be that simple. Kent had no idea how hard it would be, but Vexthra told him it would be extremely dangerous.
So for now, he was preparing for that. It was also why he planned on using the flame source he found on the first floor to create his second flame core and form more flame veins.
However, before that, he had to kill the other three beasts required to start the creation process of the portal that would take him much closer to the edge of the galaxy.
’I should handle one thing at a time then.’
Kent turned to Axiom, Kailan, and Kol... "Give me a few minutes to handle something important, then we can leave."

He entered the Soul Universe and quickly made his way to the location where the creation process would take place. The second Soul Warrior, currently in the process of being created, would take 30 days.
This time around, it seemed the process would take even longer. After he initiated the creation process, he saw it would take 42 days.
Naturally, that was a long time. That is a lot of time to wait, but while it should have taken him years to clear the void temple as expected, he knew 42 days were just around the corner.
Iinitial estimation was 5 years tops. But it had been less than 5 months since he entered the void forest, and now, he is leaving.
He soon left the Soul Universe and started preparing to leave the temple. A few minutes later, he was standing outside the red pagoda.
Once outside, he waved his hand, and five runes shaped like keys flew and merged with the pagoda. A few seconds later, the pagoda shrank and vanished into the Soul Universe.
Kent soon started making his way out of the Void Forest.
[Planet Gemini - Enkay’s POV]
Enkay is one of Uncle Drew’s Night Agents. In fact, he is the first of them and also the strongest. He had already reached the peak of the True Immortal stage and had formed seven Immortal Qi.
Uncle Drew and Nyx had poured a lot of resources into making him strong simply to send him to the Immortal Realm to look for the planet that Kaelith is being held on.
So for the past months, he had been travelling, moving from one planet to the next in search of the planet where the Divine Flame Roc race lived.
Today, finally, he had arrived on Planet Gemini, the homeworld of the divine flame rocs.
The moment the ship landed, he disembarked and swiftly made his way to the nearest information broker. Those people are most often found in inns, so he asked around and found a popular inn.
An hour later, he managed to secure the information he was after and left. Five hours later, he arrived atop a tall mountain where he could see a large city in the distance.

"How majestic," he muttered, looking at the buildings majestically lined and spaced. They were built using some of the precious jade stones and heavily protected and reinforced by formations and arrays.
Within this vast city, inside a small room where thick chains could be seen attached to hooks, sat Kaelith, his flesh sticking to his bones.
He had no idea his saviours were just a snap away.
For thousands of years now, not even water had touched his lips. However, as an immortal, death wasn’t something he expected, not when a casual beheading wouldn’t even kill him.
Enkay stood there for a couple of minutes before he tapped into the connection he shared with Uncle Drew.
"Master, I have located the asset."
Inside the Mountain Garden, Uncle Drew stood up and turned to Avotha, Lene, and Vargus... "Time to get to work."
They nodded and also stood up. However, just when they were about to move, Kent appeared inside the Mountain Garden.
"Are you guys going somewhere?" Kent asked.
When he left the Void Forest, he wanted to have some discussions with Thousand Blade, the immortal Lord who opened the seal for him.
However, he would it he returned to the immortal realm and hadn’t returned yet, so he decided to come to the tower and wait for him.

Kent knew now was the best time to connect with the Midnight Shadows. The earlier he gets hold of affairs there, the more he can use them to look for the threats he is aware would soon descend on the universe if they haven’t already.
"My Night Agent has just located the planet on which Kaelith is being held, so we are leaving to go rescue him."
"Oh, sounds like I came just on time." Kent smiled, then he asked, "Care if I tag along?"
"Why not?" They were going against immortals and demigods, perhaps even a few gods, but none of them looked afraid. Every last one of them, Uncle Drew included, wasn’t exactly an ordinary warrior.
Kent reached out to his connection with Vexthra and told her to be on standby.
If a god were to appear and make things hard for them, then Vexthra would come to their aid. Of course, there would be a backlash, but Vexthra already told him she could handle it.
"Let’s go."
Uncle Drew nodded and waved his hand, opening a hell portal. He walked through, and the demigods followed. Kent was last to enter.

When he entered the portal, it felt like he was back in hell again. It was super cold, which in a way was concerning. After all, there is this notion that hell is super hot. However, this time, it was cold—so cold, in fact, that it shouldn’t be normal.
However, it was only for a moment before he appeared atop the mountain Enkay was standing on. Uncle Drew introduced them, and then they got to work.
Avotha scanned the city and quickly located where Kaelith was held. However, his scan was sensed by a few demigods.
"There are a lot of immortals and five demigods. Three are much closer to us, so we have to engage them first. However, to get to Kaelith, we must also be ready to clash with quite a few immortals."
Kent nodded, then retrieved the Void Temple and summoned Axiom, Kailan, and Kol. He introduced them to the team, then continued with his plan.
"I will handle the rescue part of the mission with these three while you five take care of the demigods."

"Are you sure? There are Immortal Lords within their ranks," Lene asked, sounding protective of Kent. After all, he is only a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator, and Nara told her to keep her husband safe.
"Worry not, Lene. I have some ace up my sleeve."
She nodded, but she planned on keeping her focus on him.
"In that case, the moment I give the signal, you all should retreat. If things go sideways, don’t hesitate to make a run for it. I will be fine."
They nodded and left for the city, where a major battle awaited them.

sentences.text: ’Another one, huh?’
Kent smiled, seeing he had obtained yet again another Soul Warrior Candidate.
This means, aside from Calix and the one he was in the process of creating, he had obtained a third candidate who, from the look of things, would become a Core Immortal after the creation process.
’I wonder if he will maintain all four Immortal Qi after becoming a Soul Warrior,’ Kent said inwardly, his mind already looking forward to seeing what would become of his three Soul Warriors.
Vexthra already told him that when entering the Star Gateway, he cannot take anyone with him or summon anyone once he is inside.
This means he will not be able to talk to his wives and legion.
However, what if he doesn’t have to summon anyone—what if the summon is instead a technique he can use in a way it cannot be considered summoning?

In a way, the Soul Warriors are merely a technique linked to his Soul Universe, so since he won’t be barred from using his technique while inside the Star Gateway, it means he can summon his Soul Warriors to aid him while there.
The heavens know he will need them for what is coming.
Unlike the Void Temple that was compromised by his Void Legion, the Star Gateway isn’t going to be that simple.
Kent had no idea how hard it would be, but Vexthra told him it would be extremely dangerous.
So for now, he was preparing for that.
It was also why he planned on using the flame source he found on the first floor to create his second flame core and form more flame veins.
However, before that, he had to kill the other three beasts required to start the creation process of the portal that would take him much closer to the edge of the galaxy.
’I should handle one thing at a time then.’
Kent turned to Axiom, Kailan, and Kol...
"Give me a few minutes to handle something important, then we can leave."
He entered the Soul Universe and quickly made his way to the location where the creation process would take place.
The second Soul Warrior, currently in the process of being created, would take 30 days.
This time around, it seemed the process would take even longer.
After he initiated the creation process, he saw it would take 42 days.
Naturally, that was a long time.
That is a lot of time to wait, but while it should have taken him years to clear the void temple as expected, he knew 42 days were just around the corner.
Iinitial estimation was 5 years tops.
But it had been less than 5 months since he entered the void forest, and now, he is leaving.
He soon left the Soul Universe and started preparing to leave the temple.
A few minutes later, he was standing outside the red pagoda.
Once outside, he waved his hand, and five runes shaped like keys flew and merged with the pagoda.
A few seconds later, the pagoda shrank and vanished into the Soul Universe.
Kent soon started making his way out of the Void Forest.

Enkay is one of Uncle Drew’s Night Agents.
In fact, he is the first of them and also the strongest.
He had already reached the peak of the True Immortal stage and had formed seven Immortal Qi.
Uncle Drew and Nyx had poured a lot of resources into making him strong simply to send him to the Immortal Realm to look for the planet that Kaelith is being held on.
So for the past months, he had been travelling, moving from one planet to the next in search of the planet where the Divine Flame Roc race lived.
Today, finally, he had arrived on Planet Gemini, the homeworld of the divine flame rocs.
The moment the ship landed, he disembarked and swiftly made his way to the nearest information broker.
Those people are most often found in inns, so he asked around and found a popular inn.
An hour later, he managed to secure the information he was after and left.
Five hours later, he arrived atop a tall mountain where he could see a large city in the distance.
"How majestic," he muttered, looking at the buildings majestically lined and spaced.
They were built using some of the precious jade stones and heavily protected and reinforced by formations and arrays.
Within this vast city, inside a small room where thick chains could be seen attached to hooks, sat Kaelith, his flesh sticking to his bones.
He had no idea his saviours were just a snap away.
For thousands of years now, not even water had touched his lips.
However, as an immortal, death wasn’t something he expected, not when a casual beheading wouldn’t even kill him.
Enkay stood there for a couple of minutes before he tapped into the connection he shared with Uncle Drew.
"Master, I have located the asset."
Inside the Mountain Garden, Uncle Drew stood up and turned to Avotha, Lene, and Vargus...
"Time to get to work."

"Oh, sounds like I came just on time." Kent smiled, then he asked, "Care if I tag along?"

Every last one of them, Uncle Drew included, wasn’t exactly an ordinary warrior.
Kent reached out to his connection with Vexthra and told her to be on standby.
If a god were to appear and make things hard for them, then Vexthra would come to their aid.
Of course, there would be a backlash, but Vexthra already told him she could handle it.
"Let’s go."
Uncle Drew nodded and waved his hand, opening a hell portal.
He walked through, and the demigods followed.
Kent was last to enter.
When he entered the portal, it felt like he was back in hell again.
It was super cold, which in a way was concerning.
After all, there is this notion that hell is super hot.
However, this time, it was cold—so cold, in fact, that it shouldn’t be normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1339: Kaelith’s Rescue (1)
paragraphs: "Looks like they are waiting for us," Uncle Drew said just as they approached the city.
Three demigods hovered before the gate, their focus rooted on them. Behind them, hundreds of immortals could be seen, with even a dozen being immortal Lords.
It seemed the scan Avotha did spook them.
"It seems so. However, that changes nothing," Kent said, flying before the team. He was the weakest of them, yet he was leading—a clear indication of who was in charge.
"Let’s talk to them first. I have some stuff to say to them before things get ugly," Kent said, his speed increasing. A few seconds later, they were 100 meters from the gate.
"Who are you and what is your business here in Roc City?" one of the demigods, a handsome fella with nicely cute red hair, asked, his expression hostile.

"Technically, we are outside of Roc City. However, we are here for business, so how about you point us in the direction of a prisoner you have locked away for thousands of years now? I believe his name is Kaelith."
The look on the three demigods and the immortals behind them changed. Kent could tell they didn’t like the mention of Kaelith.
This also meant they were in the right place.
"This is the domain of the Divine Flame Rocs. It would be wise to turn around and leave before incurring our wrath," the demigod spoke again. However, Kent merely turned and looked at Avotha...
"If possible, kill that bastard." Avotha nodded and walked forward.
"It would be wise if you point us in the right direction and let us have our way instead of crossing us. Trust me, it is not worth it," Avotha said, taking out a sword from his space ring.
The demigod and his friends said nothing. However, Kent saw them move forward and form a battle formation.
"Well then, looks like we have to kill them now."
Avotha was the first to move. He took a step forward, arriving before the demigod, his sword going for a dangerous arc.
The demigod, caught off guard, used his hand to brace; however, he was sent flying, crashing through the city door and destroying it in the process. The entire city shuddered from the impact.
"Weak," Avotha said, looking at the demigod, who was already bleeding. He took another step, and he was already upon him again.
Lene and Vargus also moved, and the other two demigods were taken off the board, leaving only the immortals.
"Here we go," Uncle Drew said with a smile before pulling two swords. His eyes burst into green flames, and with that, he was upon the immortals, his aura increasing as he moved.
Enkay also followed, taking on an Immortal Emperor. He may be a True Immortal, but he was no weakling at all.
"Master, be sure not to die," Axiom said before he also jumped into battle. Kailan and Kol followed, their terrifying auras causing the Flame Rocs to shudder long before they approached them.
"Hmm, looks like I am the only one left," Kent said, his expression calm.
He was already out of his league, considering the weak Flame Roc on the battlefield is a Spirit Immortal; however, he didn’t seem to care.

He scanned the battlefield, and then his expression suddenly changed. "We cannot afford to fight a prolonged battle. There are still two demigods and perhaps a god already on the way. We have five minutes to go."
The battle had already become chaotic; however, everyone seemed to be ignoring him. It was as if they didn’t take him seriously, or maybe they wanted to save him for last.
However, Kent had already made his move; he was just waiting for the right time to reveal it.
He stood there for about 45 seconds, then he took one step forward, and he was in the middle of the battlefield. Suddenly, over ten thousand soul spirits appeared, catching everyone off guard.
"When they ask, tell them Kent Madson was here." Kent burst out in resounding laughter as he snapped his finger, causing every last soul spirit to explode.

What followed was the painful scream of thousands of immortals. In what should have been a simple explosion, over 600 immortals ranging from Spirit Immortal to True Immortal collapsed, the majority of them dying from soul damage.
The rest sustained gory soul damage. Not even the Immortal Lords were spared.
"Damn, what was that?" Axiom asked, turning in Kent’s direction. Sensing his gaze, Kent turned in his direction and gave him a wink, then he transformed, taking on his colossal dragon form.
But that wasn’t all; just as he became a dragon, the Chaos Scales appeared and coated his entire body. Then, all 80,000 blood runes also appeared and merged with his body.
Afterwards, the 120,000 flame veins also activated at the same time, and then the Jade Void Wings manifested, merging with his dragon wings.
Kent had transformed from a mortal dragon to a terrifying chaos dragon, the kind that is created to kill and cause severe chaos.
"Catch me if you can."
BUZZZZZZZ
With a flap of his wings, he moved and crashed through over a hundred immortals, killing a couple of dozen while the rest crashed several km away, their bones breaking in the process.
Many Flame Rocs followed him. However, Axiom, Kailan, and Kol followed as well. Their job now was to make sure Kent got to Kaelith in one piece.
"What in the hell was that?" an Immortal Lord asked, clenching his chest from the soul attack caused by the soul spirit explosion.
"I think that is a dragon," one of his pals answered. However, before he could add more context, he sensed danger appear behind him, forcing him to move forward.

But it was already too late. Uncle Drew had already made his move, his sword piercing through his back, appearing on his chest. He tried to pull himself from the sword; however, he regretted that action a second later when his entire body was engulfed in deep green flames.
Uncle Drew was long gone before the second Immortal Lord could make his move.
However, the legendary Kael Duskbane is not an ordinary warrior. He knew he had to kill two birds with one stone, so he went ahead and rigged the bastard he stabbed.
With his pal set on fire and screaming, he did what anyone would do in his position: he went to his rescue.
But just when he got close to putting out the fire, Uncle Drew snapped his finger, exploding the Immortal Lord he had attacked and taking the second Immortal Lord with him.
The core explosion from an Immortal Lord is powerful enough to kill another immortal lord and take a large chunk of the city with it.
"Damnit. Killing Immortal Lords is such a headache," Uncle Drew said with a weak smile, his pale expression showing he had used more than he should.
He is a Death-stage cultivator; however, with a perfect display of battle intelligence, he killed an Immortal Lord.
If he were to face one in a one-on-one battle, he wouldn’t last a minute. However, here he was, complaining about how hard it was to kill an immortal lord.
That is just too much to even consider. However, taking advantage of the soul explosion, he was able to reduce the number of Immortal Lords by two.
"Guys, hurry up," Uncle Drew said to Avotha, Lene, and Vargus, still clashing with the demigods.
Although they were not being pressed, killing a demigod is not easy, so they were taking longer than they should have, given their outnumbered status.
Looking into the distance where a thunderous explosion could be seen, he knew Kent was having fun.

"Who knew he was already this monstrous?" he smiled, but then he added in a concerning tone, "However, that was only possible because of the sneak attack. What then would he do when he is finally surrounded?"
This question, however, was answered the next second when the air suddenly turned hot, and a deadly finger broke through the clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1340: Kaelith’s Rescue (2)
paragraphs: [A Minute before the attack]
Just when Kent flapped his wings and broke through the formation of the Flame Rocs, he found himself drawn much closer to the location where Kaelith was being held.
However, he had to force himself to come to a halt when he sensed more Flame Rocs coming from behind him and in front of him.
It seemed reinforcement came much faster than he anticipated.
But Kent didn’t wait for them to get close to him.

He may have become faster and stronger, but he was still lacking. When facing Immortal Kings and above, he knew he had to be careful. So he did the only thing he knew—he tapped into his speed and started playing hide-and-seek with them.

Axiom, Kailan, and Kol were still a few seconds out. So he had to hold back the immortals for as long as he could for them to come and take over, so he could advance toward the prison Kaelith was held in.
Even without his taming bracelet, he started to sense his presence. It was just that he couldn’t speak to him without the taming bracelet.
So he knew exactly where to go, and he already had a way to go about it.
Kent flapped his wings, the void buzzing as he created a distance between himself and a few Immortal Kings who caught up to him when he stopped to assess the situation.

After getting out of their range, he halted and then, using the Soul Map, he teleported in the opposite direction. Before the Immortal Kings could close him in again, he teleported, appearing behind the reinforcement coming from the city.
BUZZ
His wings buzzed, and before they could sense what had happened, he was already blasting his way through their ranks. His wings weren’t just for flight; they were deadly weapons.

He blasted them away, clearing a vast path before him. However, he didn’t stop there. Before any of them could recover, Kent was already upon them, his metallic claws descending on them in a deadly slash.
He targeted an Immortal King first, sending him crashing into a building below. His bones were shattered, and his chest was torn open, blood flowing from just the initial attack.
However, Kent wasn’t attacking to make him recover. He was merely making sure that, when this was done, the message he was trying to send would be sent loud and clear.
So he took a nosedive, and before the Immortal King could get back up, Kent’s shadow enveloped him. His claws landed on him, crushing him to bits and pieces, his deadly claws staining with blood.
"What a mess," Kent said before taking to the air again. He had just killed an Immortal King; however, he didn’t have time to celebrate what a momentous achievement that was.

He combined his speed with the Soul Map so that as he moved, he also teleported nonstop. Eventually, after killing a few immortals, was surrounded on all sides. However, Axiom and his pals also arrived...

"Now might be the best time to reveal your deadly and monstrous forms, guys," Kent said, slamming his claws into a rather large roc who was tired of fighting like a human, so he transformed into his beast form.

"We can do that. But how are you going to break through them?" Axiom pointed at five Immortal Emperors standing not that far from the battlefield. They were the last line of defence between Kent and the prison.
"Leave that to me."

Axiom nodded, then he took on his form, taking on the look of a giant tiger-like beast with three deadly eyes. The moment he turned into his true beast form, his aura exploded, and the void shattered.

However, unlike how one would expect the void to heal in the next seconds, that didn’t happen. Instead, an overwhelming sucking force exploded out and latched onto a few immortals, dragging them into its dark maw.
Only then did it heal. Axiom was on the move, his overwhelming strength giving him an edge.

Kailan also transformed into a mutated phoenix, the kind with metallic wings. "I hope I don’t die on my first mission," Kailan said before flapping his wings, shooting dozens of metallic feathers at the immortals.
As for Kol, he transformed into a 400-meter-long and 150-meter-wide serpent with dark scales lining his colossal body. "Here we go."
Kent didn’t bother looking at them since, thanks to Kailan, he had finally gotten a path to the prison. When he moved, the five Immortal Emperors also moved, their Immortal Qi flaring.
"Not so fast."

Kent came to a stop, then he swiped his claws down, causing the air to suddenly become hot. The clouds parted, and a deadly finger emerged, instantly causing the five Immortal Emperors to halt their flight.
They were forced to the ground, their bodies shaking and sweat forming on their foreheads. Kent wasted no time and moved, leaving them to handle the Finger of Destruction.
He poured 70% of his flame essence and 80% of his blood Qi into it. However, even so, he could harness only 30% of the true power of the Finger of Destruction.
According to Bhaalzhar, the Finger of Destruction isn’t a true Primordial-grade technique. However, while that may be the case, it is also higher than a Celestial-grade technique. So it is powerful.

This also means that, while he was able to harness only 30% of its true power, it was enough to hold back the Immortal Emperors. There was no way they could break free of the hold it had on them unless they managed to defend against it.

But since it managed to hold them for now, he knew he had to hurry. While it may look like they were having the upper hand, Kent knew it could change at any moment, so he had to make a move now and hope he was fast enough.
He flapped his wings, and the next second, he was before a building. He transformed into his demi-dragon form and landed before it.
Without wasting time, his clawed hand moved, and the door was blasted open.
The moment it opened, he walked in, appearing in a large corridor lined with different prison cells on either side.
Seeing people in these cells, an idea came to mind.

"Today is your lucky day," Kent started breaking open the doors as he moved down the hall. He knew that since all these people were inside the prison, it meant their crimes were just too bad to let them back into society.
What would happen, then, if these people were freed? Naturally, he needed the distraction, so he started releasing them all.
Within a minute, over a hundred cell doors opened, and the people imprisoned were freed. As expected, these criminals began fighting for their lives when they were blocked by the flame rocs.
Eventually, Kent finally made his way to the door where Kaelith was imprisoned.

His claw moved, tearing a chunk off the metallic door. Kent grabbed the hole created and yanked the door off. The moment the door came off, Kaelith’s bony frame could be seen sitting at the centre of the room, his arms and limbs shackled.
Kent’s gaze grew cold as he saw his friend reduced to such a state.
"Rescue now, revenge later." Kent is angry, but he has managed to regain his composure and move closer.
"Don’t worry, buddy, I am now here." Kent’s claws moved, severing the chains in one go. Just when the last chain was severed, Kent sensed a terrifying presence closing in.
"Time to leave." Kent first sent Kaelith into the tower and then relayed the retreat order to his pals, who quickly vanished.
He, however, remained for one last bang.
He waved his hand, and over 30, ooo soul spirits appeared, feeling the 80,000km radius.

So he had to hold back the immortals for as long as he could for them to come and take over, so he could advance toward the prison Kaelith was held in.
Even without his taming bracelet, he started to sense his presence.
It was just that he couldn’t speak to him without the taming bracelet.
So he knew exactly where to go, and he already had a way to go about it.
Kent flapped his wings, the void buzzing as he created a distance between himself and a few Immortal Kings who caught up to him when he stopped to assess the situation.
After getting out of their range, he halted and then, using the Soul Map, he teleported in the opposite direction.
Before the Immortal Kings could close him in again, he teleported, appearing behind the reinforcement coming from the city.
BUZZ
His wings buzzed, and before they could sense what had happened, he was already blasting his way through their ranks.
His wings weren’t just for flight; they were deadly weapons.
He blasted them away, clearing a vast path before him.
However, he didn’t stop there.
Before any of them could recover, Kent was already upon them, his metallic claws descending on them in a deadly slash.
He targeted an Immortal King first, sending him crashing into a building below.
His bones were shattered, and his chest was torn open, blood flowing from just the initial attack.
However, Kent wasn’t attacking to make him recover.
He was merely making sure that, when this was done, the message he was trying to send would be sent loud and clear.
So he took a nosedive, and before the Immortal King could get back up, Kent’s shadow enveloped him.
His claws landed on him, crushing him to bits and pieces, his deadly claws staining with blood.
"What a mess," Kent said before taking to the air again.
He had just killed an Immortal King; however, he didn’t have time to celebrate what a momentous achievement that was.
He combined his speed with the Soul Map so that as he moved, he also teleported nonstop.
Eventually, after killing a few immortals, was surrounded on all sides.
However, Axiom and his pals also arrived...

"Now might be the best time to reveal your deadly and monstrous forms, guys," Kent said, slamming his claws into a rather large roc who was tired of fighting like a human, so he transformed into his beast form.
"We can do that.
But how are you going to break through them?" Axiom pointed at five Immortal Emperors standing not that far from the battlefield.
They were the last line of defence between Kent and the prison.
"Leave that to me."
Axiom nodded, then he took on his form, taking on the look of a giant tiger-like beast with three deadly eyes.
The moment he turned into his true beast form, his aura exploded, and the void shattered.
However, unlike how one would expect the void to heal in the next seconds, that didn’t happen.
Instead, an overwhelming sucking force exploded out and latched onto a few immortals, dragging them into its dark maw.
Only then did it heal.
Axiom was on the move, his overwhelming strength giving him an edge.
Kailan also transformed into a mutated phoenix, the kind with metallic wings.
"I hope I don’t die on my first mission," Kailan said before flapping his wings, shooting dozens of metallic feathers at the immortals.
As for Kol, he transformed into a 400-meter-long and 150-meter-wide serpent with dark scales lining his colossal body.
"Here we go."
Kent didn’t bother looking at them since, thanks to Kailan, he had finally gotten a path to the prison.
When he moved, the five Immortal Emperors also moved, their Immortal Qi flaring.
"Not so fast."
Kent came to a stop, then he swiped his claws down, causing the air to suddenly become hot.
The clouds parted, and a deadly finger emerged, instantly causing the five Immortal Emperors to halt their flight.
They were forced to the ground, their bodies shaking and sweat forming on their foreheads.
Kent wasted no time and moved, leaving them to handle the Finger of Destruction.
He poured 70% of his flame essence and 80% of his blood Qi into it.
However, even so, he could harness only 30% of the true power of the Finger of Destruction.
According to Bhaalzhar, the Finger of Destruction isn’t a true Primordial-grade technique.
However, while that may be the case, it is also higher than a Celestial-grade technique.
So it is powerful.
This also means that, while he was able to harness only 30% of its true power, it was enough to hold back the Immortal Emperors.
There was no way they could break free of the hold it had on them unless they managed to defend against it.
But since it managed to hold them for now, he knew he had to hurry.
While it may look like they were having the upper hand, Kent knew it could change at any moment, so he had to make a move now and hope he was fast enough.
He flapped his wings, and the next second, he was before a building.
He transformed into his demi-dragon form and landed before it.
Without wasting time, his clawed hand moved, and the door was blasted open.
The moment it opened, he walked in, appearing in a large corridor lined with different prison cells on either side.
Seeing people in these cells, an idea came to mind.
"Today is your lucky day," Kent started breaking open the doors as he moved down the hall.
He knew that since all these people were inside the prison, it meant their crimes were just too bad to let them back into society.
What would happen, then, if these people were freed?
Naturally, he needed the distraction, so he started releasing them all.
Within a minute, over a hundred cell doors opened, and the people imprisoned were freed.
As expected, these criminals began fighting for their lives when they were blocked by the flame rocs.
Eventually, Kent finally made his way to the door where Kaelith was imprisoned.
His claw moved, tearing a chunk off the metallic door.
Kent grabbed the hole created and yanked the door off.
The moment the door came off, Kaelith’s bony frame could be seen sitting at the centre of the room, his arms and limbs shackled.
Kent’s gaze grew cold as he saw his friend reduced to such a state.
"Rescue now, revenge later." Kent is angry, but he has managed to regain his composure and move closer.
"Don’t worry, buddy, I am now here." Kent’s claws moved, severing the chains in one go.
Just when the last chain was severed, Kent sensed a terrifying presence closing in.
"Time to leave." Kent first sent Kaelith into the tower and then relayed the retreat order to his pals, who quickly vanished.
He, however, remained for one last bang.
He waved his hand, and over 30, ooo soul spirits appeared, feeling the 80,000km radius.

chapters.title: Chapter 1341: Going Out With A Bang
paragraphs: The battle lasted for just 4 minutes and 20 seconds. However, within those precious minutes, Kent’s team managed to kill a demigod, 7 Immortal Lords, 23 Immortal Monarchs, and 452 others.
The soul explosion did most of the killing. However, they were merely within the ranks of True Immortals to Spirit Immortals. But even so, they added to the count.
The high-ranking immortals were killed by Uncle Drew, Enkay, and the Void Beasts.

However, losing a demigod and two others who were beaten to the brink of death shows Kent’s team is solid. They had fewer than ten members, but they managed to invade an entire city filled with immortal warriors and leave unscathed.
Surprisingly, it wasn’t Avotha who got the kill but rather Lene.

Turns out the demigod Avotha picked wasn’t so easy after all. He has a rather insidious aspect which allows him to heal much faster than he should. So whenever Avotha got close to ending him, his aspect kicks in.
Thankfully, he managed to hold him back long enough for Kent to rescue Kaelith. However, the moment the order was given, they retreated and vanished into the tower.
Even Axiom, Kol, and Kailan felt the connection to the tower, and so they left the moment Kent gave the order.
However, Kent didn’t want to leave just like that.
Tower had already informed him that the city is a military city where only some of the warriors of the Divine Flame Roc race live. The true homeworld of the Flame Rocs is unknown.
So, having this information and seeing what they did to Kaelith, even if he had to risk his life and precious soul spirits, he would make them pay in the thousands.
So just when he sensed the presence of the two new demigods, he released 30,000 soul spirits and spread them within an 80,000 km radius. That is about half the city.

Three seconds after his team left, two new demigods appeared. Kent teleported and appeared in the air, meeting their gaze with the same indifference he had when he met any enemy far stronger than him.

Seeing the damage caused, the two demigods, who appear far more deadly than the three they initially clashed with, release their auras, hoping to send Kent crashing down to the ground. However, to their shock, Kent remains in the air, unaffected.
"It would be wise to stop behaving like a cheated husband. Your aura won’t work on me, so save your strength for later... You are going to need it."
As if to prove his point, Kent took a step forward, showing the pressure being released by the two demigods had no effect on him.
"Now that I’ve got that out of the way, I want you to send a message to Kaelith’s father or whoever the idiot is that dares to imprison my friend in the first place.

Of course, you can try to stop me, but then you should also know that with a mere thought, all these soul spirits will explode, and while you two can survive, ask yourself how many others would be lucky."
A frown appeared on the faces of the two demigods. However, while they would love to take Kent’s head off his body, they knew such an explosion would indeed kill a lot of their people.
So they made no such move.

"That is what I thought," Kent smirked, then he said, "Tell that idiot that I, Kent Madson, have taken him as my enemy, that one day — soon — I will come for his head for what he did to my friend Kaelith.

Tell him to wash his neck and wait because until he is dead, my hatred for your race would not be satiated, and let me tell you, when I take you as my enemy, I make sure you suffer. So if you don’t want the Flame Roc race to suffer, you would do well to pass my message."
It is ironic and a bit unbelievable to think a mere mortal would be commanding two demigods to pass a threatening message to a god who had already reached the rank of a True God.
However, Kent had indeed risked his life for this moment, and now, looking at their faces, he knew they would pass his message along, or at least they made it look like they would.
"And what if we didn’t want to? What if we just capture you and take you to him?" One of the demigods asked, his aura surrounding Kent.
While his pressure did nothing to him, he knew his aura could at least catch Kent and render him immobile.
However, instead of panicking, Kent merely smiled...
"You know, a wise man once said, ’words without action are pointless.’ So allow me to give you the push you need to deliver my message."
Kent raised his hand, and before anyone could rush forward to stop him, he made his move. He snapped his finger.
"NOOOOOO!"

One of the demigods screams, his voice hoarse. However, half of the city was suddenly engulfed in white light. What followed were screams of pain and anguish that came from every direction, showing just how devastating the attack was.
One of the demigods moved, his hand shooting toward Kent’s neck. However, just before he could get hold of him, his body turned to smoke and vanished, but not before leaving one last line.
"Hasta la vista, bitches."
When the light cleared, thousands of immortals were either dead or screaming, their souls wounded in more than one place. Even the demigods that were beaten to near death felt the soul attack.

Kent left them with one last bang, and for that, they would do everything in their power to locate and get revenge. However, even if they did find him, they would have to travel to a high world to face him.
But doing so would just be sending themselves to the slaughterhouse since Kent wouldn’t let even a single one of them walk out alive.
Back inside the tower, Kent appeared inside the Mountain Garden, his expression pale. He fell to his knees, panting for breath.
Lene and Uncle Drew rush to his side, making sure he is alright.
He had just survived the combined assault of two demigods, not because he was capable, but because of a treasure he purchased from the tower.
It cost him 5 billion tower points; however, with the ability to withstand an attack from even a god for a minute and a half, Kent perfectly used it to his advantage to get what he wanted.
He succeeded in ensuring his message was delivered by giving them the right push. However, with everything good, there is a huge price to pay. Thankfully, he prepared in advance.
He retrieved a liquid from a small jade bottle and swallowed it, then retrieved a pill and swallowed that too. After about ten minutes, his pale expression finally started to regain colour.
"I am fine. But where is Kaelith?" he asked.
By the time he returned, Kaelith was already taken away to Gaiaville, where Elaine and the other healers inside the Tower Cities were diligently healing all wounds on his body.
They put him in an induced coma to make the healing process less painful for him.
After learning where Vexthra had taken Kaelith, Kent teleported there to make sure his friend was safe... after suffering for thousands of years.

chapters.title: Chapter 1342: The Aftermath
paragraphs: By the time Kent returned to Gaiaville, Elaine and the other healers had already done what they could for Kaelith. All that was left was for him to heal mentally and wake up.
External wounds and other injuries had healed, so he just had to wake up. For that, not even Elaine knew when. But at least he is in safe hands now.
He is free from the shackles that bound him for years.
"He will be fine, Kent. Just give him time to heal," Vexthra said, holding Kent’s hand. They stood beside the bed where Kaelith was.

Hearing Vexthra’s words, Kent nodded. He knew at this point there was nothing he could do for him. The least he could do was rescue him. Later, if there was a chance, they would seek their revenge, and he promised to leave more heads rolling.
"Thanks, everyone, for helping save my friend," Kent said to Elaine and the other healers who worked to save Kaelith’s life.
"No need to thank us, Kent. He is family, just like everyone here," Elaine said, creating a green dome around Kaelith’s body. Kent nodded to her words.
After spending a few minutes there, he left with Vexthra, who said she had something to show him.

They arrived in the legion tower the next second, where the members of the legions are already training after breaking their limits and awakening their innate talents, and even going as far as boosting their powers.

"Looks like you guys had it good inside the dungeon," Kent said, sensing the changes in the legion. He couldn’t sense any change in Vexthra, since she is just too powerful for his senses to make sense of anything.
But Kaizo and the rest aren’t exactly that strong for him. However, what he sensed made him realise they had become much stronger than the last time he saw them.
When they arrived, Kent saw that some of the members of the legion were nowhere to be found. However, some cocoons stand on the side, each radiating an intense power.
There are three of them, to be exact.
"Are these what you wanted to show me?" Kent asked, stopping in front of one of the cocoons.

"Yes. After clearing the 5th and 6th floors, we had to return to the tower to use the rewards we had received before going back. However, when Sylara, Ankaara, and Elyndra took their Innate Talent Awakening pill, this happened.
I tried to figure out what was wrong, but I came up empty, so I was hoping you could shed some light on this for us."

Kaizo and the other members of the legion focused their attention on Kent to hear what he had to say. Hearing the worry in Vexthra’s tone, he focused his attention on the cocoon for a few minutes before a sigh escaped his lips.
"There is nothing to worry about, Vex. They are just awakening their Innate Bodies."
"Really?" A small smile appeared on Vexthra’s lips, hearing what Kent said.

"Yes. We both know that when it comes to Innate Talents, the Innate Body is the best and perhaps the most important one. It seems these three are awakening theirs, and well, it will take some time, so you can either leave them behind and continue climbing the dungeon floor or wait for them to complete their awakening."
Vexthra nodded... "Since they are well, then we will leave them behind. We have less than 11 years to clear every floor, so we will get on that."
"Whatever you say. Just know that they are in safe hands. In fact, when they wake up, they would become even more powerful and beautiful than before."
"Good to know." Vexthra smiled happily and gave Kent a wink. Then she turned to Kaizo and the legion. "Get ready, we will be heading back to the dungeon soon."
"Finally." Kaizo, of course, became happy to hear that. He had awakened a rather monstrous innate ability that he wanted to test in combat. So, hearing Vexthra’s words, he became happy.
Kent merely shook his head and left with Vexthra. They arrived in the Mountain Garden where Gaia and her minions were already waiting for him.
They were in the Guardian Tower when a little gossip tower informed them he was back. They dropped everything and came to the Mountain Garden to wait for him.
It took him 10 minutes to free himself from their tiny hands. Then he focused on Gaia, who, at this point, can be called the leader of the troublemakers.
"How are things going, Gaia?"

"Since Big Brother happens to have so many tower points now, I was able to locate the three remaining beasts whose fangs I need to start the teleportation formation. I have built a one-way teleportation gate to the forest where they could be found.
It costs 20 million tower points each, plus some additional fees; however, they will take you there."
Kent smiles and turns toward Axiom, Kailan, and Kol... "I have a mission for you guys."

They liked the sound of that, so they rushed to his side. When Vexthra set her sights on them, there was a deep hatred suddenly surfacing in her heart. However, it vanished the next second, almost as if she hadn’t felt that.
This made her furrow her brow, but she said nothing.

"Vex, these are my new friends. They will be joining you and the legion to clear the dungeon floors. But before that, I have a mission for them." Kent said, and Vexthra nodded, her expression calm and scrutinising.
"Of course, as you suspect, they are not from this universe," Kent said, noticing the look in Vexthra’s eyes. "Three eyes is called Axiom, then there is Kailan and Kol. They are Void Beasts."
"I suspected as much."
"Nice meeting you, goddess. And rest assured, we have no plans to hurt anyone that Master Chaos didn’t want us to hurt," Axiom said, a small evil smile playing on his lips.
"Of course, if you also have someone you want to hurt but you are limited by the heavens, we are your guys," Kol added, causing Vexthra’s eyes to twitch and turn to Kent.
The Chaos Dragon laughed and said, "They are Void Beasts, so compassion and sympathy aren’t in their nature. But rest assured, they know when to be Void Beasts and when to be humans."

Vexthra nodded, feeling some resonance of his Hatred Domain forming with Axiom and his pals. She said nothing, but the fact that she felt like her domain was connecting with the three Void Beasts made her start to think about some stuff.

"This is Gaia. She will take you to a place where you have to hunt and kill three beasts. Then cut their fangs and bring them to her. When you return, I will take you to the dungeon where you will be spending your time until I am ready to ascend to the Immortal World."
"We are ready for anything, Boss," Kailan said, and Kent nodded.
"I will play with you girls later. But first, I have to play with my wives," Kent said to Gaia and her minions before teleporting away with Vexthra.
The moment they appeared inside the garden, Vexthra stripped naked, showing her flawless goddess body.
